sourceRange.text: 」庚戌，中書令李豐與皇后父光祿大夫張緝等謀廢易大臣，以太常夏侯玄為大將軍。事覺，諸所連及者皆伏誅。辛亥，大赦。三月，廢皇后張氏。夏四月，立皇后王氏，大赦。五月，封后父奉車都尉王夔為廣明鄉侯、光祿大夫，位特進，妻田氏為宣陽鄉君。秋九月，大將軍司馬景王將謀廢帝，以聞皇太后。《世語》及《魏氏春秋》並云：此秋，姜維寇隴右。時安東將軍司馬文王鎮許昌，徵還擊維，至京師，帝於平樂觀以臨軍過。中領軍許允與左右小臣謀，因文王辭，殺之，勒其衆以退大將軍。已書詔於前。文王入，帝方食栗，優人雲午等唱曰：「青頭雞，青頭雞。」青頭雞者，鴨也。帝懼不敢發。文王引兵入城，景王因是謀廢帝。臣松之案夏侯玄傳及《魏略》，許允此年春與李豐事相連。豐旣誅，即出允為鎮北將軍，未發，以放散官物收付廷尉，徙樂浪，追殺之。允此秋不得故為領軍而建此謀。甲戌，太后令曰：「皇帝芳春秋已長，不親萬機，耽淫內寵，沈漫女德，日延倡優，縱其醜謔；迎六宮家人留止內房，毀人倫之叙，亂男女之節；恭孝日虧，悖慠滋甚，不可以承天緒，奉宗廟。使兼太尉高柔奉策，用一元大武告于宗廟，遣芳歸藩于齊，以避皇位。」《魏書》曰：是日，景王承皇太后令，詔公卿中朝大臣會議，羣臣失色。景王流涕曰：「皇太后令如是，諸君其若王室何！」咸曰：「昔伊尹放太甲以寧殷，霍光廢昌邑以安漢，夫權定社稷以濟四海，二代行之於古，明公當之於今，今日之事，亦唯公命。」景王曰：「諸君所以望師者重，師安所避之？」於是乃與羣臣共為奏永寧宮曰：「守尚書令太尉長社侯臣孚、大將軍武陽侯臣師、司徒萬歲亭侯臣柔、司空文陽亭侯臣冲、行征西安東將軍新城侯臣昭、光祿大夫關內侯臣邕、太常臣晏、衞尉昌邑侯臣偉、太僕臣嶷、廷尉定陵侯臣毓、大鴻臚臣芝、大司農臣祥、少府臣袤、永寧衞尉臣楨、永寧太僕臣閣、大長秋臣模、司隷校尉潁昌侯臣曾、河南尹蘭陵侯臣肅、城門校尉臣慮、中護軍永安亭侯臣望、武衞將軍安壽亭侯臣演、中堅將軍平原侯臣德、中壘將軍昌武亭侯臣廙、屯騎校尉關內侯臣陔、步兵校尉臨晉侯臣建、射聲校尉安陽鄉侯臣溫、越騎校尉睢陽侯臣初、長水校尉關內侯臣超、侍中臣小同、臣顗、臣酆、博平侯臣表、侍中中書監安陽亭侯臣誕、散騎常侍臣瓌、臣儀、關內侯臣芝、尚書僕射光祿大夫高樂亭侯臣毓、尚書關內侯臣觀、臣嘏、長合鄉侯臣亮、臣贊、臣騫、中書令臣康、御史中丞臣鈐、博士臣範、臣峻等稽首言：臣等聞天子者，所以濟育羣生，永安萬國，三祖勳烈，光被六合。皇帝即位，纂繼洪業，春秋已長，未親萬機，耽淫內寵，沈漫女色，廢捐講學，棄辱儒士，日延小優郭懷、袁信等於建始芙蓉殿前裸袒游戲，使與保林女尚等為亂，親將後宮瞻觀。又於廣望觀上，使懷、信等於觀下作遼東妖婦，嬉褻過度，道路行人掩目，帝於觀上以為讌笑。於陵雲臺曲中施帷，見九親婦女，帝臨宣曲觀，呼懷、信使入帷共飲酒。懷、信等更行酒，婦女皆醉，戲侮無別。使保林李華、劉勳等與懷、信等戲，清商令令狐景呵華、勳曰：『諸女，上左右人，各有官職，何以得爾？』華、勳數讒毀景。帝常喜以彈彈人，以此恚景，彈景不避首目。景語帝曰：『先帝持門戶急，今陛下日將妃后游戲無度，至乃共觀倡優，裸袒為亂，不可令皇太后聞。景不愛死，為陛下計耳。』帝言：『我作天子，不得自在邪？太后何與我事！』使人燒鐵灼景，身體皆爛。甄后崩後，帝欲立王貴人為皇后。太后更欲外求，帝恚語景等：『魏家前後立皇后，皆從所愛耳，太后必違我意，知我當往不也？』後卒待張皇后疏薄。太后遭郃陽君喪，帝日在後園，倡優音樂自若，不數往定省。清商丞龐熈諫帝：『皇太后至孝，今遭重憂，水漿不入口，陛下當數往寬慰，不可但在此作樂。』帝言：『我自爾，誰能柰我何？』皇太后還北宮，殺張美人及禺婉，帝恚望，語景等：『太后橫殺我所寵愛，此無復母子恩。』數往至故處啼哭，私使暴室厚殯棺，不令太后知也。每見九親婦女有美色，或留以付清商。帝至後園竹間戲，或與從官攜手共行。熈白：『從官不宜與至尊相提挈。』帝怒，復以彈彈熈。日游後園，每有外文書入，帝不省，左右曰『出』，帝亦不索視。太后令帝常在式乾殿上講學，不欲，使行來，帝徑去；太后來問，輙詐令黃門荅言『在』耳。景、熈等畏恐，不敢復止，更共讇媚。帝肆行昏淫，敗人倫之叙，亂男女之節，恭孝彌頹，凶德浸盛。臣等憂懼傾覆天下，危墜社稷，雖殺身斃命不足以塞責。今帝不可以承天緒，臣請依漢霍光故事，收帝璽綬。帝本以齊王踐祚，宜歸藩于齊。使司徒臣柔持節，與有司以太牢告祀宗廟。臣謹昧死以聞。」奏可。是日遷居別宮，年二十三。使者持節送衞，營齊王宮於河內重門，制度皆如藩國之禮。《魏略》曰：景王將廢帝，遣郭芝入白太后，太后與帝對坐。芝謂帝曰：「大將軍欲廢陛下，立彭城王據。」帝乃起去。太后不恱。芝曰：「太后有子不能教，今大將軍意已成，又勒兵于外以備非常，但當順旨，將復何言！」太后曰：「我欲見大將軍，口有所說。」芝曰：「何可見邪？但當速取璽綬。」太后意折，乃遣傍侍御取璽綬著坐側。芝出報景王，景王甚歡。又遣使者授齊王印綬，當出就西宮。帝受命，遂載王車，與太后別，垂涕，始從太極殿南出，羣臣送者數十人，太尉司馬孚悲不自勝，餘多流涕。王出後，景王又使使者請璽綬。太后曰：「彭城王，我之季叔也，今來立，我當何之！且明皇帝當絕嗣乎？吾以為高貴鄉公者，文皇帝之長孫，明皇帝之弟子，於禮，小宗有後大宗之義，其詳議之。」景王乃更召群臣，以皇太后令示之，乃定迎高貴鄉公。是時太常已發二日，待璽綬於溫。事定，又請璽綬。太后令曰：「我見高貴鄉公，小時識之，明日我自欲以璽綬手授之也。」丁丑，令曰：「東海王霖，高祖文皇帝之子。霖之諸子，與國至親，高貴鄉公髦有大成之量，其以為明皇帝嗣。」《魏書》曰：景王復與羣臣共奏永寧宮曰：「臣等聞人道親親故尊祖，尊祖故敬宗。禮，大宗無嗣，則擇支子之賢者；為人後者，為之子也。東海定王子高貴鄉公，文皇帝之孫，宜承正統，以嗣烈祖明皇帝後。率土有賴，萬邦幸甚，臣請徵公詣洛陽宮。」奏可。使中護軍望、兼太常河南尹肅持節，與少府袤、尚書亮、侍中表等奉法駕，迎公于元城。《魏世譜》曰：晉受禪，封齊王為邵陵縣公。年四十三，泰始十年薨，謚曰厲公。

localRange.text: 高貴鄉公

context.beforeSource: 今追賜整、像爵關中侯，各除士名，使子襲爵，如部曲將死事科。

manualTranslations.zh: 」庚戌，中書令李豐與皇后父光祿大夫張緝等謀廢易大臣，以太常夏侯玄為大將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: On gengxu, Director of the Masters of Writing Li Feng, together with the empress's father, Household Grandee Zhang Ji, and others plotted to depose and replace the chief ministers, making Minister of Ceremonies Xiahou Xuan Grand General.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On gengxu Director of the Masters of Writing Li Feng, the empress's father Household Grandee Zhang Ji, and others plotted to depose the chief ministers and install Minister of Ceremonies Xiahou Xuan as Grand General.

manualTranslations.zh: 事覺，諸所連及者皆伏誅。
manualTranslations.literal: The plot was discovered; all connected with it were executed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The plot was exposed; everyone implicated was executed.

manualTranslations.zh: 辛亥，大赦。
manualTranslations.literal: On xinhai there was a general amnesty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On xinhai the court proclaimed a general amnesty.

manualTranslations.zh: 三月，廢皇后張氏。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third month Empress Zhang was deposed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the third month Empress Zhang was deposed.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏四月，立皇后王氏，大赦。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, the fourth month, Empress Wang was established, and there was a general amnesty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth month Empress Wang was installed and a general amnesty followed.

manualTranslations.zh: 五月，封后父奉車都尉王夔為廣明鄉侯、光祿大夫，位特進，妻田氏為宣陽鄉君。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month the empress's father, Commandant of the Imperial Carriage Wang Kui, was enfeoffed as Marquis of Guangming township, made Household Grandee with rank as Special Advance, and his wife, Lady Tian, was made Lady of Xuanyang township.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth month the new empress's father Wang Kui, Commandant of the Imperial Carriage, was enfeoffed as Marquis of Guangming township and made Household Grandee with Special Advance rank; his wife Lady Tian became Lady of Xuanyang township.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋九月，大將軍司馬景王將謀廢帝，以聞皇太后。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn, the ninth month, Grand General Sima Shi was about to plot deposing the emperor and reported this to the empress dowager.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the ninth month Grand General Sima Shi began plotting to depose the emperor and informed the empress dowager.

manualTranslations.zh: 《世語》及《魏氏春秋》並云：此秋，姜維寇隴右。
manualTranslations.literal: 〈The Accounts of the Age and the Wei Annals of Spring and Autumn both say: That autumn Jiang Wei raided Longxi's right flank.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: 〈Both the Shiyu and the Wei shi chunqiu record that that autumn Jiang Wei raided the Longxi frontier.

manualTranslations.zh: 時安東將軍司馬文王鎮許昌，徵還擊維，至京師，帝於平樂觀以臨軍過。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time General Who Pacifies the East Sima Zhao was stationed at Xuchang; he was summoned back to strike Jiang Wei, and when he reached the capital the emperor reviewed the army as it passed at Pingle Guan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: General Who Pacifies the East Sima Zhao was then at Xuchang; recalled to fight Jiang Wei, he reached the capital while the emperor reviewed the army at Pingle Guan as it passed.

manualTranslations.zh: 中領軍許允與左右小臣謀，因文王辭，殺之，勒其衆以退大將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: Colonel of the Central Army Xu Yun and minor attendants at the emperor's side plotted that when Sima Zhao took leave they would kill him and force his troops to withdraw before the Grand General.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Colonel of the Central Army Xu Yun and minor attendants plotted to kill Sima Zhao when he came to take leave, then compel his troops to withdraw before Sima Shi.

manualTranslations.zh: 已書詔於前。
manualTranslations.literal: The edict had already been written beforehand.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The edict had already been drafted.

manualTranslations.zh: 文王入，帝方食栗，優人雲午等唱曰：「青頭雞，青頭雞。」
manualTranslations.literal: When Sima Zhao entered, the emperor was eating chestnuts; the entertainers Yun Wu and others sang: "Green-headed chicken, green-headed chicken."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Sima Zhao entered, Cao Fang was eating chestnuts while entertainers led by Yun Wu sang: "Green-headed chicken, green-headed chicken."

manualTranslations.zh: 青頭雞者，鴨也。
manualTranslations.literal: "Green-headed chicken" meant duck.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: "Green-headed chicken" meant duck—a veiled reference to Sima Zhao.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝懼不敢發。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor feared and did not act.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor took fright and did not carry out the plot.

manualTranslations.zh: 文王引兵入城，景王因是謀廢帝。
manualTranslations.literal: Sima Zhao led troops into the city, and Sima Shi thereupon plotted to depose the emperor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sima Zhao marched into the city, and Sima Shi then moved to depose the emperor.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣松之案夏侯玄傳及《魏略》，許允此年春與李豐事相連。
manualTranslations.literal: Your subject Pei Songzhi, examining Xiahou Xuan's biography and the Wei lue, finds that Xu Yun in the spring of this year was connected with Li Feng's affair.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Pei Songzhi, checking Xiahou Xuan's biography and the Wei lue, notes that Xu Yun that spring was implicated in Li Feng's plot.

manualTranslations.zh: 豐旣誅，即出允為鎮北將軍，未發，以放散官物收付廷尉，徙樂浪，追殺之。
manualTranslations.literal: After Feng was executed, Yun was at once sent out as General Who Pacifies the North; before he departed he was seized for distributing official goods, handed to the Commandant of Justice, exiled to Lelang, and pursued and killed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Li Feng's execution Xu Yun was posted out as General Who Pacifies the North; before he left he was seized for distributing government stores, sent to the Commandant of Justice, exiled to Lelang, and hunted down and killed.

manualTranslations.zh: 允此秋不得故為領軍而建此謀。
manualTranslations.literal: Yun could not therefore still have been Colonel of the Central Army that autumn and have made this plot.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He could not therefore still have been central-army colonel that autumn and have led this conspiracy.

manualTranslations.zh: 甲戌，太后令曰：「皇帝芳春秋已長，不親萬機，耽淫內寵，沈漫女德，日延倡優，縱其醜謔；
manualTranslations.literal: An empress dowager order on jiaxu said: "Emperor Fang's years are already grown, yet he does not personally attend to the myriad affairs of state; he indulges inner favorites and sinks into feminine virtue, daily summoning entertainers and letting them utter foul jests;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An empress dowager order on jiaxu ran: "Emperor Cao Fang has come of age yet does not govern; he dotes on inner favorites, drowns in pleasure, daily summons entertainers, and lets them speak obscenely;

manualTranslations.zh: 迎六宮家人留止內房，毀人倫之叙，亂男女之節；
manualTranslations.literal: he welcomes families of the six palaces and keeps them in the inner chambers, destroying human relations and disordering male and female propriety;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: he brings families of the six palaces into the inner chambers, destroying human relations and disordering male and female propriety;

manualTranslations.zh: 恭孝日虧，悖慠滋甚，不可以承天緒，奉宗廟。
manualTranslations.literal: filial reverence daily wanes and perversity grows ever worse—he cannot inherit Heaven's line or serve the ancestral temples.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: filial reverence wanes daily while perversity grows—he cannot inherit Heaven's mandate or serve the ancestral temples.

manualTranslations.zh: 使兼太尉高柔奉策，用一元大武告于宗廟，遣芳歸藩于齊，以避皇位。」
manualTranslations.literal: Let Acting Grand Commandant Gao Rou bear the staff of office and, with the Grand Sacrifice to the One Martial Power, announce this to the ancestral temples; send Fang back to his fief in Qi to yield the throne."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Let Acting Grand Commandant Gao Rou bear the staff, announce the Grand Sacrifice to the One Martial Power at the ancestral temples, and send Cao Fang back to Qi to yield the throne."

manualTranslations.zh: 《魏書》曰：是日，景王承皇太后令，詔公卿中朝大臣會議，羣臣失色。
manualTranslations.literal: 〈The Book of Wei states: That day Sima Shi, receiving the empress dowager's order, summoned the dukes, ministers, and court officials to council; the assembled ministers turned pale.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: 〈The Book of Wei states that Sima Shi, acting on the empress dowager's order, summoned the court to council and every minister turned pale.

manualTranslations.zh: 景王流涕曰：「皇太后令如是，諸君其若王室何！」
manualTranslations.literal: Sima Shi wept and said: "The empress dowager's order is as you have heard—how will you gentlemen save the royal house!"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sima Shi wept: "The empress dowager's order stands as you hear—how can you save the royal house!"

manualTranslations.zh: 咸曰：「昔伊尹放太甲以寧殷，霍光廢昌邑以安漢，夫權定社稷以濟四海，二代行之於古，明公當之於今，今日之事，亦唯公命。」
manualTranslations.literal: All said: "Formerly Yi Yin deposed Tai Jia to settle Yin; Huo Guang deposed the Prince of Changyi to secure Han—when power settles the altars to rescue the four seas, both ages practiced it in antiquity; the enlightened lord should do so today; today's affair rests only on your command."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: All answered: "Yi Yin deposed Tai Jia to save Yin; Huo Guang deposed the Prince of Changyi to save Han—when power steadies the altars and rescues the realm, antiquity honors the man who acts; today that man is you."

manualTranslations.zh: 景王曰：「諸君所以望師者重，師安所避之？」
manualTranslations.literal: Sima Shi said: "The weight with which you gentlemen look to me is great—how can I shrink from it?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sima Shi said: "You place great weight on me—how can I refuse?"

manualTranslations.zh: 於是乃與羣臣共為奏永寧宮曰：「守尚書令太尉長社侯臣孚、大將軍武陽侯臣師、司徒萬歲亭侯臣柔、司空文陽亭侯臣冲、行征西安東將軍新城侯臣昭、光祿大夫關內侯臣邕、太常臣晏、衞尉昌邑侯臣偉、太僕臣嶷、廷尉定陵侯臣毓、大鴻臚臣芝、大司農臣祥、少府臣袤、永寧衞尉臣楨、永寧太僕臣閣、大長秋臣模、司隷校尉潁昌侯臣曾、河南尹蘭陵侯臣肅、城門校尉臣慮、中護軍永安亭侯臣望、武衞將軍安壽亭侯臣演、中堅將軍平原侯臣德、中壘將軍昌武亭侯臣廙、屯騎校尉關內侯臣陔、步兵校尉臨晉侯臣建、射聲校尉安陽鄉侯臣溫、越騎校尉睢陽侯臣初、長水校尉關內侯臣超、侍中臣小同、臣顗、臣酆、博平侯臣表、侍中中書監安陽亭侯臣誕、散騎常侍臣瓌、臣儀、關內侯臣芝、尚書僕射光祿大夫高樂亭侯臣毓、尚書關內侯臣觀、臣嘏、長合鄉侯臣亮、臣贊、臣騫、中書令臣康、御史中丞臣鈐、博士臣範、臣峻等稽首言：臣等聞天子者，所以濟育羣生，永安萬國，三祖勳烈，光被六合。
manualTranslations.literal: Thereupon together with the assembled ministers he memorialized Yongning Palace: "Guardian Director of the Masters of Writing, Grand Commandant, Marquis of Changshe Fu; Grand General, Marquis of Wuyang Shi; Minister of Education, Marquis of Wansui township Rou; Minister of Works, Marquis of Wenyang township Chong; Acting General Who Pacifies the West and General Who Pacifies the East, Marquis of Xincheng Zhao; Household Grandee, Marquis of Guannei Yong; Minister of Ceremonies Yan; Minister of Guard, Marquis of Changyi Wei; Minister of the Imperial Stud Yi; Commandant of Justice, Marquis of Dingling Yu; Grand Herald Zhi; Grand Minister of Agriculture Xiang; Minister of the Imperial Treasury Mao; Yongning Minister of Guard Zhen; Yongning Minister of the Imperial Stud Ge; Grand Director of the Imperial Household Mo; Colonel of Censorate, Marquis of Yingchang Zeng; Intendant of Henan, Marquis of Lanling Su; Colonel of the City Gates Lu; Colonel of the Central Army, Marquis of Yong'an Wang; General of the Martial Guard, Marquis of Anshou Yan; Colonel of the Central Army, Marquis of Pingyuan De; Colonel of the Central Rampart, Marquis of Changwu Yi; Colonel of the Resolute Cavalry, Marquis of Guannei Gai; Colonel of Foot Soldiers, Marquis of Linjin Jian; Colonel of the Sound of Shooting, Marquis of Anyang township Wen; Colonel of the Agile Cavalry, Marquis of Suiyang Chu; Colonel of the Long River Chao; Palace Attendants Xiaotong, Yi, Feng, Biao; Palace Attendant and Director of the Masters of Writing, Marquis of Anyang township Dan; Regular Attendants Gui, Yi, Zhi; Master of Writing, Deputy Director and Household Grandee, Marquis of Gaole township Yu; Masters of Writing Guan, Gu, Liang, Zan, Qian; Director of the Masters of Writing Kang; Imperial Secretary Qian; Erudites Fan, Jun, and others bowed their heads and said: We have heard that the Son of Heaven exists to nourish the host of living beings and bring lasting peace to the myriad states; the three founders' achievements shine through the six directions.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Thereupon he and the ministers jointly memorialized Yongning Palace, listing every senior officer from Sima Fu and Sima Shi through the full roster of ministers, who bowed and said: "We have heard that the Son of Heaven exists to nourish the people and secure the realm; the three founders' achievements shine through the six directions."

manualTranslations.zh: 皇帝即位，纂繼洪業，春秋已長，未親萬機，耽淫內寵，沈漫女色，廢捐講學，棄辱儒士，日延小優郭懷、袁信等於建始芙蓉殿前裸袒游戲，使與保林女尚等為亂，親將後宮瞻觀。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor ascended the throne and inherited the great enterprise; his years are already grown, yet he does not personally attend to the myriad affairs of state; he indulges inner favorites and sinks into feminine beauty, abandons lectures and study, and insults Confucian scholars; daily he summons minor entertainers Guo Huai, Yuan Xin, and others before the Furong Hall of Jianshi to play naked and sport, making them riot with the palace women Shang and others while he personally led the inner palace to watch.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor inherited the throne; his years are grown, yet he does not govern; he dotes on inner favorites, drowns in women, abandons study, insults scholars, and daily summons Guo Huai, Yuan Xin, and other entertainers to sport naked before the Furong Hall at Jianshi, riot with palace women, and lead the inner quarters to watch.

manualTranslations.zh: 又於廣望觀上，使懷、信等於觀下作遼東妖婦，嬉褻過度，道路行人掩目，帝於觀上以為讌笑。
manualTranslations.literal: Again, at Guangwang Guan he had Huai, Xin, and others below the tower act out a Liaodong sorceress in excessive lewd play; travelers on the road covered their eyes, while the emperor on the tower took it for banquet laughter.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At Guangwang Guan he had Huai and Xin act out a Liaodong sorceress in lewd play so indecent that passersby covered their eyes while he laughed from the tower.

manualTranslations.zh: 於陵雲臺曲中施帷，見九親婦女，帝臨宣曲觀，呼懷、信使入帷共飲酒。
manualTranslations.literal: Within the curves of Lingyun Terrace he hung curtains and summoned the women of the nine kin; the emperor came to Xuangu Guan and called Huai and Xin into the curtains to drink together.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At Lingyun Terrace he hung curtains and summoned women of the nine kin; at Xuangu Guan he called Huai and Xin inside the curtains to drink with them.

manualTranslations.zh: 懷、信等更行酒，婦女皆醉，戲侮無別。
manualTranslations.literal: Huai, Xin, and the others passed cups again; the women all grew drunk and frolicked without distinction.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Huai and Xin kept passing cups until the women were drunk and frolicked without restraint.

manualTranslations.zh: 使保林李華、劉勳等與懷、信等戲，清商令令狐景呵華、勳曰：『諸女，上左右人，各有官職，何以得爾？』
manualTranslations.literal: He had palace women Li Hua, Liu Xun, and others sport with Huai and Xin; Director of Clear Music Linghu Jing rebuked Hua and Xun, saying: 'These women are persons at Your Majesty's side; each has an office—how can it be thus?'
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He set palace women Li Hua and Liu Xun to sport with Huai and Xin; Director of Clear Music Linghu Jing rebuked them: 'These women serve Your Majesty in office—how can this be allowed?'

manualTranslations.zh: 華、勳數讒毀景。
manualTranslations.literal: Hua and Xun repeatedly slandered Jing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hua and Xun repeatedly slandered Linghu Jing.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝常喜以彈彈人，以此恚景，彈景不避首目。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor often delighted in shooting people with pellets; for this he resented Jing and shot at Jing without avoiding head or eyes.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor loved shooting people with pellets; resenting Jing, he shot at his head and eyes without restraint.

manualTranslations.zh: 景語帝曰：『先帝持門戶急，今陛下日將妃后游戲無度，至乃共觀倡優，裸袒為亂，不可令皇太后聞。
manualTranslations.literal: Jing said to the emperor: 'The late emperor kept strict household discipline; now Your Majesty daily leads consorts and empresses in boundless sport, even together watching entertainers naked and rioting—this must not reach the empress dowager.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jing told him: 'The late emperor kept strict household discipline; now Your Majesty leads consorts in boundless sport, even watching entertainers riot naked—this must not reach the empress dowager.

manualTranslations.zh: 景不愛死，為陛下計耳。』
manualTranslations.literal: Jing does not love life; I speak only for Your Majesty's sake.'
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I do not cling to life; I speak only for Your Majesty's sake.'

manualTranslations.zh: 帝言：『我作天子，不得自在邪？
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor said: 'I am Son of Heaven—may I not be free?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor snapped: 'I am Son of Heaven—may I not do as I please?

manualTranslations.zh: 太后何與我事！』
manualTranslations.literal: What has the empress dowager to do with my affairs!'
manualTranslations.idiomatic: What business is the empress dowager of mine!'

manualTranslations.zh: 使人燒鐵灼景，身體皆爛。
manualTranslations.literal: He had someone heat iron and burn Jing; his body was all scorched.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He had iron heated and burned Linghu Jing until his body was scorched raw.

manualTranslations.zh: 甄后崩後，帝欲立王貴人為皇后。
manualTranslations.literal: After Empress Zhen died, the emperor wished to establish Lady Wang as empress.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Empress Zhen died the emperor wished to make Lady Wang empress.

manualTranslations.zh: 太后更欲外求，帝恚語景等：『魏家前後立皇后，皆從所愛耳，太后必違我意，知我當往不也？』
manualTranslations.literal: The empress dowager wished instead to seek outside; the emperor angrily told Jing and the others: 'The Wei house has always established empresses from those the ruler loved; the empress dowager is sure to oppose my wish—does she know I will go anyway?'
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The empress dowager wished to choose elsewhere; the emperor told Jing and the others in anger: 'Every Wei empress was chosen from the ruler's favorite—she will oppose me; does she think I will not go anyway?'

manualTranslations.zh: 後卒待張皇后疏薄。
manualTranslations.literal: Later he ended by treating Empress Zhang coldly and thinly.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He ended by treating Empress Zhang with cold neglect.

manualTranslations.zh: 太后遭郃陽君喪，帝日在後園，倡優音樂自若，不數往定省。
manualTranslations.literal: When the empress dowager suffered the Hedang princess's bereavement, the emperor daily remained in the rear garden with entertainers and music as usual, and did not often go to inquire after her.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the empress dowager mourned the Hedang princess, the emperor stayed in the rear garden with music and entertainers as usual and rarely went to comfort her.

manualTranslations.zh: 清商丞龐熈諫帝：『皇太后至孝，今遭重憂，水漿不入口，陛下當數往寬慰，不可但在此作樂。』
manualTranslations.literal: Assistant Director of Clear Music Pang Xi admonished the emperor: 'The empress dowager is utmost in filial piety; now she suffers heavy grief and takes neither water nor food—Your Majesty should often go to comfort her; you cannot simply make merry here.'
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Assistant Director of Clear Music Pang Xi admonished him: 'The empress dowager is deeply filial and now takes neither water nor food in grief—Your Majesty should go often to comfort her, not simply make merry here.'

manualTranslations.zh: 帝言：『我自爾，誰能柰我何？』
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor said: 'I do as I please—who can do anything to me?'
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor said: 'I do as I please—who can stop me?'

manualTranslations.zh: 皇太后還北宮，殺張美人及禺婉，帝恚望，語景等：『太后橫殺我所寵愛，此無復母子恩。』
manualTranslations.literal: When the empress dowager returned to the Northern Palace she killed Lady Zhang the Beauty and Yu Wan; the emperor resented and told Jing and the others: 'The empress dowager killed those I favored—between us there is no further mother-son kindness.'
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the empress dowager returned to the Northern Palace she killed Lady Zhang the Beauty and Yu Wan; the emperor told Jing and the others in fury: 'She killed those I loved—there is no mother-son bond left.'

manualTranslations.zh: 數往至故處啼哭，私使暴室厚殯棺，不令太后知也。
manualTranslations.literal: Repeatedly he went to the old places to weep, and secretly had the Chamber of Punishments give thick burial coffins without letting the empress dowager know.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He repeatedly wept at the old places and secretly ordered thick coffins from the Chamber of Punishments without telling the empress dowager.

manualTranslations.zh: 每見九親婦女有美色，或留以付清商。
manualTranslations.literal: Whenever he saw a beautiful woman among the nine kin he sometimes kept her and handed her over to Clear Music.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Whenever he saw a beautiful woman among the nine kin he kept her and handed her to Clear Music.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝至後園竹間戲，或與從官攜手共行。
manualTranslations.literal: When the emperor went to sport among the bamboo in the rear garden he sometimes walked hand in hand with attendants.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sporting among the bamboo in the rear garden he sometimes walked hand in hand with attendants.

manualTranslations.zh: 熈白：『從官不宜與至尊相提挈。』
manualTranslations.literal: Xi said: 'Attendants should not link arms with the supreme sovereign.'
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Pang Xi said: 'Attendants should not link arms with the sovereign.'

manualTranslations.zh: 帝怒，復以彈彈熈。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor grew angry and again shot pellets at Xi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor shot pellets at Pang Xi again.

manualTranslations.zh: 日游後園，每有外文書入，帝不省，左右曰『出』，帝亦不索視。
manualTranslations.literal: Daily he roamed the rear garden; whenever an outside document came in the emperor did not examine it—when attendants said 'out,' he did not ask to see it either.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He roamed the rear garden daily; when outside documents arrived he never read them—when attendants said 'out,' he never asked to see them.

manualTranslations.zh: 太后令帝常在式乾殿上講學，不欲，使行來，帝徑去；
manualTranslations.literal: The empress dowager ordered the emperor to lecture regularly in the Hall of Shiqian; he did not wish it and went straight away;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The empress dowager ordered him to lecture regularly in the Hall of Shiqian; unwilling, he simply left;

manualTranslations.zh: 太后來問，輙詐令黃門荅言『在』耳。
manualTranslations.literal: when the empress dowager came to ask, he always had the Yellow Gate answer 'he is here.'
manualTranslations.idiomatic: when she came to ask, he always had the Yellow Gate answer that he was there.

manualTranslations.zh: 景、熈等畏恐，不敢復止，更共讇媚。
manualTranslations.literal: Jing, Xi, and the others feared and dared not again stop him, but together flattered him instead.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jing, Xi, and the others grew afraid to stop him and flattered him instead.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝肆行昏淫，敗人倫之叙，亂男女之節，恭孝彌頹，凶德浸盛。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor wantonly pursued dark debauchery, destroying human relations and disordering male and female propriety; filial reverence collapsed further and vicious conduct swelled.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor wantonly pursued debauchery, destroyed human relations, and overturned male and female propriety; filial reverence collapsed and vicious conduct swelled.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣等憂懼傾覆天下，危墜社稷，雖殺身斃命不足以塞責。
manualTranslations.literal: We, your ministers, fear the realm will be overturned and the altars will fall in peril; even dying would not suffice to atone.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: We fear the realm will overturn and the altars fall; even our deaths would not atone.

manualTranslations.zh: 今帝不可以承天緒，臣請依漢霍光故事，收帝璽綬。
manualTranslations.literal: Now the emperor cannot inherit Heaven's line; we ask, following Han Huo Guang's precedent, to take back the imperial seal and cord.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor cannot inherit Heaven's mandate; we ask, following Huo Guang's Han precedent, to take back the imperial seal and cord.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝本以齊王踐祚，宜歸藩于齊。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor originally ascended as Prince of Qi; he should return to his fief in Qi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He originally ascended as Prince of Qi and should return to Qi.

manualTranslations.zh: 使司徒臣柔持節，與有司以太牢告祀宗廟。
manualTranslations.literal: Let Minister of Education Rou bear the staff and, with the relevant offices, announce the grand sacrifice to the ancestral temples.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Let Minister of Education Gao Rou bear the staff and, with the relevant offices, announce the grand sacrifice at the ancestral temples.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣謹昧死以聞。」
manualTranslations.literal: Your ministers respectfully risk death to report this."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: We respectfully risk death to report this."

manualTranslations.zh: 奏可。
manualTranslations.literal: The memorial was approved.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The memorial was approved.

manualTranslations.zh: 是日遷居別宮，年二十三。
manualTranslations.literal: That day he moved to a separate palace; he was twenty-three.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That day Cao Fang moved to a separate palace; he was twenty-three.

manualTranslations.zh: 使者持節送衞，營齊王宮於河內重門，制度皆如藩國之禮。
manualTranslations.literal: Bearers with staff escorted and guarded him; the Prince of Qi's palace was built at Chongmen in Henei, its regulations all like those of a feudal state.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Bearers with staff escorted him; a princely residence was built for the Prince of Qi at Chongmen in Henei with full feudal protocol.

manualTranslations.zh: 《魏略》曰：景王將廢帝，遣郭芝入白太后，太后與帝對坐。
manualTranslations.literal: 〈The Wei lue states: As Sima Shi was about to depose the emperor he sent Guo Zhi in to inform the empress dowager; the empress dowager and the emperor sat facing each other.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: 〈The Wei lue states that as Sima Shi prepared to depose the emperor he sent Guo Zhi to inform the empress dowager while she and the emperor sat face to face.

manualTranslations.zh: 芝謂帝曰：「大將軍欲廢陛下，立彭城王據。」
manualTranslations.literal: Zhi said to the emperor: "The Grand General wishes to depose Your Majesty and establish the Prince of Pengcheng, Ju."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Guo Zhi told the emperor: "The Grand General means to depose you and raise Cao Ju, Prince of Pengcheng."

manualTranslations.zh: 帝乃起去。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor thereupon rose and left.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor at once rose and left.

manualTranslations.zh: 太后不恱。
manualTranslations.literal: The empress dowager was displeased.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The empress dowager was displeased.

manualTranslations.zh: 芝曰：「太后有子不能教，今大將軍意已成，又勒兵于外以備非常，但當順旨，將復何言！」
manualTranslations.literal: Zhi said: "The empress dowager had a son yet could not teach him; now the Grand General's intent is already fixed, and again he has drawn up troops outside to guard against the unexpected—you should only follow the command; what more can be said!"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Guo Zhi said: "You had a son yet could not teach him; the Grand General's mind is set and troops are drawn up outside—obey the command; what more is there to say!"

manualTranslations.zh: 太后曰：「我欲見大將軍，口有所說。」
manualTranslations.literal: The empress dowager said: "I wish to see the Grand General; I have something to say by mouth."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The empress dowager said: "I wish to see the Grand General; I have words to speak."

manualTranslations.zh: 芝曰：「何可見邪？
manualTranslations.literal: Zhi said: "How can you see him?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Guo Zhi said: "How can you see him?

manualTranslations.zh: 但當速取璽綬。」
manualTranslations.literal: You should only quickly take the seal and cord."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Take the seal and cord at once."

manualTranslations.zh: 太后意折，乃遣傍侍御取璽綬著坐側。
manualTranslations.literal: The empress dowager's will broke; she then had a attendant at her side take the seal and cord and place them beside her seat.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Her will broke; she had an attendant bring the seal and cord and set them beside her seat.

manualTranslations.zh: 芝出報景王，景王甚歡。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhi went out and reported to Sima Shi; Sima Shi was very pleased.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Guo Zhi reported to Sima Shi, who was greatly pleased.

manualTranslations.zh: 又遣使者授齊王印綬，當出就西宮。
manualTranslations.literal: Again he sent envoys to confer the Prince of Qi's seal and cord; the emperor was to go out to the Western Palace.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He again sent envoys with the Prince of Qi's seal and cord; the emperor was to go to the Western Palace.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝受命，遂載王車，與太后別，垂涕，始從太極殿南出，羣臣送者數十人，太尉司馬孚悲不自勝，餘多流涕。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor received the command, then mounted the princely carriage, parted from the empress dowager in tears, and first went out south from the Hall of Great Ultimate; several tens of ministers escorted him—Grand Commandant Sima Fu grieved beyond control, and most of the rest wept.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Cao Fang accepted the command, mounted the princely carriage, parted from the empress dowager in tears, and first went out south from the Hall of Great Ultimate; dozens of ministers escorted him—Sima Fu grieved beyond control and most wept.

manualTranslations.zh: 王出後，景王又使使者請璽綬。
manualTranslations.literal: After the prince went out, Sima Shi again sent envoys to request the seal and cord.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Cao Fang left, Sima Shi again sent envoys to request the seal and cord.

manualTranslations.zh: 太后曰：「彭城王，我之季叔也，今來立，我當何之！
manualTranslations.literal: The empress dowager said: "The Prince of Pengcheng is my youngest uncle; if he comes to be established, where am I to go!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The empress dowager said: "Cao Ju, Prince of Pengcheng, is my youngest uncle—if he is raised, where am I to go?

manualTranslations.zh: 且明皇帝當絕嗣乎？
manualTranslations.literal: And is Emperor Ming to be left without an heir?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Will Emperor Ming be left without an heir?

manualTranslations.zh: 吾以為高貴鄉公者，文皇帝之長孫，明皇帝之弟子，於禮，小宗有後大宗之義，其詳議之。」
manualTranslations.literal: I consider the Duke of Gaogui Township—he is Emperor Wen's eldest grandson and Emperor Ming's younger brother's son; by ritual, a minor line may continue a major line—let this be debated in detail."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I favor Cao Mao, Duke of Gaogui Township—Emperor Wen's eldest grandson and Emperor Ming's nephew; by ritual a minor line may continue a major line—debate this carefully."

manualTranslations.zh: 景王乃更召群臣，以皇太后令示之，乃定迎高貴鄉公。
manualTranslations.literal: Sima Shi thereupon again summoned the assembled ministers, showed them the empress dowager's order, and then fixed welcoming the Duke of Gaogui Township.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sima Shi summoned the ministers again, showed the empress dowager's order, and fixed on welcoming Cao Mao.

manualTranslations.zh: 是時太常已發二日，待璽綬於溫。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time the Minister of Ceremonies had already set out two days earlier, awaiting the seal and cord at Wen.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Minister of Ceremonies had already set out two days earlier, awaiting the seal and cord at Wen.

manualTranslations.zh: 事定，又請璽綬。
manualTranslations.literal: When the matter was settled, he again requested the seal and cord.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the matter was settled he again requested the seal and cord.

manualTranslations.zh: 太后令曰：「我見高貴鄉公，小時識之，明日我自欲以璽綬手授之也。」
manualTranslations.literal: An empress dowager order said: "I have seen the Duke of Gaogui Township; I knew him as a child; tomorrow I myself wish to hand him the seal and cord in person."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The empress dowager ordered: "I know Cao Mao from childhood; tomorrow I myself will hand him the seal and cord."

manualTranslations.zh: 丁丑，令曰：「東海王霖，高祖文皇帝之子。
manualTranslations.literal: On dingchou an order said: "The Prince of the Eastern Sea, Lin, is High Ancestor Emperor Wen's son.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On dingchou an order said: "Cao Lin, Prince of the Eastern Sea, was Emperor Wen's son.

manualTranslations.zh: 霖之諸子，與國至親，高貴鄉公髦有大成之量，其以為明皇帝嗣。」
manualTranslations.literal: Among Lin's sons, closest in kin to the state, the Duke of Gaogui Township Mao has the measure of great accomplishment—let him be Emperor Ming's heir."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Of his sons Cao Mao, Duke of Gaogui Township, has the measure of great accomplishment—let him be Emperor Ming's heir."

manualTranslations.zh: 《魏書》曰：景王復與羣臣共奏永寧宮曰：「臣等聞人道親親故尊祖，尊祖故敬宗。
manualTranslations.literal: 〈The Book of Wei states: Sima Shi again jointly memorialized Yongning Palace with the assembled ministers: "We have heard that in human relations closeness to kin leads to honoring the ancestor, and honoring the ancestor leads to revering the lineage.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: 〈The Book of Wei states that Sima Shi again jointly memorialized Yongning Palace: "In human relations closeness to kin leads to honoring the ancestor, and honoring the ancestor leads to revering the lineage.

manualTranslations.zh: 禮，大宗無嗣，則擇支子之賢者；
manualTranslations.literal: By ritual, when the major line has no heir, one chooses a worthy branch son;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: By ritual, when the major line lacks an heir one chooses a worthy branch son;

manualTranslations.zh: 為人後者，為之子也。
manualTranslations.literal: one who becomes heir becomes as a son."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: he who becomes heir becomes as a son."

manualTranslations.zh: 東海定王子高貴鄉公，文皇帝之孫，宜承正統，以嗣烈祖明皇帝後。
manualTranslations.literal: The Duke of Gaogui Township, son of the Prince of the Eastern Sea, Ding, is Emperor Wen's grandson; he should inherit the legitimate line and succeed as heir after Illustrious Ancestor Emperor Ming.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Cao Mao, son of Cao Lin, Prince of the Eastern Sea, is Emperor Wen's grandson; he should inherit the legitimate line and succeed Emperor Ming.

manualTranslations.zh: 率土有賴，萬邦幸甚，臣請徵公詣洛陽宮。」
manualTranslations.literal: All within the realm have reliance; the myriad states are greatly fortunate—we ask that the duke be summoned to the Luoyang palace."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: All within the realm will have reliance; the myriad states will be fortunate—we ask that he be summoned to the Luoyang palace."

manualTranslations.zh: 奏可。
manualTranslations.literal: The memorial was approved.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The memorial was approved.

manualTranslations.zh: 使中護軍望、兼太常河南尹肅持節，與少府袤、尚書亮、侍中表等奉法駕，迎公于元城。
manualTranslations.literal: He sent Colonel of the Central Army Wang, Acting Minister of Ceremonies and Intendant of Henan Su bearing the staff, together with Minister of the Imperial Treasury Mao, Master of Writing Liang, and Palace Attendant Biao and others with the full imperial equipage to welcome the duke at Yuan city.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He sent Colonel of the Central Army Wang, Acting Minister of Ceremonies and Intendant of Henan Su, Minister of the Imperial Treasury Mao, Master of Writing Liang, Palace Attendant Biao, and others with the full imperial equipage to welcome Cao Mao at Yuancheng.

manualTranslations.zh: 《魏世譜》曰：晉受禪，封齊王為邵陵縣公。
manualTranslations.literal: 〈The Wei House Genealogy states: When Jin received the abdication, the Prince of Qi was enfeoffed as Duke of Shaoling county.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: 〈The Wei House Genealogy states that when Jin received the abdication Cao Fang was enfeoffed as Duke of Shaoling county.

manualTranslations.zh: 年四十三，泰始十年薨，謚曰厲公。
manualTranslations.literal: Age forty-three; he died in the tenth year of Taishi; posthumous title Duke Li.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died at forty-three in the tenth year of Taishi; his posthumous title was Duke Li.

sourceRange.text: 詔曰：「」十二月甲申，黃龍見華陰縣井中。

localRange.text: 詔曰：「古之王者，或有所不臣，王將宜依此義。又當為報。夫後大宗者，降其私親，況所繼者重邪！若便同之臣妾，亦情所未安。其皆依禮典處，當務盡其宜。有司奏，以為「禮莫崇於尊祖，制莫大於正典。陛下稽德期運，撫臨萬國，紹大宗之重，隆三祖之基。伏惟燕王體尊戚屬，正位藩服，躬秉虔肅，率蹈恭德以先萬國；其於正典，闡濟大順，所不得制。聖朝誠宜崇以非常之制，奉以不臣之禮。臣等平議以為燕王章表，可聽如舊式。中詔所施，或存好問，準之義類，則『燕覿之敬』也，可少順聖敬，加崇儀稱，示不敢斥，宜曰『皇帝敬問大王侍御』。至於制書，國之正典，朝廷所以辨章公制，宣昭軌儀於天下者也，宜循法，故曰『制詔燕王』。凡詔命、制書、奏事、上書諸稱燕王者，可皆上平。其非宗廟助祭之事，皆不得稱王名，奏事、上書、文書及吏民皆不得觸王諱，以彰殊禮，加于羣后。上遵王典尊祖之制，俯順聖敬烝烝之心，二者不愆，禮實宜之，可普告施行。十二月甲申，黃龍見華陰縣井中。

sourceRange.text: 八月，詔曰：「」《魏氏春秋》曰：脩字孝先，素有業行，著名西州。

localRange.text: 八月，詔曰：「故中郎西平郭脩，砥節厲行，秉心不回。乃者蜀將姜維寇鈔脩郡，為所執略。往歲偽大將軍費禕驅率羣衆，陰圖闚𨵦，道經漢壽，請會衆賔，脩於廣坐之中手刃擊禕，勇過聶政，功逾介子，可謂殺身成仁，釋生取義者矣。夫追加襃寵，所以表揚忠義；祚及後胤，所以獎勸將來。其追封脩為長樂鄉侯，食邑千戶，謚曰威侯；子襲爵，加拜奉車都尉；賜銀千鉼，絹千匹，以光寵存亡，永垂來世焉。〈《魏氏春秋》曰：脩字孝先，素有業行，著名西州。

context.beforeSource: 朝廷嘉之，加雜號將軍，封列侯，又遷安豐太守。
context.afterSource: 姜維劫之，脩不為屈。

sourceRange.text: 秋七月，尚書何晏奏曰：「」冬十二月，散騎常侍諫議大夫孔晏乂奏曰：「禮，天子之宮，有斲礱之制，無朱丹之飾，宜循禮復古。

localRange.text: 秋七月，尚書何晏奏曰：「善為國者必先治其身，治其身者慎其所習。所習正則其身正，其身正則不令而行；所習不正則其身不正，其身不正則雖令不從。是故為人君者，所與游必擇正人，所觀覽必察正象，放鄭聲而弗聽，遠佞人而弗近，然後邪心不生而正道可弘也。季末闇主不知損益，斥遠君子，引近小人，忠良疏遠，便辟褻狎，亂生近暱，譬之社鼠；考其昏明，所積以然，故聖賢諄諄以為至慮。舜戒禹曰『鄰哉鄰哉』，言慎所近也，周公戒成王曰『其朋其朋』，言慎所與也。可自今以後，御幸式乾殿及游豫後園，皆大臣侍從，因從容戲宴，兼省文書，詢謀政事，講論經義，為萬世法。冬十二月，散騎常侍諫議大夫孔晏乂奏曰：「禮，天子之宮，有斲礱之制，無朱丹之飾，宜循禮復古。

sourceRange.text: 四年春正月，黃龍二，見寧陵縣界井中。《漢晉春秋》曰：是時龍仍見，咸以為吉祥。帝曰：「龍者，君德也。上不在天，下不在田，而數屈於井，非嘉兆也。」仍作潛龍之詩以自諷，司馬文王見而惡之。夏六月，司空王昶薨。秋七月，陳留王峻薨。冬十月丙寅，分新城郡，復置上庸郡。十一月癸卯，車騎將軍孫壹為婢所殺。

context.beforeSource: 是歲，青龍、黃龍仍見頓丘、冠軍、陽夏縣界井中。
context.afterSource: 五年春正月朔，日有蝕之。

manualTranslations.zh: 四年春正月，黃龍二，見寧陵縣界井中。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth year, spring, the first month, two yellow dragons were seen in a well within Ningling county's borders.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first month of the fourth year two yellow dragons were reported in a village well on the border of Ningling county.

manualTranslations.zh: 《漢晉春秋》曰：是時龍仍見，咸以為吉祥。
manualTranslations.literal: 〈The Han–Jin Annals states: At this time dragons continued to appear, and all took it as an auspicious sign.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: 〈The Han–Jin Annals records that dragons kept appearing and the court took each sighting for a lucky omen.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝曰：「龍者，君德也。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor said: "The dragon embodies a ruler's virtue.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor said: "The dragon embodies a ruler's virtue.

manualTranslations.zh: 上不在天，下不在田，而數屈於井，非嘉兆也。」
manualTranslations.literal: It is not above in Heaven, not below in the fields, yet repeatedly confined to wells—this is no lucky omen."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: It belongs neither in Heaven above nor in the fields below, yet keeps appearing trapped in wells—that is no lucky sign."

manualTranslations.zh: 仍作潛龍之詩以自諷，司馬文王見而惡之。
manualTranslations.literal: He thereupon composed the Hidden Dragon poem as self-admonition; Grand General Sima Zhao saw it and hated it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He then wrote the Hidden Dragon poem as a veiled warning, and Sima Zhao took offense when he read it.

manualTranslations.zh: 夏六月，司空王昶薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In summer, the sixth month, Minister of Works Wang Chang died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wang Chang, Minister of Works, died in the sixth month.

manualTranslations.zh: 秋七月，陳留王峻薨。
manualTranslations.literal: In autumn, the seventh month, the Prince of Chenliu, Jun, died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the seventh month Cao Jun, Prince of Chenliu, died.

manualTranslations.zh: 冬十月丙寅，分新城郡，復置上庸郡。
manualTranslations.literal: On bingyin in the tenth month, Xincheng commandery was divided and Shangyong commandery was re-established.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On bingyin the court split Xincheng commandery and restored Shangyong commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 十一月癸卯，車騎將軍孫壹為婢所殺。
manualTranslations.literal: On guimao in the eleventh month, General of Chariots and Cavalry Sun Yi was killed by a maidservant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On guimao General of Chariots and Cavalry Sun Yi was murdered by a maidservant.

sourceRange.text: 咸熙元年春正月壬戌，檻車徵鄧艾。甲子，行幸長安。壬申，使使者以璧幣祀華山。是月，鍾會反於蜀，為衆所討；鄧艾亦見殺。二月辛卯，特赦諸在益土者。庚申，葬明元郭后。三月丁丑，以司空王祥為太尉，征北將軍何曾為司徒，尚書左僕射荀顗為司空。己卯，進晉公爵為王，封十郡，并前二十。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jiazi the imperial progress reached Chang'an.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: On renshen envoys were sent to offer jade disks and silks in sacrifice at Mount Hua.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: On xinmao the court granted a special amnesty to everyone in the former Shu territories.

manualTranslations.idiomatic: On gengshen Empress Guo Mingyuan was buried.

localRange.text: 詔曰：「昔三祖神武聖德，應天受祚。齊王嗣位，肆行非度，顛覆厥德。皇太后深惟社稷之重，延納宰輔之謀，用替厥位，集大命于余一人。以眇眇之身，託于王公之上，夙夜祗畏，懼不能嗣守祖宗之大訓，恢中興之弘業，戰戰兢兢，如臨于谷。今羣公卿士股肱之輔，四方征鎮宣力之佐，皆積德累功，忠勤帝室；庶憑先祖先父有德之臣，左右小子，用保乂皇家，俾朕蒙闇，垂拱而治。蓋聞人君之道，德厚侔天地，潤澤施四海，先之以慈愛，示之以好惡，然後教化行於上，兆民聽於下。朕雖不德，昧於大道，思與宇內共臻茲路。大赦，改元。

sourceRange.text: 癸巳，詔曰：「」癸卯，以衞將軍司馬望為驃騎將軍。

localRange.text: 癸巳，詔曰：「前逆臣鍾會構造反亂，聚集征行將士，劫以兵威，始吐姦謀，發言桀逆，逼脅衆人，皆使下議，倉卒之際，莫不驚懾。相國左司馬夏侯和、騎士曹屬朱撫時使在成都，中領軍司馬賈輔、郎中羊琇各參會軍事；和、琇、撫皆抗節不撓，拒會凶言，臨危不顧，詞指正烈。輔語散將王起，說『會姦逆凶暴，欲盡殺將士』，又云『相國已率三十萬衆西行討會』，欲以稱張形勢，感激衆心。起出，以輔言宣語諸軍，遂使將士益懷奮勵。宜加顯寵，以彰忠義。其進和、輔爵為鄉侯，琇、撫爵關內侯。起宣傳輔言，告令將士，所宜賞異。其以起為部曲將。癸卯，以衞將軍司馬望為驃騎將軍。

context.beforeSource: 八月庚寅，命中撫軍司馬炎副貳相國事，以同魯公拜後之義。
context.afterSource: 九月戊午，以中撫軍司馬炎為撫軍大將軍。

localRange.text: 辛未，詔曰：「吳賊政刑暴虐，賦斂無極。孫休遣使鄧句，勑交阯太守鎖送其民，發以為兵。吳將呂興因民心憤怒，又承王師平定巴蜀，即糾合豪傑，誅除句等，驅逐太守長吏，撫和吏民，以待國命。九真、日南郡聞興去逆即順，亦齊心響應，與興恊同。興移書日南州郡，開示大計，兵臨合浦，告以禍福；遣都尉唐譜等詣進乘縣，因南中都督護軍霍弋上表自陳。又交阯將吏各上表，言『興創造事業，大小承命。郡有山寇，入連諸郡，懼其計異，各有攜貳。權時之宜，以興為督交阯諸軍事、上大將軍、定安縣侯，乞賜褒獎，以慰邊荒』。乃心欵誠，形於辭旨。昔儀父朝魯，春秋所美；竇融歸漢，待以殊禮。今國威遠震，撫懷六合，方包舉殊裔，混一四表。興首向王化，舉衆稽服，萬里馳義，請吏帥職，宜加寵遇，崇其爵位。旣使興等懷忠感恱，遠人聞之，必皆競勸。其以興為使持節、都督交州諸軍事、南中大將軍，封定安縣侯，得以便宜從事，先行後上。策命未至，興為下人所殺。冬十月丁亥，詔曰：「昔聖帝明王，靜亂濟世，保大定功，文武殊塗，勳烈同歸。是故或舞干戚以訓不庭，或陳師旅以威暴慢。至於愛民全國，康惠庶類，必先脩文教，示之軌儀，不得已然後用兵，此盛德之所同也。往者季漢分崩，九土顛覆，劉備、孫權乘間作禍。三祖綏寧中夏，日不暇給，遂使遺寇僭逆歷世。幸賴宗廟威靈，宰輔忠武，爰發四方，拓定庸、蜀，役不浹時，一征而克。自頃江表衰弊，政刑荒闇，巴、漢平定，孤危無援，交、荊、揚、越靡然向風。今交阯偽將呂興已帥三郡，萬里歸命；武陵邑侯相嚴等糾合五縣，請為臣妾；豫章廬陵山民舉衆叛吳，以助北將軍為號。又孫休病死，主帥改易，國內乖違，人各有心。偽將施績，賊之名臣，懷疑自猜，深見忌惡。衆叛親離，莫有固志，自古及今，未有亡徵若此之甚。若六軍震曜，南臨江、漢，吳會之域必扶老攜幼以迎王師，必然之理也。然興動大衆，猶有勞費，宜告喻威德，開示仁信，使知順附和同之利。相國參軍事徐紹、水曹掾孫彧，昔在壽春，並見虜獲。紹本偽南陵督，才質開壯；彧，孫權支屬，忠良見事。其遣紹南還，以彧為副，宣揚國命，告喻吳人，諸所示語，皆以事實，若其覺悟，不損征伐之計，蓋廟勝長筭，自古之道也。其以紹兼散騎常侍，加奉車都尉，封都亭侯；彧兼給事黃門侍郎，賜爵關內侯。紹等所賜妾及男女家人在此者，悉聽自隨，以明國恩，不必使還，以開廣大信。丙午，命撫軍大將軍新昌鄉侯炎為晉世子。

sourceRange.text: 嘉平元年249年春正月甲午，車駕謁高平陵。孫盛《魏世籍》曰：高平陵在洛水南大石山，去洛城九十里。太傅司馬宣王奏免大將軍曹爽、爽弟中領軍羲、武衞將軍訓、散騎常侍彥官，以侯就第。戊戌，有司奏収黃門張當付廷尉，考實其辭，爽與謀不軌。又尚書丁謐、鄧颺、何晏、司隷校尉畢軌、荊州刺史李勝、大司農桓範皆與爽通姦謀，夷三族。語在《爽傳》。丙午，大赦。丁未，以太傅司馬宣王為丞相，固讓乃止。孔衍《漢魏春秋》曰：詔使太常王肅冊命太傅為丞相，增邑萬戶，羣臣奏事不得稱名，如漢霍光故事。太傅上書辭讓曰：「臣親受顧命，憂深責重，憑賴天威，摧弊姦凶，贖罪為幸，功不足論。又三公之官，聖王所制，著之典禮。至於丞相，始自秦政。漢氏因之，無復變改。今三公之官皆備，橫復寵臣，違越先典，革聖明之經，襲秦漢之路，雖在異人，臣所宜正，況當臣身而不固爭，四方議者將謂臣何！」書十餘上，詔乃許之，復加九錫之禮。太傅又言：「太祖有大功大德，漢氏崇重，故加九錫，此乃歷代異事，非後代之君臣所得議也。」又辭不受。

manualTranslations.zh: 嘉平元年249年春正月甲午，車駕謁高平陵。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Jiaping, 249, spring, the first month, on jiawu, the imperial carriage had audience at Gaoping Mausoleum.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jiawu in the first month of Jiaping 1 (249) the emperor went to sacrifice at the Gaoping tombs.

manualTranslations.zh: 孫盛《魏世籍》曰：高平陵在洛水南大石山，去洛城九十里。
manualTranslations.literal: 〈Sun Sheng's Register of Wei Generations states: Gaoping Mausoleum is on Great Stone Mountain south of the Luo River, ninety li from Luoyang.〉
manualTranslations.idiomatic: 〈Sun Sheng's Register of Wei Generations places Gaoping Mausoleum on Great Stone Mountain south of the Luo, ninety li from the capital.〉

manualTranslations.zh: 太傅司馬宣王奏免大將軍曹爽、爽弟中領軍羲、武衞將軍訓、散騎常侍彥官，以侯就第。
manualTranslations.literal: Grand Tutor Sima Yi (King Xuan) memorialized to dismiss Grand General Cao Shuang, Shuang's younger brothers Commander of the Central Army Xi, General of Martial Guards Xun, and Attendant at Large Yan from office, and sent them to their fiefs as marquises.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Grand Tutor Sima Yi (King Xuan) stripped Cao Shuang, his brother Xi as commander of the central army, Xun as general of martial guards, and Yan as attendant at large of their posts and sent them home as marquises.

manualTranslations.zh: 戊戌，有司奏収黃門張當付廷尉，考實其辭，爽與謀不軌。
manualTranslations.literal: On wuxu the bureaus memorialized to arrest Yellow Gate Zhang Dang and deliver him to the Minister of Justice to verify his testimony—that Shuang had plotted treason.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On wuxu the court had eunuch director Zhang Dang seized and interrogated by the Minister of Justice, confirming Cao Shuang's conspiracy.

manualTranslations.zh: 又尚書丁謐、鄧颺、何晏、司隷校尉畢軌、荊州刺史李勝、大司農桓範皆與爽通姦謀，夷三族。
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover, Masters of Writing Ding Mi, Deng Yang, and He Yan, Metropolitan Commandant Bi Gui, Inspector of Jing Province Li Sheng, and Minister of the Imperial Clan Huan Fan all had secret dealings with Shuang in plotting; their three kindreds were exterminated.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ding Mi, Deng Yang, He Yan, Bi Gui, Li Sheng, and Huan Fan were also found complicit with Shuang and their clans were wiped out to the third degree.

manualTranslations.zh: 語在《爽傳》。
manualTranslations.literal: The account is in the Biography of Shuang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The full story appears in Cao Shuang's biography.

manualTranslations.zh: 丙午，大赦。
manualTranslations.literal: On bingwu there was a general amnesty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On bingwu the court proclaimed a general amnesty.

manualTranslations.zh: 丁未，以太傅司馬宣王為丞相，固讓乃止。
manualTranslations.literal: On dingwei Grand Tutor Sima Yi (King Xuan) was made Chancellor; he firmly declined and the appointment was halted.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On dingwei Sima Yi was offered the chancellorship, but his repeated refusals led the court to withdraw the offer.

manualTranslations.zh: 孔衍《漢魏春秋》曰：詔使太常王肅冊命太傅為丞相，增邑萬戶，羣臣奏事不得稱名，如漢霍光故事。
manualTranslations.literal: 〈Kong Yan's Annals of Han and Wei states: An edict ordered Minister of Ceremonies Wang Su to invest the Grand Tutor as Chancellor, increase his fief by ten thousand households, and forbid ministers memorializing to use his personal name, following the precedent of Huo Guang of Han.〉
manualTranslations.idiomatic: 〈Kong Yan's Han–Wei Annals records an edict commissioning Wang Su to enfeoff Sima Yi as chancellor with ten thousand added households and full Huo Guang–style court privileges, including the right to be addressed without personal name.〉

manualTranslations.zh: 太傅上書辭讓曰：「臣親受顧命，憂深責重，憑賴天威，摧弊姦凶，贖罪為幸，功不足論。
manualTranslations.literal: The Grand Tutor submitted a memorial declining: "Your servant personally received the dying charge; my worry is deep and my responsibility heavy. Relying on Heaven's majesty, I overthrew corrupt traitors—escaping punishment is already fortune enough; merit is not worth discussing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sima Yi memorialized his refusal: "I received the late emperor's charge in person, and the burden weighs on me heavily. By Heaven's grace I crushed treason—merely to escape punishment is already more than I deserve, let alone merit.

manualTranslations.zh: 又三公之官，聖王所制，著之典禮。
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover, the Three Excellencies are offices the sage kings instituted and fixed in canonical ritual.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Three Excellencies were ordained by the sages and fixed in ritual law.

manualTranslations.zh: 至於丞相，始自秦政。
manualTranslations.literal: As for the Chancellor, that began with the Qin ruler.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The chancellorship began only under the Qin ruler.

manualTranslations.zh: 漢氏因之，無復變改。
manualTranslations.literal: Han inherited it without further change.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Han carried the office on without altering it.

manualTranslations.zh: 今三公之官皆備，橫復寵臣，違越先典，革聖明之經，襲秦漢之路，雖在異人，臣所宜正，況當臣身而不固爭，四方議者將謂臣何！」
manualTranslations.literal: Now all Three Excellencies are in place; to again favor a minister violates the former canon, alters the sage's bright standard, and follows the Qin–Han path. Even if another held the post, your servant ought to correct it—how much more when it is your servant himself, and I do not firmly contend: what will commentators in the four quarters say of me!"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: All three posts are now filled; to heap new honors on one minister overturns precedent and revives Qin ways. If another man were offered this, I would protest—how can I accept it myself and leave the realm to wonder what I am about?"

manualTranslations.zh: 書十餘上，詔乃許之，復加九錫之禮。
manualTranslations.literal: After more than ten memorials, the edict finally granted his request, and again added the rites of the nine bestowals.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After more than ten refusals the court accepted his declination but renewed the offer of the nine insignia.

manualTranslations.zh: 太傅又言：「太祖有大功大德，漢氏崇重，故加九錫，此乃歷代異事，非後代之君臣所得議也。」
manualTranslations.literal: The Grand Tutor again said: "Grand Progenitor had great merit and great virtue; Han honored him heavily, and therefore added the nine bestowals—this is an exceptional matter of successive ages, not something later generations of ruler and minister may discuss."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sima Yi protested again: "Grand Progenitor alone earned the nine insignia because Han itself exalted him—it was a once-in-an-age exception, not a precedent later courts should invoke."

manualTranslations.zh: 又辭不受。
manualTranslations.literal: Again he declined and did not accept.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He refused once more and the honors were not conferred.

sourceRange.text: 丙寅，詔曰：「」車駕親率羣司，躬行古禮焉。

localRange.text: 丙寅，詔曰：「夫養老興教，三代所以樹風化垂不朽也，必有三老、五更以崇至敬，乞言納誨，著在惇史，然後六合承流，下觀而化。宜妙簡德行，以充其選。關內侯王祥，履仁秉義，雅志淳固。關內侯鄭小同，溫恭孝友，帥禮不忒。其以祥為三老，小同為五更。車駕親率羣司，躬行古禮焉。

sourceRange.text: 五月，詔曰：「相國晉王誕敷神慮，光被四海；震燿武功，則威蓋殊荒，流風邁化，則旁洽無外。愍卹江表，務存濟育，戢武崇仁，示以威德。文告所加，承風嚮慕，遣使納獻，以明委順，方寶纖珍，歡以效意。而王謙讓之至，一皆簿送，非所以慰副初附，從其款願也。孫皓諸所獻致，其皆還送，歸之于王，以恊古義。」王固辭乃止。又命晉王冕十有二旒，建天子旌旗，出警入蹕，乘金根車、六馬，備五時副車，置旄頭雲䍐，樂舞八佾，設鍾虡宮縣。進王妃為王后，世子為太子，王子、王女、王孫，爵命之號如舊儀。癸未，大赦。秋八月辛卯，相國晉王薨。壬辰，晉太子炎紹封襲位，總攝百揆，備物典冊，一皆如前。是月，襄武縣言有大人見，長三丈餘，迹長三尺二寸，白髮，著黃單衣，黃巾，柱杖，呼民王始語云：「今當太平。」九月乙未，大赦。戊午，司徒何曾為晉丞相。癸亥，以驃騎將軍司馬望為司徒，征東大將軍石苞為驃騎將軍，征南大將軍陳騫為車騎將軍。乙亥，葬晉文王。閏月庚辰，康居、大宛獻名馬，歸于相國府，以顯懷萬國致遠之勳。十二月壬戌，天祿永終，歷數在晉。詔羣公卿士具儀設壇于南郊，使使者奉皇帝璽綬冊，禪位于晉嗣王，如漢魏故事。甲子，使使者奉策。遂改次于金墉城，而終館于鄴，時年二十。《魏世譜》曰：封帝為陳留王。年五十八，太安元年302年崩，謚曰元皇帝。

manualTranslations.literal: On wuwu, Minister of Education He Zeng became Chancellor of Jin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On wuwu Minister of Education He Zeng became Chancellor of Jin.

manualTranslations.zh: 癸亥，以驃騎將軍司馬望為司徒，征東大將軍石苞為驃騎將軍，征南大將軍陳騫為車騎將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: On guihai, General of Agile Cavalry Sima Wang was made Minister of Education, Grand General Who Conquers the East Shi Bao was made General of Agile Cavalry, and Grand General Who Conquers the South Chen Qian was made General of Chariots and Cavalry.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On guihai Sima Wang became Minister of Education, Shi Bao General of Agile Cavalry, and Chen Qian General of Chariots and Cavalry.

manualTranslations.zh: 乙亥，葬晉文王。
manualTranslations.literal: On yihai, King Wen of Jin was buried.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On yihai King Wen of Jin, Sima Zhao, was buried.

manualTranslations.zh: 閏月庚辰，康居、大宛獻名馬，歸于相國府，以顯懷萬國致遠之勳。
manualTranslations.literal: In the intercalary month, on gengchen, Kangju and Dayuan presented famous horses, sent to the chancellor's palace to display the merit of cherishing the myriad states and reaching the distant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the intercalary month, on gengchen, Kangju and Dayuan presented famous horses to the chancellor's palace, displaying the merit of cherishing the myriad states and reaching the distant.

manualTranslations.zh: 十二月壬戌，天祿永終，歷數在晉。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth month, on renxu, Heaven's mandate ended forever and the succession lay with Jin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the twelfth month, on renxu, Heaven's mandate for Wei ended forever and the succession passed to Jin.

manualTranslations.zh: 詔羣公卿士具儀設壇于南郊，使使者奉皇帝璽綬冊，禪位于晉嗣王，如漢魏故事。
manualTranslations.literal: An edict ordered the assembled dukes, ministers, and grandees to prepare ritual and set up the altar at the southern suburban field; envoys were sent bearing the imperial seal-cord and patent scroll to abdicate the throne to the heir king of Jin, following the precedent of Han and Wei.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: An edict ordered the assembled nobles and ministers to prepare ritual and set up the altar at the southern suburb; envoys were sent bearing the imperial seal, cord, and patent scroll to abdicate to the heir king of Jin, following the Han and Wei precedent.

manualTranslations.zh: 甲子，使使者奉策。
manualTranslations.literal: On jiazi, envoys were sent bearing the written mandate.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jiazi envoys were sent bearing the written mandate.

manualTranslations.zh: 遂改次于金墉城，而終館于鄴，時年二十。
manualTranslations.literal: Thereupon he changed lodging to Jincheng fortress and at last took residence at Ye; he was then twenty years old.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Thereupon Cao Huan moved to Jincheng fortress and at last took residence at Ye; he was then twenty years old.

manualTranslations.zh: 《魏世譜》曰：封帝為陳留王。
manualTranslations.literal: The Wei Genealogy states: The emperor was enfeoffed as King of Chenliu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Wei Genealogy states: The emperor was enfeoffed as King of Chenliu.

manualTranslations.zh: 年五十八，太安元年302年崩，謚曰元皇帝。
manualTranslations.literal: Age fifty-eight; he died in the first year of Taian, 302, and his posthumous title was Emperor Yuan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died at fifty-eight in Taian 1 (302) and received the posthumous title Emperor Yuan.

sourceRange.text: 夏五月，詔曰：「」又命鎮西將軍鍾會由駱谷伐蜀。

localRange.text: 夏五月，詔曰：「蜀，蕞爾小國，土狹民寡，而姜維虐用其衆，曾無廢志；往歲破敗之後，猶復耕種沓中，刻剥衆羌，勞役無已，民不堪命。夫兼弱攻昧，武之善經，致人而不至於人，兵家之上略。蜀所恃賴，唯維而已，因其遠離巢窟，用力為易。今使征西將軍鄧艾督帥諸軍，趣甘松、沓中以羅取維，雍州刺史諸葛緒督諸軍趣武都、高樓，首尾踧討。若禽維，便當東西並進，掃滅巴蜀也。又命鎮西將軍鍾會由駱谷伐蜀。

sourceRange.text: 二年春正月乙丑，鎮東將軍毌丘儉、楊州刺史文欽反。戊，大將軍司馬景王征之。癸未，車騎將軍郭淮薨。閏月己亥，破欽於樂嘉。欽遁走，遂奔吳。甲辰，安風都尉斬儉，傳首京都。《世語》曰：大將軍奉天子征儉，至項；儉旣破，天子先還。臣松之檢諸書都無此事，至諸葛誕反，司馬文王始挾太后及帝與俱行耳。故發詔引漢二祖及明帝親征以為前比，知明帝已後始有此行也。案張璠、虞溥、郭頒皆晉之令史，璠、頒出為官長，溥，鄱陽內史。璠撰《後漢紀》，雖似未成，辭藻可觀。溥著《江表傳》，亦粗有條貫。惟頒撰魏晉《世語》，蹇乏全無宮商，最為鄙劣，以時有異事，故頗行於世。干寶、孫盛等多采其言以為《晉書》，其中虛錯如此者，往往而有之。壬子，復特赦淮南士民諸為儉、欽所詿誤者。以鎮南將軍諸葛誕為鎮東大將軍。司馬景王薨于許昌。二月丁巳，以衞將軍司馬文王為大將軍，錄尚書事。

context.beforeSource: 甲辰，命有司論廢立定策之功，封爵、增邑、進位、班賜各有差。

manualTranslations.zh: 閏月己亥，破欽於樂嘉。

manualTranslations.zh: 欽遁走，遂奔吳。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wen Qin fled the field and escaped to Wu.

manualTranslations.zh: 甲辰，安風都尉斬儉，傳首京都。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: On jiachen the commandant of Anfeng executed Guanqiu Jian and forwarded his head to Luoyang.

manualTranslations.zh: 《世語》曰：大將軍奉天子征儉，至項；
manualTranslations.literal: 〈The Shiyu states: The Grand General, escorting the Son of Heaven, campaigned against Jian and reached Xiang;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: 〈The Shiyu claims Sima Shi led the emperor in person against Guanqiu Jian as far as Xiang;

manualTranslations.zh: 儉旣破，天子先還。
manualTranslations.literal: once Jian was broken, the Son of Heaven returned first.〉
manualTranslations.idiomatic: and once Jian was defeated, sent the emperor home ahead of the army.〉

manualTranslations.zh: 臣松之檢諸書都無此事，至諸葛誕反，司馬文王始挾太后及帝與俱行耳。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: 〈Pei Songzhi finds no other source for this story; emperors did not take the field again until Zhuge Dan's rebellion, when Sima Zhao first marched with the empress dowager and emperor in train.〉

manualTranslations.zh: 故發詔引漢二祖及明帝親征以為前比，知明帝已後始有此行也。
manualTranslations.literal: 〈Therefore edicts cite the Han two ancestors and Emperor Ming's personal campaigns as earlier parallels, showing that only after Emperor Ming did such travel begin.〉
manualTranslations.idiomatic: 〈Later edicts cite the Han founders and Emperor Ming's own campaigns as precedent precisely because personal imperial expeditions did not resume until after Ming's reign.〉

manualTranslations.zh: 案張璠、虞溥、郭頒皆晉之令史，璠、頒出為官長，溥，鄱陽內史。
manualTranslations.literal: 〈Examining the case: Zhang Fan, Yu Pu, and Guo Song were all Jin record clerks; Fan and Song later went out as chief officials, and Pu became Administrator of Poyang.〉
manualTranslations.idiomatic: 〈Zhang Fan, Yu Pu, and Guo Song were all clerks in Jin service—Fan and Song later became local governors, and Pu served as administrator of Poyang.〉

manualTranslations.zh: 璠撰《後漢紀》，雖似未成，辭藻可觀。
manualTranslations.literal: 〈Fan compiled the Annals of Later Han; though it seems unfinished, its literary polish is worth seeing.〉
manualTranslations.idiomatic: 〈Fan's Annals of Later Han, though apparently incomplete, is elegantly written.〉

manualTranslations.zh: 溥著《江表傳》，亦粗有條貫。
manualTranslations.literal: 〈Pu authored the Jiangbiao zhuan; it too has a rough order and coherence.〉
manualTranslations.idiomatic: 〈Pu's Jiangbiao zhuan, though rough, is at least organized.〉

manualTranslations.zh: 惟頒撰魏晉《世語》，蹇乏全無宮商，最為鄙劣，以時有異事，故頗行於世。
manualTranslations.literal: 〈Only Song compiled the Wei–Jin Shiyu: deficient and altogether without measure, the most base and inferior; because it contains unusual affairs of the time, it nevertheless circulates widely in the world.〉
manualTranslations.idiomatic: 〈Only Song's Wei–Jin Shiyu is truly wretched—artless and crude—yet because it preserves sensational anecdotes it remains widely read.〉

manualTranslations.zh: 干寶、孫盛等多采其言以為《晉書》，其中虛錯如此者，往往而有之。
manualTranslations.literal: 〈Gan Bao, Sun Sheng, and others often adopted its words for their Jin histories; errors and fabrications such as this are frequently found among them.〉
manualTranslations.idiomatic: 〈Gan Bao, Sun Sheng, and others mined it heavily for their Jin histories, and false reports like this one appear all too often.〉

manualTranslations.zh: 壬子，復特赦淮南士民諸為儉、欽所詿誤者。
manualTranslations.literal: On renzi, a special amnesty was again granted to the officers and people of Huainan who had been misled by Jian and Qin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On renzi the court again pardoned Huainan subjects who had been duped into following Guanqiu Jian and Wen Qin.

manualTranslations.zh: 以鎮南將軍諸葛誕為鎮東大將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: General Who Guards the South Zhuge Dan was made Grand General Who Guards the East.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhuge Dan was promoted from general who guards the south to grand general who guards the east.

manualTranslations.zh: 司馬景王薨于許昌。
manualTranslations.literal: Sima Shi died at Xuchang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sima Shi died at Xuchang.

manualTranslations.zh: 二月丁巳，以衞將軍司馬文王為大將軍，錄尚書事。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second month, on dingsi, Sima Zhao advanced from general of the guard to grand general with control of the secretariat.

sourceRange.text: 」甘露元年256年春正月辛丑，青龍見軹縣井中。乙巳，沛王林薨。《魏氏春秋》曰：二月丙辰，帝宴羣臣於太極東堂，與侍中荀顗、尚書崔贊、袁亮、鍾毓、給事中中書令虞松等並講述禮典，遂言帝王優劣之差。帝慕夏少康，因問顗等曰：「有夏旣衰，后相殆滅，少康收集夏衆，復禹之績，高祖拔起隴畒，驅帥豪儁，芟夷秦、項，包舉宇內，斯二主可謂殊才異略，命世大賢者也。考其功德，誰宜為先？」顗等對曰：「夫天下重器，王者天授，聖德應期，然後能受命創業。至於階緣前緒，興復舊績，造之與因，難易不同。少康功德雖美，猶為中興之君，與世祖同流可也。至如高祖，臣等以為優。」帝曰：「自古帝王，功德言行互有高下，未必創業者皆優，紹繼者咸劣也。湯、武、高祖雖俱受命，賢聖之分，所覺縣殊。少康、殷宗中興之美，夏啟、周成守文之盛，論德較實，方諸漢祖，吾見其優，未聞其劣；顧所遇之時殊，故所名之功異耳。少康生於滅亡之後，降為諸侯之隷，崎嶇逃難，僅以身免，能布其德而兆其謀，卒滅過、戈，克復禹績，祀夏配天，不失舊物，非至德弘仁，豈濟斯勳？漢祖因土崩之勢，仗一時之權，專任智力以成功業，行事動靜多違聖檢；為人子則數危其親，為人君則囚繫賢相，為人父則不能衞子；身沒之後，社稷幾傾，若與少康易時而處，或未能復大禹之績也。推此言之，宜高夏康而下漢祖矣。諸卿具論詳之。」翌日丁巳，講業旣畢，顗、亮等議曰：「三代建國，列土而治，當其衰弊，無土崩之勢，可懷以德，難屈以力。逮至戰國，彊弱相兼，去道德而任智力。故秦之弊可以力爭。少康布德，仁者之英也；高祖任力，智者之儁也。仁智不同，二帝殊矣。詩、書述殷中宗、高宗，皆列大雅，少康功美過於二宗，其為大雅明矣。少康為優，宜如詔旨。」贊、毓、松等議曰：「少康雖積德累仁，然上承大禹遺澤餘慶，內有虞、仍之援，外有靡、艾之助，寒浞讒慝，不德于民，澆、豷無親，外內棄之，以此有國，蓋有所因。至於漢祖，起自布衣，率烏合之士，以成帝者之業。論德則少康優，課功則高祖多，語資則少康易，校時則高祖難。」帝曰：「諸卿論少康因資，高祖創造，誠有之矣，然未知三代之世，任德濟勳如彼之難，秦、項之際，任力成功如此之易。且太上立德，其次立功，漢祖功高，未若少康盛德之茂也。且夫仁者必有勇，誅暴必用武，少康武烈之威，豈必降於高祖哉？但夏書淪亡，舊文殘缺，故勳美闕而罔載，唯有伍員粗述大略，其言復禹之績，不失舊物，祖述聖業，舊章不行，自非大雅兼才，孰能與於此，向令墳、典具存，行事詳備，亦豈有異同之論哉？」於是羣臣咸恱服。中書令松進曰：「少康之事，去世乆遠，其文昧如，是以自古及今，議論之士莫有言者，德美隱而不宣。陛下旣垂心遠鑒，考詳古昔，又發德音，贊明少康之美，使顯於千載之上，宜錄以成篇，永垂于後。」帝曰：「吾學不博，所聞淺狹，懼於所論，未獲其宜；縱有可采，億則屢中，又不足貴，無乃致笑後賢，彰吾闇昧乎！」於是侍郎鍾會退論次焉。

manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Wei Annals of Spring and Autumn records that on bingchen in the second month Cao Mao feasted his ministers in the eastern hall of the Hall of Supreme Ultimate and, with Xun Yi, Cui Zan, Yuan Liang, Zhong Yu, and Yu Song among others, lectured on ritual and debated which rulers ranked higher.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝慕夏少康，因問顗等曰：「有夏旣衰，后相殆滅，少康收集夏衆，復禹之績，高祖拔起隴畒，驅帥豪儁，芟夷秦、項，包舉宇內，斯二主可謂殊才異略，命世大賢者也。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor admired Xia's Shao Kang, and therefore asked Yi and the others, saying: "When Xia had declined and Hou Xiang was nearly extinguished, Shao Kang gathered the Xia host and restored Yu's achievement; the High Ancestor rose from the fields, drove and led heroic men, cut down Qin and Xiang, and embraced all within the realm—these two lords may be called men of extraordinary talent, singular strategy, and worthies of the age.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Admiring Shao Kang of Xia, Cao Mao asked Xun Yi and the rest: "When Xia fell and Hou Xiang was nearly destroyed, Shao Kang rallied the Xia people and restored Yu's work; the High Ancestor rose from the plowlands, led heroes, swept away Qin and Xiang, and took all under Heaven—these two may be called singular talents and sages of their age.

manualTranslations.zh: 考其功德，誰宜為先？」
manualTranslations.literal: Considering their merit and virtue, who should come first?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Weighing their merit and virtue, who should rank first?"

manualTranslations.zh: 顗等對曰：「夫天下重器，王者天授，聖德應期，然後能受命創業。
manualTranslations.literal: Yi and the others replied: "The vessel of all under Heaven is weighty; the kingship is Heaven-bestowed—only when sage virtue meets the age can one receive the mandate and found a dynasty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xun Yi and the others answered: "The realm is a heavy trust and kingship is Heaven's gift—only when sage virtue meets the times can one receive the mandate and found a dynasty.

manualTranslations.zh: 至於階緣前緒，興復舊績，造之與因，難易不同。
manualTranslations.literal: As for ascending by the thread of an earlier cause, raising up and restoring an old achievement, founding anew and following on—the difficulty differs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: To build on a prior line and restore an old achievement differs from founding anew—the difficulty is not the same.

manualTranslations.zh: 少康功德雖美，猶為中興之君，與世祖同流可也。
manualTranslations.literal: Shao Kang's merit and virtue, though beautiful, still make him a lord of restoration; he may be classed with Emperor Guangwu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shao Kang's merit is splendid, yet he remains a restorer and may be grouped with Emperor Guangwu.

manualTranslations.zh: 至如高祖，臣等以為優。」
manualTranslations.literal: As for the High Ancestor, we your ministers hold him the superior."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As for the High Ancestor, we hold him the superior."

manualTranslations.zh: 帝曰：「自古帝王，功德言行互有高下，未必創業者皆優，紹繼者咸劣也。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor said: "From antiquity emperors and kings have differed in merit, virtue, word, and deed—those who found states are not necessarily all superior, nor those who succeeded all inferior.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Cao Mao said: "From antiquity rulers have differed in merit, virtue, word, and deed—founders are not always superior, nor successors always inferior.

manualTranslations.zh: 湯、武、高祖雖俱受命，賢聖之分，所覺縣殊。
manualTranslations.literal: Tang, Wu, and the High Ancestor all received the mandate alike, yet the gradations of worth and sagacity that one perceives are far apart.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tang, Wu, and the High Ancestor all received Heaven's mandate, yet the gradations of worth and sagacity one perceives are far apart.

manualTranslations.zh: 少康、殷宗中興之美，夏啟、周成守文之盛，論德較實，方諸漢祖，吾見其優，未聞其劣；
manualTranslations.literal: Shao Kang's and Yin Zong's beauty in restoration, Xia Qi's and Zhou Cheng's splendor in guarding the legacy—in comparing virtue by reality, set against Han's Ancestor, I see only their superiority and have not heard them inferior;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shao Kang and Yin Zong in restoration, Xia Qi and Zhou Cheng in preserving the legacy—measured against Han's Ancestor for real virtue, I see only their superiority, not their inferiority;

manualTranslations.zh: 顧所遇之時殊，故所名之功異耳。
manualTranslations.literal: Only the times they encountered differ, and therefore the achievements named are not the same.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: only the times differ, and so the achievements named differ as well.

manualTranslations.zh: 少康生於滅亡之後，降為諸侯之隷，崎嶇逃難，僅以身免，能布其德而兆其謀，卒滅過、戈，克復禹績，祀夏配天，不失舊物，非至德弘仁，豈濟斯勳？
manualTranslations.literal: Shao Kang was born after extinction, reduced to the servitude of a feudal lord, escaped hardship by treacherous paths and barely saved himself; he was able to spread his virtue and found his design, at last extinguishing Guo and Ge, recovering Yu's achievement, sacrificing to Xia and pairing with Heaven, and not losing what had been—without supreme virtue and broad benevolence, how could such merit be accomplished?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shao Kang was born after ruin, reduced to a vassal's thrall, fled through hardship and barely escaped with his life; he spread virtue, laid his plans, destroyed Guo and Ge, recovered Yu's achievement, sacrificed to Xia and paired with Heaven without losing the old patrimony—without supreme virtue and broad benevolence, how could such merit be achieved?

manualTranslations.zh: 漢祖因土崩之勢，仗一時之權，專任智力以成功業，行事動靜多違聖檢；
manualTranslations.literal: Han's Ancestor relied on the tendency of the earth's collapse, leaned on momentary authority, relied solely on wit and force to complete his enterprise, and in action and stillness often violated the sage's measure;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Han's Ancestor rode the collapse of the realm, leaned on momentary power, relied on wit and force alone, and in word and deed often violated the sage's measure;

manualTranslations.zh: 為人子則數危其親，為人君則囚繫賢相，為人父則不能衞子；
manualTranslations.literal: As a son he repeatedly endangered his parent, as a lord he imprisoned worthy chancellors, as a father he could not protect his son;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: as a son he repeatedly endangered his father, as a ruler he imprisoned worthy ministers, as a father he could not protect his son;

manualTranslations.zh: 身沒之後，社稷幾傾，若與少康易時而處，或未能復大禹之績也。
manualTranslations.literal: After his body's end the altars of soil and grain nearly toppled—if he had changed places with Shao Kang in time, he might not have recovered Great Yu's achievement.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: after his death the altars nearly fell; had he traded places with Shao Kang in time, he might not have recovered Great Yu's achievement.

manualTranslations.zh: 推此言之，宜高夏康而下漢祖矣。
manualTranslations.literal: Push this to speak: one should exalt Xia's Kang and set Han's Ancestor below.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On this reasoning one should exalt Shao Kang and rank Han's Ancestor below.

manualTranslations.zh: 諸卿具論詳之。」
manualTranslations.literal: You ministers, discuss it in full detail."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ministers, debate this thoroughly."

manualTranslations.zh: 翌日丁巳，講業旣畢，顗、亮等議曰：「三代建國，列土而治，當其衰弊，無土崩之勢，可懷以德，難屈以力。
manualTranslations.literal: Next day, dingsi, when the lecture was finished, Yi, Liang, and the others deliberated, saying: "The Three Dynasties founded states and governed by apportioned domains; when they declined there was no tendency of the earth's collapse—one could win them by cherishing virtue, but hardly force them by strength.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The next day, dingsi, when the lecture ended, Xun Yi, Yuan Liang, and the others argued: "The Three Dynasties founded states on apportioned domains; in decline there was no general collapse—one could win men by virtue, not easily by force.

manualTranslations.zh: 逮至戰國，彊弱相兼，去道德而任智力。
manualTranslations.literal: Reaching the Warring States, strong and weak mutually swallowed one another and cast off the Way to employ wit and force.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: By the Warring States strong and weak devoured one another and cast off the Way for wit and force.

manualTranslations.zh: 故秦之弊可以力爭。
manualTranslations.literal: Therefore Qin's weakness could be contested by force.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Thus Qin's weakness could be overcome by force.

manualTranslations.zh: 少康布德，仁者之英也；
manualTranslations.literal: Shao Kang spread virtue—he was a hero among the benevolent;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shao Kang spread virtue—he was a hero among the benevolent;

manualTranslations.zh: 高祖任力，智者之儁也。
manualTranslations.literal: The High Ancestor relied on force—he was an outstanding man among the wise.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: the High Ancestor relied on force—he was an outstanding man among the wise.

manualTranslations.zh: 仁智不同，二帝殊矣。
manualTranslations.literal: Benevolence and wisdom differ—the two emperors are distinct.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Benevolence and wisdom differ—the two emperors are distinct.

manualTranslations.zh: 詩、書述殷中宗、高宗，皆列大雅，少康功美過於二宗，其為大雅明矣。
manualTranslations.literal: The Poetry and Documents recount Yin Zhongzong and Gaozong, all placed in the Grand Odes; Shao Kang's beautiful achievement surpasses the two zongs—his place in the Grand Odes is clear.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Poetry and Documents place Yin Zhongzong and Gaozong in the Grand Odes; Shao Kang's achievement surpasses both—his place among the Grand Odes is clear.

manualTranslations.zh: 少康為優，宜如詔旨。」
manualTranslations.literal: Shao Kang is superior; it should be as the edict intends."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shao Kang is superior, as Your Majesty intended."

manualTranslations.zh: 贊、毓、松等議曰：「少康雖積德累仁，然上承大禹遺澤餘慶，內有虞、仍之援，外有靡、艾之助，寒浞讒慝，不德于民，澆、豷無親，外內棄之，以此有國，蓋有所因。
manualTranslations.literal: Zan, Yu, Song, and the others deliberated: "Though Shao Kang accumulated virtue and heaped up benevolence, he yet inherited the lingering bounty of Great Yu's bequeathed favor; within he had the aid of Yu and Sì, without the help of Mi and Ai; Han Zhu was treacherous and wicked, without virtue toward the people; Ao and Yi lacked kin—within and without abandoned them—thereby to possess a state, he surely had something to follow from.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Cui Zan, Zhong Yu, Yu Song, and the others argued: "Though Shao Kang heaped up virtue and benevolence, he inherited Great Yu's lingering favor; within he had Yu and Sì, without Mi and Ai; Han Zhu was wicked and unloved, Ao and Yi were friendless—men within and without abandoned them—so his possession of the state had something to build on.

manualTranslations.zh: 至於漢祖，起自布衣，率烏合之士，以成帝者之業。
manualTranslations.literal: As for Han's Ancestor, he rose from plain cloth, led a motley host, and thereby completed an emperor's enterprise.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Han's Ancestor rose from common cloth, led a motley host, and completed an emperor's enterprise.

manualTranslations.zh: 論德則少康優，課功則高祖多，語資則少康易，校時則高祖難。」
manualTranslations.literal: In discussing virtue Shao Kang is superior; in reckoning achievement the High Ancestor has more; in speaking of resources Shao Kang had the easier part, in comparing times the High Ancestor had the harder."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In virtue Shao Kang is superior; in achievement the High Ancestor has more; in resources Shao Kang had the easier case, in times the High Ancestor had the harder."

manualTranslations.zh: 帝曰：「諸卿論少康因資，高祖創造，誠有之矣，然未知三代之世，任德濟勳如彼之難，秦、項之際，任力成功如此之易。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor said: "Your discussion that Shao Kang had resources to follow from and the High Ancestor created anew is indeed so, yet you do not know how hard it was in the age of the Three Dynasties to employ virtue to achieve merit, and how easy it was between Qin and Xiang to rely on force for success.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Cao Mao said: "Your point that Shao Kang had resources to follow and the High Ancestor created anew is fair, yet you do not know how hard it was in the Three Dynasties to achieve merit through virtue, or how easy it was between Qin and Xiang to succeed through force.

manualTranslations.zh: 且太上立德，其次立功，漢祖功高，未若少康盛德之茂也。
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover the highest is to establish virtue, next is to establish achievement—Han's Ancestor's achievement is high, but not like Shao Kang's lush excellence in virtue.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The highest is to establish virtue, next achievement—Han's Ancestor's achievement is high, but not like Shao Kang's lush virtue.

manualTranslations.zh: 且夫仁者必有勇，誅暴必用武，少康武烈之威，豈必降於高祖哉？
manualTranslations.literal: And the benevolent must have courage; punishing violence must use arms—could Shao Kang's martial blaze and authority necessarily rank below the High Ancestor's?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The benevolent must have courage, and punishing violence requires arms—must Shao Kang's martial blaze necessarily rank below the High Ancestor's?

manualTranslations.zh: 但夏書淪亡，舊文殘缺，故勳美闕而罔載，唯有伍員粗述大略，其言復禹之績，不失舊物，祖述聖業，舊章不行，自非大雅兼才，孰能與於此，向令墳、典具存，行事詳備，亦豈有異同之論哉？」
manualTranslations.literal: Only the Xia Documents have perished and old text survives broken, so merit and beauty are missing and untransmitted—only Wu Yuan roughly recounted the main design; his words restore Yu's achievement, not losing the old possessions, following the sage's enterprise; old statutes are not carried out—unless one unites the breadth of the Grand Odes with comprehensive talent, who could join in this? If the canons of tomb and archive had been complete and actions fully recorded, how could there have been debate with different conclusions?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: But the Xia Documents are lost and old text broken, so merit and beauty go unrecorded—only Wu Yuan roughly sketched the design, saying Shao Kang restored Yu's achievement without losing the old patrimony and followed the sage's enterprise while old statutes lapsed. Unless one combined the breadth of the Grand Odes with comprehensive talent, who could match this? Had the tomb canons and archives survived intact, how could there be differing debate?"

manualTranslations.zh: 於是羣臣咸恱服。
manualTranslations.literal: Thereupon the assembled ministers were all pleased and submitted.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Thereupon the assembled ministers were all pleased and submitted.

manualTranslations.zh: 中書令松進曰：「少康之事，去世乆遠，其文昧如，是以自古及今，議論之士莫有言者，德美隱而不宣。
manualTranslations.literal: Director of the Masters of Writing Song advanced and said: "Shao Kang's affairs are far removed in time and their text is dim—therefore from antiquity to now debaters have had none to speak of him; virtue and beauty lie hidden and are not proclaimed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Director Yu Song advanced and said: "Shao Kang's affairs are remote in time and the texts dim—so from antiquity to now debaters have scarcely spoken of him; virtue and beauty lie hidden and unproclaimed.

manualTranslations.zh: 陛下旣垂心遠鑒，考詳古昔，又發德音，贊明少康之美，使顯於千載之上，宜錄以成篇，永垂于後。」
manualTranslations.literal: Your Majesty has already bent your mind to far-reaching scrutiny, examined antiquity in detail, and moreover issued virtuous words, praising and clarifying Shao Kang's beauty, making him shine above a thousand years—it is fitting to record this into a completed piece and leave it forever for posterity."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Your Majesty has already looked far into antiquity and issued virtuous words praising Shao Kang, making him shine for a thousand years—it is fitting to record this into a completed piece and leave it for posterity."

manualTranslations.zh: 帝曰：「吾學不博，所聞淺狹，懼於所論，未獲其宜；
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor said: "My learning is not broad, what I have heard is shallow and narrow; I fear that in what was debated the apt conclusion was not reached;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Cao Mao said: "My learning is not broad and what I have heard is shallow; I fear our debate did not reach the apt conclusion;

manualTranslations.zh: 縱有可采，億則屢中，又不足貴，無乃致笑後賢，彰吾闇昧乎！」
manualTranslations.literal: Even if something could be taken from it, that a hundred guesses many times hit the mark is again not worth esteeming—would it not only invite laughter from later worthies and display my dimness!"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: even if something could be taken from it, that a hundred guesses often hit the mark is not worth esteem—would it not only invite laughter from later worthies and display my dimness!"

manualTranslations.zh: 於是侍郎鍾會退論次焉。
manualTranslations.literal: Thereupon Gentleman of the Secretariat Zhong Hui withdrew and arranged the discussion in order.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Thereupon Gentleman of the Secretariat Zhong Hui withdrew and compiled the discussion in order.

sourceRange.text: 三年春正月，荊州刺史王基、新城太守泰攻吳，破之，降者數千口。二月，置南郡之夷陵縣以居降附。三月，以尚書令司馬孚為司空。四月甲申，以征南將軍王昶為征南大將軍。壬辰，大赦。丙午，聞太尉王淩謀廢帝，立楚王彪，太傅司馬宣王東征淩。五月甲寅，淩自殺。六月，彪賜死。秋七月壬戌，皇后甄氏崩。辛未，以司空司馬孚為太尉。戊寅，太傅司馬宣王薨，以衞將軍司馬景王為撫軍大將軍，錄尚書事。乙未，葬懷甄后于太清陵。庚子，驃騎將軍孫資薨。十一月，有司奏諸功臣應饗食於太祖廟者，更以官為次，太傅司馬宣王功高爵尊，最在上。十二月，以光祿勳鄭冲為司空。
