manualTranslations.zh: 初，儉與夏侯玄、李豐等厚善。
manualTranslations.literal: At first Jian was on close terms with Xiahou Xuan, Li Feng, and others.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At first Guanqiu Jian was on close terms with Xiahou Xuan, Li Feng, and others.

manualTranslations.zh: 揚州刺史前將軍文欽，曹爽之邑人也，驍果粗猛，數有戰功，好增虜獲，以徼寵賞，多不見許，怨恨日甚。
manualTranslations.literal: Inspector of Yang Province and former general Wen Qin was a townsman of Cao Shuang; bold and fierce, coarse and violent, he had won battle merit many times; he liked to inflate enemy captures to seek favor and reward, but was often not granted it, and his resentment grew daily.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wen Qin, inspector of Yang Province and former general, was a townsman of Cao Shuang—bold, fierce, and rough. He had won battle merit many times but habitually inflated enemy captures to seek reward, was often refused, and his resentment grew daily.

manualTranslations.zh: 儉以計厚待欽，情好歡洽。
manualTranslations.literal: Jian by policy treated Qin generously, and their feelings and friendship were warm and harmonious.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Guanqiu Jian deliberately treated Wen Qin generously, and their friendship grew warm.

manualTranslations.zh: 欽亦感戴，投心無貳。
manualTranslations.literal: Qin also felt gratitude and devotion, giving his heart without a second thought.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wen Qin in turn was deeply grateful and gave him his loyalty without reservation.

manualTranslations.zh: 正元二年正月，有彗星數十丈，西北竟天，起於吳、楚之分。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first month of the second year of Zhengyuan, a comet tens of zhang long stretched across the northwest sky, rising from the division of Wu and Chu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the first month of the second year of Zhengyuan, a comet tens of zhang long stretched across the northwest sky, rising from the Wu-Chu quarter.

manualTranslations.zh: 儉、欽喜，以為己祥。
manualTranslations.literal: Jian and Qin rejoiced, taking it as their own auspice.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Guanqiu Jian and Wen Qin rejoiced, taking it as an omen in their favor.

manualTranslations.zh: 遂矯太后詔，罪狀大將軍司馬景王，移諸郡國，舉兵反。
manualTranslations.literal: Thereupon they forged an edict of the empress dowager, indicted Grand General Sima Shi, Lord of Jing, sent notices to all commanderies and kingdoms, and raised troops in rebellion.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They then forged an edict of the empress dowager, indicted Grand General Sima Shi, Lord of Jing, sent notices to every commandery and kingdom, and rose in arms.

manualTranslations.zh: 迫脅淮南將守諸別屯者，及吏民大小，皆入壽春城，為壇於城西，歃血稱兵為盟，分老弱守城，儉、欽自將五六萬眾渡淮，西至項。
manualTranslations.literal: They coerced the Huainan garrison commanders at the various detached posts, and officials and people great and small, all to enter Shouchun city; they built an altar west of the city, drank blood and proclaimed arms to form an alliance; they assigned the old and weak to hold the city, while Jian and Qin personally led fifty or sixty thousand men across the Huai west to Xiang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They coerced Huainan garrison commanders at detached posts and officials and commoners alike into Shouchun, built an altar west of the city, drank blood, and proclaimed arms in alliance. The old and weak were left to hold the city while Guanqiu Jian and Wen Qin personally led fifty or sixty thousand men across the Huai west to Xiang.

manualTranslations.zh: 儉堅守，欽在外為遊兵。
manualTranslations.literal: Jian held firm in defense; Qin served outside as mobile troops.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Guanqiu Jian held the defense while Wen Qin operated outside as mobile troops.

manualTranslations.zh: 儉、欽等表曰：「故相國懿，匡輔魏室，歷事忠貞，故烈祖明皇帝授以寄託之任。
manualTranslations.literal: Jian, Qin, and the others submitted a memorial saying: "The late Chief Minister Sima Yi supported and assisted the house of Wei, served through the ages with loyalty and fidelity, and therefore Resplendent Ancestor Emperor Ming entrusted him with the charge of guardianship.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Guanqiu Jian, Wen Qin, and the others submitted a memorial: "The late Chief Minister Sima Yi supported the house of Wei and served with loyal fidelity; Resplendent Ancestor Emperor Ming therefore entrusted him with the charge of guardianship.

manualTranslations.zh: 懿戮力盡節，以寧華夏。
manualTranslations.literal: Yi exhausted his strength and fulfilled his duty to bring peace to the Central Realm.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sima Yi exhausted his strength and fulfilled his duty to bring peace to the Central Realm.

manualTranslations.zh: 又以齊王聰明，無有穢德，乃心勤盡忠以輔上，天下賴之。
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover, because the Prince of Qi was intelligent and without foul conduct, he devoted his heart in diligent loyalty to assist the sovereign, and the realm relied on him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because the Prince of Qi was intelligent and without foul conduct, he devoted himself in loyal service to the sovereign, and the realm relied on him.

manualTranslations.zh: 懿欲討滅二虜以安宇內，始分軍糧，克時同舉，未成而薨。
manualTranslations.literal: Yi wished to campaign and destroy the two barbarian states to settle the realm; he began dividing army grain and fixing a date for a joint advance, but before it was accomplished he died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sima Yi wished to campaign against the two barbarian states and settle the realm; he began dividing army grain and fixing a date for a joint advance, but died before it was accomplished.

manualTranslations.zh: 齊王以懿有輔己大功，故遂使師承統懿業，委以大事。
manualTranslations.literal: The Prince of Qi, because Yi had great merit in assisting him, therefore had Shi inherit and carry on Yi's enterprise and entrusted him with great affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Because Sima Yi had rendered him great service, the Prince of Qi had Sima Shi inherit his father's enterprise and entrusted him with great affairs.

manualTranslations.zh: 而師以盛年在職，無疾託病，坐擁強兵，無有臣禮，朝臣非之，義士譏之，天下所聞，其罪一也。
manualTranslations.literal: Yet Shi, in the prime of life and in office, feigned illness without being ill, sat holding strong troops, and had no deportment of a subject; court ministers condemned him, men of principle mocked him, and all the realm heard of it—this is his first crime.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet Sima Shi, in the prime of life and in office, feigned illness while sitting on strong troops and showing no deportment of a subject. Court ministers condemned him and men of principle mocked him—the whole realm heard of it. This is his first crime.

manualTranslations.zh: 懿造計取賊，多舂軍糧，剋期有日。
manualTranslations.literal: Yi devised plans to take the enemy, pounded much army grain, and fixed a day for the deadline.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sima Yi devised plans against the enemy, pounded much army grain, and fixed a day for the campaign.

manualTranslations.zh: 師為大臣，當除國難，又為人子，當卒父業。
manualTranslations.literal: Shi, as a great minister, ought to remove the state's peril; as a son, he ought to complete his father's work.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As a great minister Sima Shi ought to remove the state's peril; as a son he ought to complete his father's work.

manualTranslations.zh: 哀聲未絕而便罷息，為臣不忠，為子不孝，其罪二也。
manualTranslations.literal: Before the sounds of mourning had ceased he stopped the effort—unfaithful as a minister, unfilial as a son; this is his second crime.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Before the sounds of mourning had ceased he stopped the effort—unfaithful as a minister and unfilial as a son. This is his second crime.

manualTranslations.zh: 賊退過東關，坐自起眾，三征同進，喪眾敗績，歷年軍實，一旦而盡，致使賊來，天下騷動，死傷流離，其罪三也。
manualTranslations.literal: When the enemy retreated past Dong Pass, he on his own raised troops; three campaigns advanced together, lost troops and suffered defeat; years of military stores were exhausted in a single day, causing the enemy to come, the realm to be thrown into turmoil, and the dead and wounded to be driven from their homes—this is his third crime.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When the enemy retreated past Dong Pass he raised troops on his own; three campaigns advanced together, lost men, and were defeated. Years of military stores were exhausted in a day, the enemy returned, the realm was thrown into turmoil, and the dead and wounded were driven from their homes. This is his third crime.

manualTranslations.zh: 賊舉國悉眾，號五十萬，來向壽春，圖詣洛陽，會太尉孚與臣等建計，乃杜塞要險，不與爭鋒，還固新城。
manualTranslations.literal: The enemy mobilized the whole state and all its forces, claiming five hundred thousand men, and came toward Shouchun intending to reach Luoyang; meeting with Grand Commandant Fu and us in devising plans, they then blocked the vital passes, refused to contend at the spearpoint, and withdrew to hold Xincheng firm.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The enemy mobilized the whole state, claiming five hundred thousand men, and marched on Shouchun intending to reach Luoyang. Grand Commandant Sima Fu and we devised a plan to block the vital passes, refuse battle, and withdraw to hold Xincheng firm.

manualTranslations.zh: 淮南將士，衝鋒履刃，晝夜相守，勤瘁百日，死者塗地，自魏有軍已來，為難苦甚，莫過於此。
manualTranslations.literal: The Huainan officers and soldiers charged the spearpoints and trod the blades, guarding day and night through a hundred days of exhausting toil; the dead covered the ground. Since Wei first had armies, no hardship in warfare has surpassed this.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Huainan officers and soldiers charged spearpoints and trod blades, guarding day and night through a hundred days of exhausting toil until the dead covered the ground. Since Wei first had armies, no hardship in warfare has surpassed this.

manualTranslations.zh: 而師遂意自由，不論封賞，權勢自在，無所領錄，其罪四也。
manualTranslations.literal: Yet Shi then followed his own will freely, made no account of rewards and honors, kept power in his own hands, and submitted to no oversight—this is his fourth crime.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet Sima Shi then followed his own will, made no account of rewards and honors, kept power in his own hands, and submitted to no oversight. This is his fourth crime.

manualTranslations.zh: 故中書令李豐等，以師無人臣節，欲議退之。
manualTranslations.literal: The late Director of the Secretariat Li Feng and others, because Shi lacked the restraint of a subject, wished to deliberate on removing him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The late Director of the Secretariat Li Feng and others, because Sima Shi lacked the restraint of a subject, wished to deliberate on removing him.

manualTranslations.zh: 師知而請豐，其夕拉殺，載屍埋棺。
manualTranslations.literal: Shi learned of it and summoned Feng; that evening he dragged him out and killed him, loaded the corpse into a coffin, and buried it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sima Shi learned of it and summoned Li Feng; that evening he dragged him out and killed him, loaded the corpse into a coffin, and buried it.

manualTranslations.zh: 豐等為大臣，帝王腹心，擅加酷暴，死無罪名，師有無君之心，其罪五也。
manualTranslations.literal: Feng and the others were great ministers, the sovereign's inner confidants; Shi arbitrarily inflicted cruel violence, and they died without any charge against them—Shi harbored a heart without regard for the ruler; this is his fifth crime.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Li Feng and the others were great ministers and the sovereign's inner confidants; Sima Shi arbitrarily inflicted cruel violence, and they died without any charge against them. He harbored a heart without regard for the ruler. This is his fifth crime.

manualTranslations.zh: 懿每嘆說齊王自堪人主，君臣之義定。
manualTranslations.literal: Yi often sighed and declared that the Prince of Qi was himself fit to be ruler, and that the righteousness between ruler and minister was settled.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sima Yi often declared that the Prince of Qi was himself fit to be ruler and that the righteousness between ruler and minister was settled.

manualTranslations.zh: 奉事以來十有五載，始欲歸政，按行武庫，詔問禁兵不得妄出。
manualTranslations.literal: From the time of service there had been fifteen years; he first wished to return government to the throne, inspected the armory, and issued an edict forbidding the forbidden troops to go out without authorization.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For fifteen years he had served the throne; he first wished to return government to the sovereign, inspected the armory, and issued an edict forbidding the forbidden troops to go out without authorization.

manualTranslations.zh: 師自知姦慝，人神所不祐，矯廢君主，加之以罪。
manualTranslations.literal: Shi knew himself wicked and corrupt, unblessed by men and spirits; he forged the deposition of the sovereign and heaped charges upon him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Knowing himself wicked and unblessed by men and spirits, Sima Shi forged the deposition of the sovereign and heaped charges upon him.

manualTranslations.zh: 孚，師之叔父，性甚仁孝，追送齊王，悲不自勝。
manualTranslations.literal: Fu was Shi's uncle by the paternal line; by nature deeply humane and filial, he followed to send off the Prince of Qi, grief beyond his power to bear.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sima Fu, Sima Shi's uncle by the paternal line, was by nature deeply humane and filial; he followed to send off the Prince of Qi, grief beyond his power to bear.

manualTranslations.zh: 群臣皆怒而師懷忍，不顧大義，其罪六也。
manualTranslations.literal: All the ministers were angry, yet Shi harbored hardness and paid no regard to great righteousness—this is his sixth crime.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: All the ministers were angry, yet Sima Shi harbored hardness and paid no regard to great righteousness. This is his sixth crime.

manualTranslations.zh: 又故光祿大夫張緝，無罪而誅，夷其妻子，並及母后，逼恐至尊，強催督遣，臨時哀愕，莫不傷痛；
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover the late Household Counsellor Zhang Ji was executed though guiltless; his wife and children were exterminated, and even the empress dowager was implicated; he intimidated and terrified the supreme sovereign and forcibly urged and supervised the dismissal—at the moment all were stricken with grief and shock, and none were not wounded in heart;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Moreover the late Household Counsellor Zhang Ji was executed though guiltless; his wife and children were exterminated, and even the empress dowager was implicated. He intimidated the supreme sovereign and forcibly urged the dismissal—at the moment all were stricken with grief and shock;

manualTranslations.zh: 而師稱慶，反以歡喜，其罪七也。
manualTranslations.literal: yet Shi proclaimed celebration and on the contrary rejoiced—this is his seventh crime.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: yet Sima Shi proclaimed celebration and rejoiced. This is his seventh crime.

manualTranslations.zh: 陛下踐阼，聰明神武，事經聖心，欲崇省約，天下聞之，莫不歡慶；
manualTranslations.literal: Your Majesty ascended the throne, intelligent, divine, and martial; affairs passed through the sacred heart; you wished to promote austerity and restraint; all the realm heard of it and none were not rejoicing;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Your Majesty ascended the throne, intelligent, divine, and martial; affairs passed through the sacred heart; you wished to promote austerity and restraint, and all the realm rejoiced;

manualTranslations.zh: 而師不自改悔脩复臣禮，而方徵兵募士，毀壞宮內，列侯自衛。
manualTranslations.literal: yet Shi did not himself repent and reform and restore the deportment of a subject, but instead was recruiting troops and levying soldiers, damaging the inner palace, and having ranked marquises guard themselves.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: yet Sima Shi did not repent and restore the deportment of a subject, but instead recruited troops, damaged the inner palace, and had ranked marquises guard themselves.

manualTranslations.zh: 陛下即阼，初不朝覲。
manualTranslations.literal: From the time Your Majesty took the throne, at first he did not attend court audience.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From the time Your Majesty took the throne, at first he did not attend court audience.

manualTranslations.zh: 陛下欲臨幸師舍以省其疾，复拒不通，不奉法度，其罪八也。
manualTranslations.literal: Your Majesty wished to visit Shi's residence in person to inquire after his illness, yet he again refused and would not admit you, not observing the laws and standards—this is his eighth crime.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Your Majesty wished to visit Sima Shi's residence in person to inquire after his illness, yet he again refused and would not admit you, not observing the laws and standards. This is his eighth crime.

manualTranslations.zh: 近者領軍許允當為鎮北，以廚錢給賜，而師舉奏加辟，雖云流徙，道路餓殺，天下聞之，莫不哀傷，其罪九也。
manualTranslations.literal: Recently Colonel of the Garrison Xu Yun was to become general who guards the north; kitchen funds were given as bounty, yet Shi memorialized and added capital punishment; though it was said he was banished, on the road he starved to death; all the realm heard of it and none were not grieved—this is his ninth crime.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Recently Colonel of the Garrison Xu Yun was to become general who guards the north and kitchen funds were given as bounty, yet Sima Shi memorialized and added capital punishment. Though it was said he was banished, on the road he starved to death; all the realm grieved. This is his ninth crime.

manualTranslations.zh: 三方之守，一朝闕廢，多選精兵，以自營衛，五營領兵，闕而不補，多載器杖，充聚本營，天下所聞，人懷憤怨，訛言盈路，以疑海內，其罪十也。
manualTranslations.literal: The garrisons of the three directions were in one morning left vacant and abolished; he selected many elite troops to guard himself; the five-camp commanders of troops were left vacant and not filled; he loaded many weapons and gear and packed them into his own headquarters; all the realm heard of it; men harbored anger and resentment; false reports filled the roads and sowed doubt throughout the realm—this is his tenth crime.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The garrisons of the three directions were in one morning left vacant; he selected many elite troops to guard himself, left the five-camp commands unfilled, and packed weapons into his own headquarters. All the realm heard of it; men harbored anger and resentment, false reports filled the roads, and doubt spread throughout the realm. This is his tenth crime.

manualTranslations.zh: 多休守兵，以佔高第，以空虛四表，欲擅強勢，以逞姦心，募取屯田，加其復賞，阻兵安忍，壞亂舊法。
manualTranslations.literal: He dismissed many frontier garrison troops to occupy high-grade posts, leaving the four borders empty, wishing to monopolize strong power and give free rein to his wicked heart; he recruited and seized military colonies and added to their exemptions and rewards; he relied on troops and rested in cruelty, wrecking and disordering the old laws.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He dismissed many frontier garrison troops to occupy high-grade posts, leaving the four borders empty, wishing to monopolize power and give free rein to his wicked heart. He recruited and seized military colonies, added to their exemptions and rewards, relied on troops, rested in cruelty, and wrecked the old laws.

manualTranslations.zh: 合聚諸籓王公以著鄴，欲悉誅之，一旦舉事廢主。
manualTranslations.literal: He gathered the feudal princes and kings at Ye, wishing to execute them all, and in one stroke raise an affair to depose the sovereign.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He gathered the feudal princes and kings at Ye, wishing to execute them all, and in one stroke raise an affair to depose the sovereign.

manualTranslations.zh: 天不長惡，使目腫不成，其罪十一也。
manualTranslations.literal: Heaven does not long endure wickedness; it made his eye swell so that the deed could not be completed—this is his eleventh crime.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Heaven does not long endure wickedness; it made his eye swell so that the deed could not be completed. This is his eleventh crime.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣等先人皆隨從太祖武皇帝征討凶暴，獲成大功，與高祖文皇帝即受漢禪，開國承家，猶堯舜相傳也。
manualTranslations.literal: Our forebears all followed Grand Ancestor Emperor Wu in campaigning against the violent and cruel and won great merit; with High Ancestor Emperor Wen they immediately received the Han abdication, founded the state and inherited the house, like Yao and Shun passing the throne in succession.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Our forebears all followed Grand Ancestor Emperor Wu in campaigning against the violent and cruel and won great merit; with High Ancestor Emperor Wen they received the Han abdication, founded the state and inherited the house, like Yao and Shun passing the throne in succession.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣與安豐護軍鄭翼、廬江護軍呂宣、太守張休、淮南太守丁尊、督合肥護軍王休等議，各以累世受恩，千載風塵，思盡軀命，以完全社稷安主為效。
manualTranslations.literal: We deliberated with Protector of the Army of Anfeng Zheng Yi, Protector of the Army of Lujiang Lu Xuan, Administrator Zhang Xiu, Administrator of Huainan Ding Zun, and Protector of the Army supervising Hefei Wang Xiu, and others; each, having received grace through successive generations amid a thousand years of turmoil, thought to exhaust body and life to complete the altars of state and secure the sovereign as our service.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: We deliberated with Protector of the Army of Anfeng Zheng Yi, Protector of the Army of Lujiang Lu Xuan, Administrator Zhang Xiu, Administrator of Huainan Ding Zun, and Protector of the Army supervising Hefei Wang Xiu, and others. Each, having received grace through successive generations amid a thousand years of turmoil, thought to exhaust body and life to secure the altars of state and the sovereign.

manualTranslations.zh: 斯義苟立，雖焚妻子，吞炭漆身，死而不恨也。
manualTranslations.literal: If this righteousness is once established, though we burn wife and children, swallow charcoal and lacquer our bodies, we would die without regret.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If this righteousness is once established, though we burn wife and children or swallow charcoal and lacquer our bodies, we would die without regret.

manualTranslations.zh: 按師之罪，宜加大辟，以彰姦慝。
manualTranslations.literal: Weighing Shi's crimes, he ought to receive capital punishment to make manifest his wickedness and corruption.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Weighing Sima Shi's crimes, he ought to receive capital punishment to make manifest his wickedness and corruption.

manualTranslations.zh: 春秋之義，一世為善，一世宥之。
manualTranslations.literal: The principle of the Spring and Autumn Annals is that one generation's goodness earns one generation's pardon.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The principle of the Spring and Autumn Annals is that one generation's goodness earns one generation's pardon.

manualTranslations.zh: 懿有大功，海內所書，依古典議，廢師以侯就弟。
manualTranslations.literal: Yi had great merit, recorded throughout the realm; according to the deliberation of ancient precedent, depose Shi and let him go to his younger brother as a marquis.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sima Yi had great merit, recorded throughout the realm; according to ancient precedent, depose Sima Shi and let him go to his younger brother as a marquis.

manualTranslations.zh: 弟昭，忠肅寬明，樂善好士，有高世君子之度，忠誠為國，不與師同。
manualTranslations.literal: The younger brother Zhao is loyal, solemn, broad-minded, and clear-sighted; he delights in goodness and loves scholars; he has the measure of a lofty gentleman of the age; he is loyal and devoted to the state and does not share Shi's ways.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The younger brother Sima Zhao is loyal, solemn, broad-minded, and clear-sighted; he delights in goodness and loves scholars, has the measure of a lofty gentleman of the age, is loyal and devoted to the state, and does not share Sima Shi's ways.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣等碎首所保，可以代師輔導聖躬。
manualTranslations.literal: We would break our heads to vouch for him; he can replace Shi in assisting and guiding the sacred person.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: We would break our heads to vouch for him; he can replace Sima Shi in assisting and guiding the sacred person.

manualTranslations.zh: 太尉孚，忠孝小心，所宜親寵，授以保傅。
manualTranslations.literal: Grand Commandant Fu is loyal, filial, and careful; he ought to be favored in person and given the posts of guardian and tutor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Grand Commandant Sima Fu is loyal, filial, and careful; he ought to be favored in person and given the posts of guardian and tutor.

manualTranslations.zh: 護軍散騎常侍望，忠公親事，當官稱能，遠迎乘輿，有宿衛之功，可為中領軍。
manualTranslations.literal: Protector of the Army and Regular Attendant at the Secretariat Wang is loyal and public-spirited in personal service, competent in office, welcomed the imperial carriage from afar, and has merit in night guard; he can serve as central colonel of the garrison.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Protector of the Army and Regular Attendant at the Secretariat Sima Wang is loyal and public-spirited in personal service, competent in office, welcomed the imperial carriage from afar, and has merit in night guard; he can serve as central colonel of the garrison.

manualTranslations.zh: 春秋之義，大義滅親，故周公誅弟，石碏戮子，季友鴆兄，上為國計，下全宗族。
manualTranslations.literal: The principle of the Spring and Autumn Annals is that great righteousness overrides kinship; therefore the Duke of Zhou executed his younger brother, Shi Que killed his son, and Ji You poisoned his elder brother—above for the state's reckoning, below to preserve the clan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The principle of the Spring and Autumn Annals is that great righteousness overrides kinship; therefore the Duke of Zhou executed his younger brother, Shi Que killed his son, and Ji You poisoned his elder brother—above for the state's reckoning, below to preserve the clan.

manualTranslations.zh: 殛鯀用禹，聖人明典，古今所稱。
manualTranslations.literal: Executing Gun and employing Yu is the clear precedent of the sages, praised through ancient and modern times.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Executing Gun and employing Yu is the clear precedent of the sages, praised through ancient and modern times.

manualTranslations.zh: 乞陛下下臣等所奏，朝堂博議。
manualTranslations.literal: We beg Your Majesty to issue down our memorial for broad deliberation in the court hall.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: We beg Your Majesty to issue down our memorial for broad deliberation in the court hall.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣言當道，使師遜位避賢者，罷兵去備，如三皇舊法，則天下協同。
manualTranslations.literal: If our words accord with the Way, let Shi yield his position and make way for the worthy, dismiss troops and remove defenses, as in the old ways of the Three Sovereigns, and then the realm will be of one accord.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If our words accord with the Way, let Sima Shi yield his position and make way for the worthy, dismiss troops and remove defenses as in the old ways of the Three Sovereigns, and the realm will be of one accord.

manualTranslations.zh: 若師負勢恃眾不自退者，臣等率將所領，晝夜兼行，惟命是授。
manualTranslations.literal: If Shi relies on his power and trusts in his masses and will not withdraw of himself, we will lead what we command, traveling day and night together, awaiting orders to give our lives.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If Sima Shi relies on his power and trusts in his masses and will not withdraw of himself, we will lead what we command, traveling day and night together, awaiting orders to give our lives.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣等今日所奏，惟欲使大魏永存，使陛下得行君意，遠絕亡之禍，百姓安全，六合一體，使忠臣義士，不愧於三皇五帝耳。
manualTranslations.literal: What we memorialize today is only that we wish to make great Wei endure forever, let Your Majesty carry out the sovereign's intent, keep far from the calamity of ruin, secure the common people, unite the six directions in one body, and let loyal ministers and righteous men not be shamed before the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: What we memorialize today is only that we wish to make great Wei endure forever, let Your Majesty carry out the sovereign's intent, keep far from the calamity of ruin, secure the common people, unite the six directions in one body, and let loyal ministers and righteous men not be shamed before the Three Sovereigns and Five Emperors.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣恐兵起，天下擾亂，臣輒上事，移三征及州郡國典農，各安慰所部吏民，不得妄動，謹具以狀聞。
manualTranslations.literal: We fear that when arms are raised the realm will be thrown into disorder; we therefore immediately submit this report and send notices to the three campaign-generals and to the agricultural officers of the provinces, commanderies, and kingdoms, each to reassure the officials and people under their jurisdiction and not act rashly; we respectfully set forth the full account to inform you.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: We fear that when arms are raised the realm will be thrown into disorder; we therefore immediately submit this report and send notices to the three campaign-generals and to the agricultural officers of the provinces, commanderies, and kingdoms, each to reassure the officials and people under their jurisdiction and not act rashly; we respectfully set forth the full account to inform you.

manualTranslations.zh: 惟陛下愛養精神，明慮危害，以寧海內。
manualTranslations.literal: May Your Majesty cherish and nurture your spirit, clearly weigh perils and harms, and thereby bring peace within the seas.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: May Your Majesty cherish and nurture your spirit, clearly weigh perils and harms, and thereby bring peace within the seas.

manualTranslations.zh: 師專權用勢，賞罰自由，聞臣等舉眾，必下詔禁絕關津，使驛書不通，擅复徵調，有所收捕。
manualTranslations.literal: Shi monopolizes power and uses force; rewards and punishments are at his own will. Hearing that we have raised the masses, he is sure to issue an edict forbidding passage at passes and fords, cutting off relay dispatches, and on his own authority again levying troops and making arrests.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sima Shi monopolizes power and uses force; rewards and punishments are at his own will. Hearing that we have raised the masses, he is sure to issue an edict forbidding passage at passes and fords, cutting off relay dispatches, and on his own authority again levying troops and making arrests.

manualTranslations.zh: 此乃師詔，非陛下詔書，在所皆不得復承用。
manualTranslations.literal: These are Shi's orders, not Your Majesty's edicts; wherever they arrive none may again receive and employ them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: These are Sima Shi's orders, not Your Majesty's edicts; wherever they arrive none may again receive and employ them.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣等道遠，懼文書不得皆通，輒臨時賞罰，以便宜從事，須定表上也。
manualTranslations.literal: We are far on the road and fear that documents may not all get through; we therefore provisionally grant rewards and punishments and act according to local circumstances, to be reported in a fixed memorial when settled.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: We are far on the road and fear that documents may not all get through; we therefore provisionally grant rewards and punishments and act according to local circumstances, to be reported in a fixed memorial when settled.

sourceRange.text: 艾州里時輩南陽州泰，亦好立功業，善用兵，官至征虜將軍、假節都督江南諸軍事。景元二年薨，追贈衛將軍，諡曰壯侯。《世語》曰：初，荊州刺史裴潛以泰為從事，司馬宣王鎮宛，潛數遣詣宣王，由此為宣王所知。及征孟達，泰又導軍，遂辟泰。泰頻喪考、妣、祖，九年居喪，宣王留缺待之，至三十六日，擢為新城太守。宣王為泰會，使尚書鍾繇調泰：「君釋褐登宰府，三十六日擁麾蓋，守兵馬郡；乞兒乘小車，一何駛乎？」泰曰：「誠有此。君，名公之子，少有文采，故守吏職；獼猴騎土牛，又何遲也！」眾賓咸悅。後歷兗、豫州刺史，所在有籌算績效。

context.afterSource: 鍾會字士季，潁川長社人，太傅繇小子也。

manualTranslations.zh: 艾州里時輩南陽州泰，亦好立功業，善用兵，官至征虜將軍、假節都督江南諸軍事。
manualTranslations.literal: Deng Ai's contemporary from the same district, Zhou Tai of Nanyang, likewise loved to achieve merit and was skilled in using troops; he reached the post of General Who Subdues Barbarians, with provisional staff superintending military affairs of the lands south of the Yangtze.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Deng Ai's contemporary from the same district, Zhou Tai of Nanyang, likewise loved to achieve merit and was skilled in using troops; he reached the post of general who subdues barbarians, with provisional staff superintending military affairs south of the Yangtze.

manualTranslations.zh: 景元二年薨，追贈衛將軍，諡曰壯侯。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Jingyuan he died; posthumously he was given General of the Guards and the posthumous title Marquis Zhuang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the second year of Jingyuan he died; posthumously he was made general of the guards with the posthumous title Marquis Zhuang.

manualTranslations.zh: 《世語》曰：初，荊州刺史裴潛以泰為從事，司馬宣王鎮宛，潛數遣詣宣王，由此為宣王所知。
manualTranslations.literal: The Sayings of the Age says: At first Inspector of Jing Province Pei Qian employed Tai as an aide; Sima Yi, Prince of Xuan, was stationed at Wan; Qian repeatedly sent Tai to see the Prince of Xuan, and thereby Tai became known to him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Sayings of the Age says: At first Inspector Pei Qian of Jing Province employed Zhou Tai as an aide; Sima Yi, Prince of Xuan, was stationed at Wan; Qian repeatedly sent Tai to see him, and thereby Tai became known to him.

manualTranslations.zh: 及征孟達，泰又導軍，遂辟泰。
manualTranslations.literal: When campaigning against Meng Da, Tai again guided the army, and thereupon Tai was recruited.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When campaigning against Meng Da, Tai again guided the army, and thereupon he was recruited.

manualTranslations.zh: 泰頻喪考、妣、祖，九年居喪，宣王留缺待之，至三十六日，擢為新城太守。
manualTranslations.literal: Tai repeatedly mourned father, mother, and grandfather, observing mourning for nine years; the Prince of Xuan left the post vacant awaiting him, and on the thirty-sixth day promoted him to Administrator of Xincheng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tai repeatedly mourned father, mother, and grandfather, observing mourning for nine years; the Prince of Xuan left the post vacant awaiting him, and on the thirty-sixth day promoted him to administrator of Xincheng.

manualTranslations.zh: 宣王為泰會，使尚書鍾繇調泰：「君釋褐登宰府，三十六日擁麾蓋，守兵馬郡；
manualTranslations.literal: The Prince of Xuan held a gathering for Tai and had Master of Writing Zhong You tease Tai: "Sir, you left coarse cloth and entered the chief minister's office; in thirty-six days you wield banner and canopy and guard a commandery of troops and horses;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Prince of Xuan held a gathering for Tai and had Master of Writing Zhong You tease Tai: "Sir, you left coarse cloth and entered the chief minister's office; in thirty-six days you wield banner and canopy and guard a commandery of troops and horses;

manualTranslations.zh: 乞兒乘小車，一何駛乎？」

sourceRange.text: 」後樓班大，峭王率其部衆奉樓班爲單于，蹋頓爲王。然蹋頓多畫計策。廣陽閻柔，少沒烏丸、鮮卑中，爲其種所歸信。柔乃因鮮卑衆，殺烏丸校尉邢舉代之，紹因寵慰以安北邊。後袁尚敗奔蹋頓，憑其勢，復圖冀州。會太祖平河北，柔帥鮮卑、烏丸歸附，遂因以柔爲校尉，猶持漢使節，治廣甯如舊。建安十一年，太祖自征蹋頓於柳城，潛軍詭道，未至百餘里，虜乃覺。尚與蹋頓將衆逆戰於凡城，兵馬甚盛。太祖登高望虜陳，（柳）軍未進，觀其小動，乃擊破其衆，臨陳斬蹋頓首，死者被野。速附丸、樓班、烏延等走遼東，遼東悉斬，傳送其首。其餘遺迸皆降。及幽州、并州柔所統烏丸萬餘落，悉徙其族居中國，帥從其侯王大人種衆與征伐。由是三郡烏丸爲天下名騎。《魏略》曰：景初元年秋，遣幽州刺史毌丘儉率衆軍討遼東。右北平烏丸單于寇婁敦、遼西烏丸都督率衆王護留葉，昔隨袁尚奔遼西，聞儉軍至，率衆五千餘人降。寇婁敦遣弟（阿羅獎）阿羅槃等詣闕朝貢，封其渠帥三十餘爲王，賜輿馬繒采各有差。鮮卑《魏書》曰：鮮卑亦東胡之餘也，別保鮮卑山，因號焉。

sourceRange.text: 文帝踐阼，田豫爲烏丸校尉，持節并護鮮卑，屯昌平。步度根遣使獻馬，帝拜爲王。後數與軻比能更相攻擊，步度根部衆稍寡弱，將其衆萬餘落保太原、鴈門郡。步度根乃使人招呼泄歸泥曰：「汝父爲比能所殺，不念報仇，反屬怨家。今雖厚待汝，是欲殺汝計也。不如還我，我與汝是骨肉至親，豈與仇等？」由是歸泥將其部落逃歸步度根，比能追之弗及。至黃初五年，步度根詣闕貢獻，厚加賞賜，是後一心守邊，不爲寇害，而軻比能衆遂彊盛。明帝即位，務欲綏和戎狄，以息征伐，羈縻兩部而已。至青龍元年233年，比能誘步度根深結和親，於是步度根將泄歸泥及部衆悉保比能，寇鈔并州，殺略吏民。帝遣驍騎將軍秦朗征之，歸泥叛比能，將其部衆降，拜歸義王，賜幢麾、曲蓋、鼓吹，居并州如故。步度根爲比能所殺。

manualTranslations.literal: Budugen dispatched envoys presenting horses; the emperor enfeoffed him as king.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Budugen sent horses as tribute, and the emperor enfeoffed him as king.

manualTranslations.zh: 後數與軻比能更相攻擊，步度根部衆稍寡弱，將其衆萬餘落保太原、鴈門郡。
manualTranslations.literal: Afterward he repeatedly with Kebineng mutually attacked and struck; Budugen's tribal masses gradually grew few and weak, and he led his masses of more than ten thousand households to shelter in Taiyuan and Yanmen commanderies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He and Kebineng raided each other repeatedly until Budugen's following thinned; he then withdrew more than ten thousand households into Taiyuan and Yanmen.

manualTranslations.zh: 步度根乃使人招呼泄歸泥曰：「汝父爲比能所殺，不念報仇，反屬怨家。
manualTranslations.literal: Budugen then sent men to summon Xieguini, saying: "Your father was killed by Kebineng; you give no thought to avenging him, yet instead attach yourself to your family's enemy.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Budugen then sent men to call Xieguini to him, saying, "Your father was killed by Kebineng. You show no thought of vengeance, yet serve your family's enemy instead.

manualTranslations.zh: 今雖厚待汝，是欲殺汝計也。
manualTranslations.literal: Though he now treats you generously, that is a plan to kill you.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Though he treats you generously now, that is only a plan to kill you.

manualTranslations.zh: 不如還我，我與汝是骨肉至親，豈與仇等？
manualTranslations.literal: Better return to me; you and I are bone-and-flesh closest kin—how could we be equal to an enemy?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Come back to me instead. You and I are closest kin by blood—how could we be counted with an enemy?"

manualTranslations.zh: 」由是歸泥將其部落逃歸步度根，比能追之弗及。
manualTranslations.literal: From this Xieguini led his tribe in flight back to Budugen; Kebineng pursued but did not overtake him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xieguini then fled with his tribe back to Budugen, and Kebineng pursued but could not catch him.

manualTranslations.zh: 至黃初五年，步度根詣闕貢獻，厚加賞賜，是後一心守邊，不爲寇害，而軻比能衆遂彊盛。
manualTranslations.literal: When it reached the fifth year of Huangchu, Budugen came to court with tribute and was richly rewarded; thereafter he devoted himself to guarding the border and made no raids, while Kebineng's masses grew strong and flourishing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Huangchu 5 Budugen came to court with tribute and received rich rewards; thereafter he kept the border faithfully and made no raids, while Kebineng's following grew ever stronger.

manualTranslations.zh: 明帝即位，務欲綏和戎狄，以息征伐，羈縻兩部而已。
manualTranslations.literal: When Emperor Ming took the throne, he strove to soothe and harmonize the Rong and Di, to cease campaigns and strikes, and merely held the two divisions in restraint.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Ming succeeded, he sought to pacify the frontier peoples and end campaigning, holding the two factions in check by favors alone.

manualTranslations.zh: 至青龍元年233年，比能誘步度根深結和親，於是步度根將泄歸泥及部衆悉保比能，寇鈔并州，殺略吏民。
manualTranslations.literal: When it reached the first year of Qinglong, 233, Kebineng enticed Budugen into a deep bond of peace and kinship; Budugen then led Xieguini and all his tribal masses to shelter under Kebineng, raided and plundered Bingzhou, and killed and plundered officials and people.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Qinglong 1 (233) Kebineng lured Budugen into a close marriage alliance; Budugen then brought Xieguini and all his people under Kebineng's protection, raided Bingzhou, and killed or plundered officials and commoners.

manualTranslations.zh: 帝遣驍騎將軍秦朗征之，歸泥叛比能，將其部衆降，拜歸義王，賜幢麾、曲蓋、鼓吹，居并州如故。
manualTranslations.literal: The emperor dispatched Fierce Cavalry General Qin Lang to campaign against them; Xieguini rebelled against Kebineng, led his tribal masses to surrender, was enfeoffed as king who returns to righteousness, and was granted banners, curved canopies, and ceremonial music, dwelling in Bingzhou as before.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The emperor sent Fierce Cavalry General Qin Lang against them; Xieguini turned against Kebineng, surrendered with his people, was enfeoffed as king who returns to righteousness, and received banners, curved canopies, and ceremonial music, remaining in Bingzhou as before.

manualTranslations.zh: 步度根爲比能所殺。
manualTranslations.literal: Budugen was killed by Kebineng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Budugen was killed by Kebineng.

sourceRange.text: 汝來使、涉遠，道路勤勞，今以爲，爲，假銀印靑綬，引見勞賜遣還。今以五匹，十張，五十匹，五十匹，答汝所獻貢直。又特賜汝三匹，五張，五十匹，金八兩，五尺刀二口，銅鏡百枚，真珠、鉛丹各五十斤，皆裝封付、還到録受。

localRange.text: 汝來使難升米、牛利涉遠，道路勤勞，今以難升米爲率善中郎將，牛利爲率善校尉，假銀印青綬，引見勞賜遣還。今以絳地交龍錦五匹、〈臣松之以爲地應爲綈，漢文帝著皁衣謂之弋綈是也。此字不體，非魏朝之失，則傳寫者誤也。絳地縐粟罽十張、蒨絳五十匹、紺青五十匹，答汝所獻貢直。又特賜汝紺地句文錦三匹、細班華罽五張、白絹五十匹、金八兩、五尺刀二口、銅鏡百枚、真珠、鉛丹各五十斤，皆裝封付難升米、牛利還到錄受。

sourceRange.text: 有千餘戶，無良田，食海物自活，乘船南北市糴。又南渡一海千餘里，名曰瀚海，至ul|一國，官亦曰，副曰，方可三百里。多竹木叢林，有三千許家。差有田地，耕田猶不足食，亦南北市糴。又渡一海，千餘里至，有四千餘戶，濵山海居，草木茂盛，行不見前人。好捕魚鰒，水無深淺，皆沉没取之。東南陸行五百里，到，官曰，副曰、。有千餘户，世有王，皆統屬女王國，郡使往來常所駐。東南至百里，官曰，副曰，有二萬餘户。東行至百里，官曰，副曰，有千餘家。南至，水行二十日，官曰，副曰，可五萬餘户。南至ul|邪馬國，女王之所都，水行十日，陸行一月。官有，次曰，次曰，次曰，可七萬餘戶。

localRange.text: 有千餘戶，無良田，食海物自活，乖船南北市糴。又南渡一海千餘里，名曰瀚海，至一大國，官亦曰卑狗，副曰卑奴母離。方可三百里，多竹木叢林，有三千許家，差有田地，耕田猶不足食，亦南北市糴。又渡一海，千餘里至末盧國，有四千餘戶，濱山海居，草木茂盛，行不見前人。好捕魚鰒，水無深淺，皆沈沒取之。東南陸行五百里，到伊都國，官曰爾支，副曰泄謨觚、柄渠觚。有千餘戶，世有王，皆統屬女王國，郡使往來常所駐。東南至奴國百里，官曰兕馬觚，副曰卑奴母離，有二萬餘戶。東行至不彌國百里，官曰多模，副曰卑奴母離，有千餘家。南至投馬國，水行二十日，官曰彌彌，副曰彌彌那利，可五萬餘戶。南至邪馬壹國，女王之所都，水行十日，陸行一月。官有伊支馬，次曰彌馬升，次曰彌馬獲支，次曰奴佳鞮，可七萬餘戶。

sourceRange.text: 出真珠、靑玉，其山有丹，其木有柟、杼、豫樟、楺櫪、投橿、烏號、楓香，其竹篠簳、桃支，有薑、橘、椒、蘘荷，不知以爲滋味。有獼猴、黑雉。其俗舉事行來，有所云爲，輙灼骨而卜，以占吉凶。先告所卜，其辭如令龜法，視火坼占兆。其會同坐起，父子男女無别，人性嗜酒。

localRange.text: 出真珠、青玉。其山有丹，其木有柟、杼、豫樟、楺櫪、投橿、烏號、楓香，其竹筱簳、桃支。有薑、橘、椒、蘘荷，不知以爲滋味。有獮猴、黑雉。其俗舉事行來，有所雲爲，輒灼骨而卜，以占吉凶，先告所卜，其辭如令龜法，視火坼占兆。其會同坐起，父子男女無別，人性嗜酒。〈《魏略》曰：其俗不知正歲四節，但計春耕秋收爲年紀。

sourceRange.text: 」正始元年，太守遣等奉詔書印綬詣倭國，拜假倭王，並齎詔賜金帛、錦罽、刀鏡、采物，倭王因使上表答謝恩詔。其四年，倭王復遣使大夫、等八人，上獻生口、倭錦、絳靑縑、緜衣、帛布、丹木、𤝔、短弓矢。等壹拜率善中郎將印綬。其六年，詔賜倭黄幢，付郡假授。其八年，太守王頎到官。倭女王與男王素不和，遣倭、等詣郡，說相攻擊狀。遣等，因齎詔書、黄幢，拜假爲檄告諭之。以死，大作冢，徑百餘步，徇葬者奴婢百餘人。更立男王，國中不服，更相誅殺，當時殺千餘人。復立宗女ul|與，年十三爲王，國中遂定。等以檄告喻ul|與，ul|與遣倭大夫率善中郎將等二十人送等還，因詣臺，獻上男女生口三十人，貢白珠五千孔、靑大句珠二枚、異文雜錦二十匹。

sourceRange.text: 會益州刺史郤儉賦斂煩擾，謠言遠聞，儉，郤正祖也。而并州殺刺史張壹，涼州殺刺史耿鄙，焉謀得施。出為監軍使者，領益州牧，封陽城侯，當收儉治罪；《續漢書》曰：是時用劉虞為幽州，劉焉為益州，劉表為荊州，賈琮為冀州。虞等皆海內清名之士，或從列卿尚書以選為牧伯，各以本秩居任。舊典：傳車參駕，施赤為帷裳。臣松之按：靈帝崩後，義軍起，孫堅殺荊州刺史王叡，然後劉表為荊州，不與焉同時也。《漢靈帝紀》曰：帝引見焉，宣示方略，加以賞賜，敕焉為益州刺史。前刺史劉雋、郤儉皆貪殘放濫，取受狼籍，元元無聊，呼嗟充野，焉到便收攝行法，以示萬姓，勿令漏露，使癰疽決潰，為國生梗。焉受命而行，以道路不通，住荊州東界。扶亦求為蜀郡西部屬國都尉，及太倉令（會）巴西趙韙去官，俱隨焉。陳壽《益部耆舊傳》曰：董扶字茂安。少從師學，兼通數經，善歐陽尚書，又事聘士楊厚，究極圖讖。遂至京師，遊覽太學，還家講授，弟子自遠而至。永康元年167年，日有蝕之，詔舉賢良方正之士，策問得失。左馮翊趙謙等舉扶，扶以病不詣，遙於長安上封事，遂稱疾篤歸家。前後宰府十闢，公車三徵，再舉賢良方正、博士、有道皆不就，名稱尤重。大將軍何進表薦扶曰：「資遊、夏之德，述孔氏之風，內懷焦、董消復之術。方今並、涼騷擾，西戎蠢叛，宜敕公車特召，待以異禮，諮謀奇策。」於是靈帝徵扶，即拜侍中。在朝稱為儒宗，甚見器重。求為蜀郡屬國都尉。扶出一歲而靈帝崩，天下大亂。後去官，年八十二卒於家。始扶發辭抗論，益部少雙，故號曰（致止）〔至止〕，言人莫能當，所至而談止也。後丞相諸葛亮問秦宓以扶所長，宓曰：「董扶褒秋毫之善，貶纖芥之惡。」是時〔益〕州逆賊馬相、趙祗等於綿竹縣自號黃巾，合聚疲役之民，一二日中得數千人，先殺綿竹令李升，吏民翕集，合萬餘人，便前破雒縣，攻益州殺儉，又到蜀郡、犍為，旬月之間，破壞三郡。

localRange.text: 是時（涼）州逆賊馬相、趙祗等於綿竹縣自號黃巾，合聚疲役之民，一二日中得數千人，先殺綿竹令李升，吏民翕集，合萬馀人，便前破雒縣，攻益州殺儉，又到蜀郡、犍為，旬月之間，破壞三郡。

manualTranslations.zh: 會益州刺史郤儉賦斂煩擾，謠言遠聞，儉，郤正祖也。
manualTranslations.literal: It happened that Inspector of Yizhou Xi Jian levied taxes in vexing and harassing fashion, and rumors were heard from afar; Jian was a descendant of Xi Zheng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: About then Yizhou Inspector Xi Jian was grinding the people with heavy levies until rumor of it spread far; Xi Jian was a descendant of Xi Zheng.

manualTranslations.zh: 而并州殺刺史張壹，涼州殺刺史耿鄙，焉謀得施。
manualTranslations.literal: Meanwhile Bing Province killed Inspector Zhang Yi, and Liang Province killed Inspector Geng Bi; Yan’s plan could be carried out.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Bing Province slew Inspector Zhang Yi and Liang slew Inspector Geng Bi, Liu Yan’s scheme could finally move forward.

manualTranslations.zh: 出為監軍使者，領益州牧，封陽城侯，當收儉治罪；
manualTranslations.literal: He went out as supervisory army envoy, took charge as governor of Yizhou, was enfeoffed as Marquis of Yangcheng, and was to arrest Jian and punish him according to law;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was sent out as supervisory army envoy with the governorship of Yizhou, enfeoffed as Marquis of Yangcheng, and charged to seize Xi Jian and bring him to justice;

manualTranslations.zh: 《續漢書》曰：是時用劉虞為幽州，劉焉為益州，劉表為荊州，賈琮為冀州。
manualTranslations.literal: The Continuation of the Book of Han says: At this time Liu Yu was appointed to You Province, Liu Yan to Yizhou, Liu Biao to Jing Province, and Jia Cong to Ji Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Continuation of the Book of Han records that Liu Yu was made governor of You, Liu Yan of Yizhou, Liu Biao of Jing, and Jia Cong of Ji.

manualTranslations.zh: 虞等皆海內清名之士，或從列卿尚書以選為牧伯，各以本秩居任。
manualTranslations.literal: Yu and the others were all men of pure reputation within the realm; some were chosen as regional shepherds from among ranked ministers and masters of writing, each holding office at his original rank.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: All were men of spotless reputation; some were promoted from the ranks of ministers and palace secretaries to provincial governorships while retaining their former titles.

manualTranslations.zh: 舊典：傳車參駕，施赤為帷裳。
manualTranslations.literal: According to old precedent: relay carriages with three teams, red drapery used as curtains and canopies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: By ancient custom they traveled in relay carriages with three teams and red drapery as their canopy.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣松之按：靈帝崩後，義軍起，孫堅殺荊州刺史王叡，然後劉表為荊州，不與焉同時也。
manualTranslations.literal: Your servant Songzhi notes: After Emperor Ling’s death righteous armies rose; Sun Jian killed Inspector of Jing Province Wang Rui, and only then was Liu Biao made governor of Jing—he was not appointed at the same time as Yan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Pei Songzhi remarks: After Emperor Ling died and the loyalist armies rose, Sun Jian killed Jing inspector Wang Rui; Liu Biao’s appointment to Jing came only afterward and was not contemporaneous with Liu Yan’s.

manualTranslations.zh: 《漢靈帝紀》曰：帝引見焉，宣示方略，加以賞賜，敕焉為益州刺史。
manualTranslations.literal: The Annals of Emperor Ling of Han say: The emperor summoned Yan for audience, displayed strategy and plans, bestowed rewards, and ordered Yan to be inspector of Yizhou.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Annals of Emperor Ling record that the emperor received Liu Yan in audience, laid out his plans, rewarded him, and appointed him inspector of Yizhou.

manualTranslations.zh: 前刺史劉雋、郤儉皆貪殘放濫，取受狼籍，元元無聊，呼嗟充野，焉到便收攝行法，以示萬姓，勿令漏露，使癰疽決潰，為國生梗。
manualTranslations.literal: The former inspectors Liu Juan and Xi Jian were both greedy, cruel, and unrestrained; their taking and receiving were in disorder; the common people were destitute; cries of lament filled the wilds. When Yan arrived he was to gather them in and enforce the law, to show the myriad people, not letting leaks appear, so that the abscess might burst and drain and not become a running sore for the state.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His predecessors Liu Juan and Xi Jian had been rapacious and lawless, their extortion so rampant that the people were destitute and the countryside rang with lament. Yan was to arrest them at once, enforce the law before the people, and drain the abscess before it festered into a national crisis.

manualTranslations.zh: 焉受命而行，以道路不通，住荊州東界。
manualTranslations.literal: Yan received the command and set out; because the roads were impassable, he halted on the eastern border of Jing Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Liu Yan set out on his commission but, with the roads blocked, halted on Jing Province’s eastern frontier.

manualTranslations.zh: 扶亦求為蜀郡西部屬國都尉，及太倉令
manualTranslations.literal: Fu also requested appointment as commandant of the dependent state in the western part of Shu Commandery, and the grand granary director
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Dong Fu likewise sought the post of commandant of the dependent state in western Shu Commandery, while the director of the imperial granary

manualTranslations.literal: (hui “meeting” [variant])
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Some manuscripts insert “meeting” here.

manualTranslations.zh: 巴西趙韙去官，俱隨焉。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhao Wei of Baxi left office; all followed Yan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhao Wei of Baxi resigned his post and went with him.

manualTranslations.zh: 陳壽《益部耆舊傳》曰：董扶字茂安。
manualTranslations.literal: Chen Shou’s Records of Elders of Yibu says: Dong Fu, courtesy name Mao’an.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chen Shou’s Records of Elders of Yibu records: Dong Fu, courtesy name Mao’an.

manualTranslations.zh: 少從師學，兼通數經，善歐陽尚書，又事聘士楊厚，究極圖讖。
manualTranslations.literal: In youth he followed teachers in study, mastered several classics, excelled in Ouyang’s Book of Documents, and also served the reclusive scholar Yang Hou, thoroughly investigating charts and prognostications.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As a youth he studied under several masters, mastered multiple classics and Ouyang Gao’s version of the Book of Documents, and served the reclusive scholar Yang Hou in the study of prognostic charts.

manualTranslations.zh: 遂至京師，遊覽太學，還家講授，弟子自遠而至。
manualTranslations.literal: Then he reached the capital, toured the Imperial Academy, returned home to lecture and teach, and disciples came from afar.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He went to the capital, studied at the Imperial Academy, then returned home to teach; students came from far and wide.

manualTranslations.zh: 永康元年167年，日有蝕之，詔舉賢良方正之士，策問得失。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Yongkang, 167, there was a solar eclipse; an edict summoned worthy and upright candidates, and policy questions were put on gains and losses.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In 167, the first year of Yongkang, a solar eclipse prompted an edict summoning worthy and upright candidates for written policy examinations.

manualTranslations.zh: 左馮翊趙謙等舉扶，扶以病不詣，遙於長安上封事，遂稱疾篤歸家。
manualTranslations.literal: Zuo Fengyi Zhao Qian and others recommended Fu; Fu, citing illness, did not go; from afar at Chang’an he submitted a sealed memorial, then claimed grave illness and returned home.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhao Qian of Zuofengyi and others recommended him, but Fu pleaded illness and stayed away, submitting a sealed memorial from Chang’an before declaring himself gravely ill and going home.

manualTranslations.zh: 前後宰府十闢，公車三徵，再舉賢良方正、博士、有道皆不就，名稱尤重。
manualTranslations.literal: Before and after, ten summonses came from chief ministers’ offices, three imperial carriage summonses, and twice he was recommended as worthy and upright, as erudite, and as possessing the Way—he accepted none; his reputation was especially weighty.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Provincial and central offices summoned him ten times, the imperial carriage three times, and he was twice recommended as worthy, erudite, and virtuous—yet he refused every call, and his fame only grew.

manualTranslations.zh: 大將軍何進表薦扶曰：「資遊、夏之德，述孔氏之風，內懷焦、董消復之術。
manualTranslations.literal: Grand General He Jin memorialized recommending Fu, saying: “He possesses the virtue of You and Xia, expounds the style of the Kong clan, and inwardly holds the restorative arts of Jiao and Dong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Grand General He Jin memorialized in his favor: “He has the virtue of the ancient sages You and Xia, carries forward Confucius’s teaching, and holds within him the restorative arts of Jiao and Dong.

manualTranslations.zh: 方今並、涼騷擾，西戎蠢叛，宜敕公車特召，待以異禮，諮謀奇策。」
manualTranslations.literal: Now Bing and Liang are in turmoil, the western Rong foolishly rebel; it is fitting to order the imperial carriage to summon him specially, treat him with exceptional ceremony, and consult him on extraordinary plans.”
manualTranslations.idiomatic: With Bing and Liang in turmoil and the western tribes in revolt, the throne should summon him by imperial carriage with exceptional honors and seek his counsel on extraordinary measures.”

manualTranslations.zh: 於是靈帝徵扶，即拜侍中。
manualTranslations.literal: Thereupon Emperor Ling summoned Fu and immediately appointed him Palace Attendant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Ling then summoned Dong Fu and appointed him palace attendant on the spot.

manualTranslations.zh: 在朝稱為儒宗，甚見器重。
manualTranslations.literal: At court he was called the patriarch of scholars and was greatly valued and trusted.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At court he was hailed as the leading Confucian scholar and won deep respect.

manualTranslations.zh: 求為蜀郡屬國都尉。
manualTranslations.literal: He requested appointment as commandant of the dependent state in Shu Commandery.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He asked for the post of commandant of Shu’s dependent state.

manualTranslations.zh: 扶出一歲而靈帝崩，天下大亂。
manualTranslations.literal: Fu had been out one year when Emperor Ling died and the realm fell into great chaos.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: A year after he left the capital Emperor Ling died and the empire plunged into chaos.

manualTranslations.zh: 後去官，年八十二卒於家。
manualTranslations.literal: Later he left office; at age eighty-two he died at home.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He later resigned and died at home at eighty-two.

manualTranslations.zh: 始扶發辭抗論，益部少雙，故號曰
manualTranslations.literal: At first, when Fu began to speak in refutation and debate, few in Yibu could match him; therefore he was styled
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From the start his debating was unmatched in Yizhou, so he was nicknamed

manualTranslations.zh: （致止）
manualTranslations.literal: (zhizhi “to stop” [variant])
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Some manuscripts read “Zhizhi” (“he who stops”).

manualTranslations.zh: 〔至止〕，言人莫能當，所至而談止也。
manualTranslations.literal: [Zhizhi “to the stop”], meaning no one could withstand him—wherever he went discussion ceased.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: “Zhizhi”—“the one who stops all talk”—for wherever he went debate fell silent.

manualTranslations.zh: 後丞相諸葛亮問秦宓以扶所長，宓曰：「董扶褒秋毫之善，貶纖芥之惡。」
manualTranslations.literal: Later Chancellor Zhuge Liang asked Qin Mi about Fu’s strengths; Mi said: “Dong Fu praises the good even in an autumn down, and condemns evil even in a fiber of grass.”
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Later Chancellor Zhuge Liang asked Qin Mi what Dong Fu excelled at. Mi replied: “Dong Fu praises goodness down to the finest hair and condemns wrongdoing down to the smallest flaw.”

manualTranslations.zh: 是時〔益〕州逆賊馬相、趙祗等於綿竹縣自號黃巾，合聚疲役之民，一二日中得數千人，先殺綿竹令李升，吏民翕集，合萬餘人，便前破雒縣，攻益州殺儉，又到蜀郡、犍為，旬月之間，破壞三郡。
manualTranslations.literal: At this time [Yi] Province’s rebel bandits Ma Xiang, Zhao Qi, and others at Mianzhu County styled themselves Yellow Turbans; they gathered exhausted conscripted people; in one or two days they obtained several thousand men; first they killed Mianzhu magistrate Li Sheng; officials and common people flocked together, totaling more than ten thousand; then they advanced and broke Luoxian, attacked Yizhou and killed Jian, then went to Shu Commandery and Qianwei; within a month or so they destroyed three commanderies.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: About then rebels Ma Xiang and Zhao Qi in Yizhou raised the Yellow Turban banner at Mianzhu, sweeping up worn-out conscripts. Within a day or two they had thousands of followers; they slew Magistrate Li Sheng, and officials and townsfolk rallied until their host passed ten thousand. They took Luoxian, struck down Inspector Xi Jian of Yizhou, then swept through Shu and Qianwei—three commanderies ruined inside a month.

sourceRange.text: 《魏書》曰：備聞曹公薨，遣掾韓冉奉書吊，並致賻贈之禮。文帝惡其因喪求好，敕荊州刺史斬冉，絕使命。《典略》曰：備遣軍謀掾韓冉齎書吊，並貢錦布。冉稱疾，住上庸。上庸致其書，適會受終，有詔報答以引致之。備得報書，遂稱制。章武元年夏四月，大赦，改年。以諸葛亮為丞相，許靖為司徒。置百官，立宗廟，祫祭高皇帝以下。臣松之以為先主雖云出自孝景，而世數悠遠，昭穆難明，既紹漢祚，不知以何帝為元祖以立親廟。於時英賢作輔，儒生在宮，宗廟制度，必有憲章，而載記闕略，良可恨哉！五月，立皇后吳氏，子禪為皇太子。六月，以子永為魯王，理為梁王。車騎將軍張飛為其左右所害。初，先主忿孫權之襲關羽，將東征，秋七月，遂帥諸軍伐吳。孫權遣書請和，先主盛怒不許，吳將陸議、李異、劉阿等屯巫、秭歸；將軍吳班、馮習自巫攻破異等，軍次秭歸，武陵五谿蠻夷遣使請兵。

context.beforeSource: 脩燔瘞，告類於天神，惟神饗祚於漢家，永綏四海！

manualTranslations.zh: 《魏書》曰：備聞曹公薨，遣掾韓冉奉書吊，並致賻贈之禮。
manualTranslations.literal: The Book of Wei says: Bei heard Lord Cao had died; he sent aide Han Ran to present a letter of condolence and also convey funeral gifts.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Book of Wei records that when Liu Bei heard Cao Cao had died, he sent aide Han Ran with a letter of condolence and funeral gifts.

manualTranslations.zh: 文帝惡其因喪求好，敕荊州刺史斬冉，絕使命。
manualTranslations.literal: Emperor Wen hated that he sought friendship through mourning; he ordered the inspector of Jing Province to execute Ran and cut off the mission.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Wen resented the overture at a time of mourning and ordered the inspector of Jing province to execute Han Ran and break off contact.

manualTranslations.zh: 《典略》曰：備遣軍謀掾韓冉齎書吊，並貢錦布。
manualTranslations.literal: The Brief Account says: Bei sent army planning aide Han Ran bearing a letter of condolence and also presenting tribute of brocade and cloth.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Brief Account says Liu Bei sent army planning aide Han Ran with condolences and tribute of brocade and cloth.

manualTranslations.zh: 冉稱疾，住上庸。
manualTranslations.literal: Ran claimed illness and stayed at Shangyong.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Han Ran pleaded illness and remained at Shangyong.

manualTranslations.zh: 上庸致其書，適會受終，有詔報答以引致之。
manualTranslations.literal: Shangyong forwarded his letter; it happened to coincide with receiving the end of the mandate; there was an edict to reply and draw him in.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Shangyong forwarded his letter just as Cao Pi succeeded; an edict answered him in order to draw Liu Bei in.

manualTranslations.zh: 備得報書，遂稱制。
manualTranslations.literal: Bei received the reply letter and thereupon styled himself regent by imperial command.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Liu Bei received the reply and thereupon assumed regency in his own name.

manualTranslations.zh: 章武元年夏四月，大赦，改年。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fourth month of summer in the first year of Zhangwu, a general amnesty was proclaimed and the reign title was changed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fourth month of summer in Zhangwu 1 (221) he proclaimed a general amnesty and changed the reign title.

manualTranslations.zh: 以諸葛亮為丞相，許靖為司徒。
manualTranslations.literal: He made Zhuge Liang chancellor and Xu Jing minister over the masses.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He named Zhuge Liang chancellor and Xu Jing minister over the masses.

manualTranslations.zh: 置百官，立宗廟，祫祭高皇帝以下。
manualTranslations.literal: He established the hundred offices, erected the ancestral temples, and performed the joint sacrifice from High Emperor downward.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He set up the hundred offices, erected the ancestral temples, and performed the joint rite for the line from Emperor Gao downward.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣松之以為先主雖云出自孝景，而世數悠遠，昭穆難明，既紹漢祚，不知以何帝為元祖以立親廟。
manualTranslations.literal: Your subject Songzhi considers that although the Former Lord said he sprang from Emperor Jing, generations are remote and senior and junior lines are hard to clarify; having succeeded to the Han throne, one does not know which emperor to take as founding ancestor to establish the intimate temple.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Pei Songzhi observes that although Liu Bei traced his line to Emperor Jing, the generations are remote and the temple generations unclear; having taken the Han succession, it is unclear which emperor should stand as founding ancestor for the intimate temple.

manualTranslations.zh: 於時英賢作輔，儒生在宮，宗廟制度，必有憲章，而載記闕略，良可恨哉！
manualTranslations.literal: At that time worthy heroes served as assistants and Confucian scholars were in the palace; ancestral temple regulations surely had statutes, yet the record is deficient and brief—truly regrettable!
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Worthy ministers and Confucian scholars were then at court; ancestral temple law surely existed, yet the record is maddeningly brief.

manualTranslations.zh: 五月，立皇后吳氏，子禪為皇太子。
manualTranslations.literal: In the fifth month he installed Lady Wu as empress and made his son Shan imperial crown prince.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the fifth month he installed Empress Wu and named his son Shan crown prince.

manualTranslations.zh: 六月，以子永為魯王，理為梁王。
manualTranslations.literal: In the sixth month he made his son Yong King of Lu and Li King of Liang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the sixth month he made his son Yong king of Lu and his son Li king of Liang.

manualTranslations.zh: 車騎將軍張飛為其左右所害。
manualTranslations.literal: General of Chariots and Cavalry Zhang Fei was killed by his attendants.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: General of chariots and cavalry Zhang Fei was murdered by his own attendants.

manualTranslations.zh: 初，先主忿孫權之襲關羽，將東征，秋七月，遂帥諸軍伐吳。
manualTranslations.literal: At first the Former Lord resented Sun Quan's raid on Guan Yu and meant to campaign east; in the seventh month of autumn he thereupon led the various armies to attack Wu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Angered by Sun Quan's strike against Guan Yu, the Former Lord marched east in the seventh month of autumn at the head of his armies against Wu.

manualTranslations.zh: 孫權遣書請和，先主盛怒不許，吳將陸議、李異、劉阿等屯巫、秭歸；
manualTranslations.literal: Sun Quan sent a letter seeking peace; the Former Lord in great rage would not permit it; Wu generals Lu Yi, Li Yi, Liu A and others garrisoned Wu and Zigui;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sun Quan sent peace overtures, but the Former Lord in fury refused; Lu Xun, Li Yi, Liu A, and other Wu generals camped at Wu and Zigui;

manualTranslations.zh: 將軍吳班、馮習自巫攻破異等，軍次秭歸，武陵五谿蠻夷遣使請兵。
manualTranslations.literal: Generals Wu Ban and Feng Xi from Wu broke Li Yi and the others; the army halted at Zigui; Wuling Five Ravines barbarians sent envoys requesting troops.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wu Ban and Feng Xi broke the Wu line from Wu itself and advanced to Zigui; the Five Ravines tribes of Wuling sent envoys asking for troops.

sourceRange.text: 袁紹攻公孫瓚，先主與田楷東屯齊。曹公征徐州，徐州牧陶謙遣使告急於田楷，楷與先主俱救之。時先主自有兵千餘人及幽州烏丸雜胡騎，又略得饑民數千人。既到，謙以丹楊兵四千益先主，先主遂去楷歸謙。謙表先主為豫州刺史，屯小沛。謙病篤，謂別駕麋竺曰：「非劉備不能安此州也。」謙死，竺率州人迎先主，先主未敢當。下邳陳登謂先主曰：「今漢室陵遲，海內傾覆，立功立事，在於今日。彼州殷富，戶口百萬，欲屈使君撫臨州事。」先主曰：「袁公路近在壽春，此君四世五公，海內所歸，君可以州與之。」登曰：「公路驕豪，非治亂之主。今欲為使君合步騎十萬，上可以匡主濟民，成五霸之業，下可以割地守境，書功於竹帛。若使君不見聽許，登亦未敢聽使君也。」北海相孔融謂先主曰：「袁公路豈憂國忘家者邪？冢中枯骨，何足介意。今日之事，百姓與能，天與不取，悔不可追。」先主遂領徐州。《獻帝春秋》曰：陳登等遣使詣袁紹曰：「天降災沴，禍臻鄙州，州將殂殞，生民無主，恐懼姦雄一旦承隙，以貽盟主日昃之憂，輒共奉故平原相劉備府君以為宗主，永使百姓知有依歸。方今寇難縱橫，不遑釋甲，謹遣下吏奔告于執事。」紹答曰：「劉玄德弘雅有信義，今徐州樂戴之，誠副所望也。」袁術來攻先主，先主拒之於盱眙、淮陰。曹公表先主為鎮東將軍，封宜城亭侯，是歲建安元年也。先主與術相持經月，呂布乘虛襲下邳。下邳守將曹豹反，閒迎布。布虜先主妻子，先主轉軍海西。《英雄記》曰：備留張飛守下邳，引兵與袁術戰於淮陰石亭，更有勝負。陶謙故將曹豹在下邳，張飛欲殺之。豹眾堅營自守，使人招呂布。布取下邳，張飛敗走。備聞之，引兵還，比至下邳，兵潰。收散卒東取廣陵，與袁術戰，又敗。楊奉、韓暹寇徐、揚閒，先主邀擊，盡斬之。先主求和於呂布，布還其妻子。先主遣關羽守下邳。先主還小沛，《英雄記》曰：備軍在廣陵，飢餓困踧，吏士大小自相噉食，窮餓侵逼，欲還小沛，遂使吏請降布。

context.beforeSource: 眾多歸焉。
context.afterSource: 布令備還州，并勢擊術。

manualTranslations.zh: 袁紹攻公孫瓚，先主與田楷東屯齊。
manualTranslations.literal: Yuan Shao attacked Gongsun Zan; the Former Lord with Tian Kai camped east at Qi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Yuan Shao attacked Gongsun Zan, Liu Bei and Tian Kai camped east in Qi.

manualTranslations.zh: 曹公征徐州，徐州牧陶謙遣使告急於田楷，楷與先主俱救之。
manualTranslations.literal: Lord Cao campaigned against Xu Province; Xu Province Governor Tao Qian sent envoys in urgent appeal to Tian Kai; Kai and the Former Lord together went to rescue him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Cao Cao marched on Xu province, Governor Tao Qian appealed to Tian Kai, and Kai and Liu Bei went together to his aid.

manualTranslations.zh: 時先主自有兵千餘人及幽州烏丸雜胡騎，又略得饑民數千人。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time the Former Lord himself had more than a thousand troops and mixed Wuhuan and foreign cavalry from You Province, and also gathered several thousand starving commoners.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Liu Bei then had a little over a thousand men of his own plus Wuhuan and foreign cavalry from You province, and he also pressed several thousand hungry refugees into service.

manualTranslations.zh: 既到，謙以丹楊兵四千益先主，先主遂去楷歸謙。
manualTranslations.literal: When they arrived, Qian with four thousand Danyang troops augmented the Former Lord; the Former Lord thereupon left Kai and returned to Qian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On arrival Tao Qian gave him four thousand Danyang troops; Liu Bei then left Tian Kai and attached himself to Tao Qian.

manualTranslations.zh: 謙表先主為豫州刺史，屯小沛。
manualTranslations.literal: Qian memorialized the Former Lord as inspector of Yu Province and garrisoned him at Little Pei.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tao Qian memorialized him as inspector of Yu province and posted him at Little Pei.

manualTranslations.zh: 謙病篤，謂別駕麋竺曰：「非劉備不能安此州也。
manualTranslations.literal: Qian was gravely ill; he said to chief aide Mi Zhu: "If not Liu Bei, this province cannot be settled.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: As Tao Qian lay gravely ill he told chief aide Mi Zhu, "Only Liu Bei can secure this province.

manualTranslations.zh: 」謙死，竺率州人迎先主，先主未敢當。
manualTranslations.literal: " When Qian died, Zhu led the province's people to welcome the Former Lord; the Former Lord did not yet dare accept.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " When Tao Qian died, Mi Zhu led the people to offer him the province, but Liu Bei did not yet dare accept.

manualTranslations.zh: 下邳陳登謂先主曰：「今漢室陵遲，海內傾覆，立功立事，在於今日。
manualTranslations.literal: Chen Deng of Xiapi said to the Former Lord: "Now the house of Han declines; all within the seas overturns; to establish merit and accomplish enterprise is a matter of today.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Chen Deng of Xiapi told him, "The house of Han is failing and the realm is overturned; the moment to build a career is now.

manualTranslations.zh: 彼州殷富，戶口百萬，欲屈使君撫臨州事。
manualTranslations.literal: That province is rich and populous, a million households; we wish to bend you, my lord, to oversee the province's affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: This province is rich and holds a million households; we ask you to take charge of it.

manualTranslations.zh: 」先主曰：「袁公路近在壽春，此君四世五公，海內所歸，君可以州與之。
manualTranslations.literal: " The Former Lord said: "Lord Yuan Shu is near at Shouchun; this lord is four generations and five dukes; all within the seas turn to him; you may give the province to him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " Liu Bei answered, "Yuan Shu is close at Shouchun—a man of four generations and five marquisates whom the realm follows; you might give the province to him.

manualTranslations.zh: 」登曰：「公路驕豪，非治亂之主。
manualTranslations.literal: " Deng said: "Lord Shu is arrogant and overbearing; he is not a ruler for order and disorder.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " Chen Deng replied, "Yuan Shu is arrogant and no ruler for troubled times.

manualTranslations.zh: 今欲為使君合步騎十萬，上可以匡主濟民，成五霸之業，下可以割地守境，書功於竹帛。
manualTranslations.literal: Now I wish for you, my lord, to assemble a hundred thousand foot and horse; upward you may support the ruler and aid the people, accomplishing the enterprise of the Five Hegemons; downward you may carve territory and guard the borders, inscribing merit on bamboo and silk.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I can raise a hundred thousand foot and horse for you—high enough to restore the ruler and aid the people in a hegemon's work, low enough to hold territory and inscribe your merit on bamboo and silk.

manualTranslations.zh: 若使君不見聽許，登亦未敢聽使君也。
manualTranslations.literal: If you, my lord, do not heed and permit this, Deng also dares not heed you, my lord.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If you will not accept, I dare not accept you either.

manualTranslations.zh: 」北海相孔融謂先主曰：「袁公路豈憂國忘家者邪？
manualTranslations.literal: " Beihai Chancellor Kong Rong said to the Former Lord: "Is Lord Yuan Shu one who grieves for the state and forgets his family?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " Beihai chancellor Kong Rong told him, "Is Yuan Shu a man who cares for the state and forgets his family?

manualTranslations.zh: 冢中枯骨，何足介意。
manualTranslations.literal: A withered bone in a tomb—what is there worth minding?
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He is a withered bone in a tomb—why heed him?

manualTranslations.zh: 今日之事，百姓與能，天與不取，悔不可追。
manualTranslations.literal: In today's affair, the people grant the capacity; Heaven grants it—if you do not take it, regret cannot be pursued.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The people offer you the charge; Heaven offers it—if you refuse, regret will not wait.

manualTranslations.zh: 」先主遂領徐州。
manualTranslations.literal: " The Former Lord thereupon took charge of Xu Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " Liu Bei thereupon took charge of Xu province.

manualTranslations.zh: 《獻帝春秋》曰：陳登等遣使詣袁紹曰：「天降災沴，禍臻鄙州，州將殂殞，生民無主，恐懼姦雄一旦承隙，以貽盟主日昃之憂，輒共奉故平原相劉備府君以為宗主，永使百姓知有依歸。
manualTranslations.literal: The Spring and Autumn of Emperor Xian says: Chen Deng and others sent envoys to Yuan Shao saying: "Heaven sends disaster and pestilence; calamity reaches our humble province; the provincial lord has died; the living people have no lord; we fear treacherous heroes will seize the gap in a day, to burden the alliance leader with the worry of the setting sun; we together install the former grand administrator of Pingyuan, Lord Liu Bei, as our clan leader, forever letting the people know they have dependence and return.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Spring and Autumn of Emperor Xian records that Chen Deng and others sent envoys to Yuan Shao: "Heaven has sent disaster upon our province; our governor is dead and the people are leaderless; we fear traitors will seize the moment and trouble our alliance lord at day's end; we have installed the former grand administrator of Pingyuan, Liu Bei, as our leader so the people may know where to turn.

manualTranslations.zh: 方今寇難縱橫，不遑釋甲，謹遣下吏奔告于執事。
manualTranslations.literal: Now bandit hardship runs crosswise; we have no leisure to lay down armor; respectfully we send subordinate clerks running to report to the chief.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Bandits run wild and we cannot yet lay down our arms; we respectfully send clerks to report to you.

manualTranslations.zh: 」紹答曰：「劉玄德弘雅有信義，今徐州樂戴之，誠副所望也。
manualTranslations.literal: " Shao answered: "Liu Xuande is broad and elegant and has faith and righteousness; now Xu Province gladly honors him—truly it matches what was hoped.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " Yuan Shao answered, "Liu Bei is generous and trustworthy; Xu province gladly follows him—this truly matches our hopes.

manualTranslations.zh: 」袁術來攻先主，先主拒之於盱眙、淮陰。
manualTranslations.literal: " Yuan Shu came to attack the Former Lord; the Former Lord resisted him at Xuyi and Huaiyin.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: " Yuan Shu attacked Liu Bei, who held him at Xuyi and Huaiyin.

manualTranslations.zh: 曹公表先主為鎮東將軍，封宜城亭侯，是歲建安元年也。
manualTranslations.literal: Lord Cao memorialized the Former Lord as General Who Guards the East and enfeoffed him as Marquis of Yicheng precinct; that year was the first year of Jian'an.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Cao Cao memorialized him as general who guards the east and enfeoffed him as Marquis of Yicheng precinct; that year was Jian'an 1 (196).

manualTranslations.zh: 先主與術相持經月，呂布乘虛襲下邳。
manualTranslations.literal: The Former Lord and Shu faced each other for a month; Lu Bu seized the opening and raided Xiapi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After a month locked with Yuan Shu, Lu Bu struck Xiapi while Liu Bei's guard was thin.

manualTranslations.zh: 下邳守將曹豹反，閒迎布。
manualTranslations.literal: Xiapi garrison general Cao Bao rebelled and secretly welcomed Bu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Cao Bao, the Xiapi garrison commander, rebelled and secretly admitted Lu Bu.

manualTranslations.zh: 布虜先主妻子，先主轉軍海西。
manualTranslations.literal: Bu captured the Former Lord's wife and children; the Former Lord shifted his army to Haixi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lu Bu seized Liu Bei's wives and children, and Liu Bei withdrew toward Haixi.

manualTranslations.zh: 《英雄記》曰：備留張飛守下邳，引兵與袁術戰於淮陰石亭，更有勝負。
manualTranslations.literal: The Record of Heroes says: Bei left Zhang Fei to guard Xiapi and led troops to fight Yuan Shu at Shiting in Huaiyin; again there were victories and defeats.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Record of Heroes says Liu Bei left Zhang Fei at Xiapi and fought Yuan Shu at Shiting in Huaiyin with mixed results.

manualTranslations.zh: 陶謙故將曹豹在下邳，張飛欲殺之。
manualTranslations.literal: Tao Qian's former general Cao Bao was at Xiapi; Zhang Fei wished to kill him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Tao Qian's old officer Cao Bao was at Xiapi, and Zhang Fei meant to kill him.

manualTranslations.zh: 豹眾堅營自守，使人招呂布。
manualTranslations.literal: Bao's host fortified the camp and held in self-defense; he sent men to summon Lu Bu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Cao Bao fortified his camp and sent for Lu Bu.

manualTranslations.zh: 布取下邳，張飛敗走。
manualTranslations.literal: Bu took Xiapi; Zhang Fei was defeated and fled.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lu Bu took Xiapi and Zhang Fei fled in defeat.

manualTranslations.zh: 備聞之，引兵還，比至下邳，兵潰。
manualTranslations.literal: When Bei heard this, he led troops back; by the time he reached Xiapi, the army collapsed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hearing this, Liu Bei marched back, but his army collapsed before he reached Xiapi.

manualTranslations.zh: 收散卒東取廣陵，與袁術戰，又敗。
manualTranslations.literal: He gathered scattered soldiers and went east to take Guangling; he fought Yuan Shu and was again defeated.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He gathered stragglers and struck east for Guangling, fought Yuan Shu again, and lost again.

manualTranslations.zh: 楊奉、韓暹寇徐、揚閒，先主邀擊，盡斬之。
manualTranslations.literal: Yang Feng and Han Xian raided the borders of Xu and Yang; the Former Lord intercepted and struck them and beheaded them all.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Yang Feng and Han Xian raided the Xu and Yang borderlands, Liu Bei intercepted them and cut them down to the last man.

manualTranslations.zh: 先主求和於呂布，布還其妻子。
manualTranslations.literal: The Former Lord sought peace with Lu Bu; Bu returned his wife and children.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Liu Bei sued for peace with Lu Bu, who returned his wives and children.

manualTranslations.zh: 先主遣關羽守下邳。
manualTranslations.literal: The Former Lord sent Guan Yu to guard Xiapi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Liu Bei sent Guan Yu to hold Xiapi.

items.acceptedSourceText: 袁紹攻公孫瓚，先主與田楷東屯齊。曹公征徐州，徐州牧陶謙遣使告急於田楷，楷與先主俱救之。時先主自有兵千餘人及幽州烏丸雜胡騎，又略得饑民數千人。既到，謙以丹楊兵四千益先主，先主遂去楷歸謙。謙表先主為豫州刺史，屯小沛。謙病篤，謂別駕麋竺曰：「非劉備不能安此州也。」謙死，竺率州人迎先主，先主未敢當。下邳陳登謂先主曰：「今漢室陵遲，海內傾覆，立功立事，在於今日。彼州殷富，戶口百萬，欲屈使君撫臨州事。」先主曰：「袁公路近在壽春，此君四世五公，海內所歸，君可以州與之。」登曰：「公路驕豪，非治亂之主。今欲為使君合步騎十萬，上可以匡主濟民，成五霸之業，下可以割地守境，書功於竹帛。若使君不見聽許，登亦未敢聽使君也。」北海相孔融謂先主曰：「袁公路豈憂國忘家者邪？冢中枯骨，何足介意。今日之事，百姓與能，天與不取，悔不可追。」先主遂領徐州。《獻帝春秋》曰：陳登等遣使詣袁紹曰：「天降災沴，禍臻鄙州，州將殂殞，生民無主，恐懼姦雄一旦承隙，以貽盟主日昃之憂，輒共奉故平原相劉備府君以為宗主，永使百姓知有依歸。方今寇難縱橫，不遑釋甲，謹遣下吏奔告于執事。」紹答曰：「劉玄德弘雅有信義，今徐州樂戴之，誠副所望也。」袁術來攻先主，先主拒之於盱眙、淮陰。曹公表先主為鎮東將軍，封宜城亭侯，是歲建安元年也。先主與術相持經月，呂布乘虛襲下邳。下邳守將曹豹反，閒迎布。布虜先主妻子，先主轉軍海西。《英雄記》曰：備留張飛守下邳，引兵與袁術戰於淮陰石亭，更有勝負。陶謙故將曹豹在下邳，張飛欲殺之。豹眾堅營自守，使人招呂布。布取下邳，張飛敗走。備聞之，引兵還，比至下邳，兵潰。收散卒東取廣陵，與袁術戰，又敗。楊奉、韓暹寇徐、揚閒，先主邀擊，盡斬之。先主求和於呂布，布還其妻子。先主遣關羽守下邳。

sourceRange.text: __FORCETOC__==後主劉禪==後主諱禪，字公嗣，先主子也。建安二十四年，先主為漢中王，立為王太子。及即尊號，冊曰：「惟章武元年五月辛巳，皇帝若曰：太子禪，朕遭漢運艱難，賊臣篡盜，社稷無主，格人群正，以天明命，朕繼大統。今以禪為皇太子，以承宗廟，祗肅社稷。使使持節丞相亮授印綬，敬聽師傅，行一物而三善皆得焉，可不勉與！」《禮記》曰：行一物而三善者，惟世子而已，其齒於學之謂也。鄭玄日：物猶事也。三年夏四月，先主殂於永安宮。五月，後主襲位於成都，時年十七，尊皇后曰皇太后。大赦，改元。是歲魏黃初四年也。《魏略》曰：初備在小沛，不意曹公卒至，遑遽棄家屬，後奔荊州。禪時年數歲，竄匿，隨人西入漢中，為人所賣。及建安十六年，關中破亂，扶風人劉括避亂入漢中，買得禪，問知其良家子，遂養為子，與娶婦，生一子。初禪與備相失時，識其父字玄德。比舍人有姓簡者，及備得益州而簡為將軍，備遣簡到漢中，舍都邸。禪乃詣簡，簡相檢訊，事皆符驗。簡喜，以語張魯，魯（乃）洗沐送詣益州，備乃立以為太子。初備以諸葛亮為太子太傅，及禪立，以亮為丞相，委以諸事，謂亮曰：「政由葛氏，祭則寡人。」亮亦以禪未閒於政，遂總內外。臣松之案：〈二主妃子傳〉曰“後主生於荊州”，〈後主傳〉云「初即帝位，年十七」，則建安十二年生也。十三年敗於長阪，備棄妻子走，〈趙雲傳〉曰「雲身抱弱子以免」，即後主也。如此，備與禪未嘗相失也。又諸葛亮以禪立之明年領益州牧，其年與主簿杜微書曰「朝廷今年十八」，與禪傳相應，理當非虛。而魚豢云備敗於小沛，禪時年始生，及奔荊州，能識其父字玄德，計當五六歲。備敗於小沛時，建安五年也，至禪初立，首尾二十四年，禪應過二十矣。以事相驗，理不得然。此則《魏略》之妄說，乃至二百餘言，異也！又案諸書記及《諸葛亮集》，亮亦不為太子太傅。建興元年223年夏，臧柯太守朱褒擁郡反。
