manualTranslations.zh: 初，皓常銜凱數犯顏忤旨，加何定譖構非-，既以重臣，難繩以法，又陸抗時為大將在疆場，故以計容忍。
manualTranslations.literal: At first Hao continually harbored resentment because Kai repeatedly offended him and defied his will; moreover He Ding slandered and fabricated charges against him. Since Kai was a high minister, Hao could not easily punish him by law; furthermore Lu Kang then served as Grand General on the frontier, so by policy Hao endured it.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At first Sun Hao resented Lu Kai for repeatedly speaking bluntly and defying his will, and He Ding piled on slander. Because Kai was a senior minister, Hao could not easily punish him by law; Lu Kang still commanded on the frontier, so Hao endured it by policy.

manualTranslations.zh: 抗卒後，竟徙凱家於建安。
manualTranslations.literal: After Kang died, Hao at last moved Kai's household to Jian'an.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Lu Kang died, Hao at last moved Lu Kai's household to Jian'an.

manualTranslations.zh: 或曰寶鼎元年十二月，凱與大司馬丁奉、御史大夫丁固謀，因皓謁廟，欲廢皓立孫休子。
manualTranslations.literal: Some say in the twelfth month of Baoding 1 Kai plotted with Grand Marshal Ding Feng and Censor-in-chief Ding Gu, taking advantage of Hao's temple visit, to depose Hao and install Sun Xiu's son.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Some say that in the twelfth month of Baoding 1 Lu Kai plotted with Grand Marshal Ding Feng and Censor-in-chief Ding Gu to use Sun Hao's temple visit to depose him and install Sun Xiu's son.

manualTranslations.zh: 時左將軍留平領兵先驅，故密語平，平拒而不許，誓以不洩，是以所圖不果。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time Left General Liu Ping led troops as vanguard, so they secretly spoke to Ping; Ping refused and would not assent, swearing not to leak the matter—therefore the plot failed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Left General Liu Ping then led the vanguard, so they confided in him; Ping refused and swore not to reveal the plot, and the scheme failed.

manualTranslations.zh: 太史郎陳苗奏皓久陰不雨，風氣回逆，將有陰謀，皓深警懼雲。
manualTranslations.literal: Astronomer Chen Miao memorialized that Hao had long lacked rain and winds ran contrary—there would be a secret plot; Hao was deeply alarmed and afraid.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Astronomer Chen Miao reported that Sun Hao's long drought and contrary winds foretold a secret plot, and Sun Hao was deeply alarmed.

manualTranslations.zh: 《吴录》曰：旧拜庙，选兼大将军领三千兵为卫，凯欲因此兵以图之，令选曹白用丁奉。
manualTranslations.literal: The Wu Lu states: When paying temple visits in old practice, they selected an acting Grand General with three thousand troops as escort; Kai wished to use those troops for the plot and had the selection bureau report appointing Ding Feng.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Wu Lu states: On old temple visits an acting grand general with three thousand troops served as escort; Lu Kai meant to use those troops for the plot and had the selection bureau propose Ding Feng.

manualTranslations.zh: 皓偶不欲，曰：「更选。」
manualTranslations.literal: Hao happened not to want this and said, "Choose someone else."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sun Hao happened to refuse and said, "Choose someone else."

manualTranslations.zh: 凯令执据，虽蹔兼，然宜得其人。
manualTranslations.literal: Kai pressed his grounds; though Feng was temporarily appointed acting commander, the right man ought to be found.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lu Kai pressed his case; though Feng was temporarily appointed acting commander, the right man still had to be found.

manualTranslations.zh: 皓曰：「用留平。」
manualTranslations.literal: Hao said, "Use Liu Ping."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sun Hao said, "Use Liu Ping."

manualTranslations.zh: 凯令其子祎谋语平。
manualTranslations.literal: Kai had his son Yi plan to speak with Ping.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lu Kai had his son Lu Yi plan to speak with Liu Ping.

manualTranslations.zh: 平素与丁奉有隙，祎未及得宣凯旨，平语祎曰：「闻野猪入丁奉营，此凶徵也。」
manualTranslations.literal: Ping had long been at odds with Ding Feng; Yi had not yet delivered Kai's message when Ping told Yi, "I hear a wild boar entered Ding Feng's camp—this is an ill omen."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ping had long been at odds with Ding Feng; before Yi could deliver Lu Kai's message, Ping told him, "I hear a wild boar entered Ding Feng's camp—a bad omen."

manualTranslations.zh: 有喜色。
manualTranslations.literal: He wore a look of pleasure.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He looked pleased.

manualTranslations.zh: 祎乃不敢言，还，因具启凯，故辍止。
manualTranslations.literal: Yi then dared not speak, returned, and fully reported to Kai, so the scheme was stopped.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lu Yi dared not speak further, returned, reported everything to Lu Kai, and the plot was abandoned.

sourceRange.text: 永安元年258年，徵為西陵督，封都亭侯，後轉左虎林。中書丞華覈表薦胤曰：胤天姿聰朗，才通行潔，昔歷選曹，遺跡可紀。

sourceRange.text: 陸凱字敬風，吳郡吳人，丞相遜族子也。黃武初為永興、諸暨長，所在有治跡，拜建武都尉，領兵。雖統軍眾，手不釋書。好《太玄》，論演其意，以筮輒驗。赤烏中，除儋耳太守，討朱崖，斬獲有功，遷為建武校尉。五鳳二年255年，討山賊陳毖於零陵。斬毖克捷，拜巴丘督、偏將軍，封都鄉侯，轉為武昌右部督。與諸將共赴壽春；還，累遷蕩魏、綏遠將軍。孫休即位，拜征北將軍，假節領豫州牧。孫皓立，遷鎮西大將軍，都督巴丘，領荊州牧，進封嘉興侯。孫皓與晉平，使者丁忠自北還，說皓弋陽可襲，凱諫止，語在《皓傳》。寶鼎元年，遷左丞相。

context.beforeSource: 」后祕为尚书僕射，代温为公平，甚得州里之誉。
context.afterSource: 皚性不好人視己，郡臣侍見，精莫敢進。

manualTranslations.zh: 陸凱字敬風，吳郡吳人，丞相遜族子也。
manualTranslations.literal: Lu Kai, courtesy name Jingfeng, was a man of Wu in Wu commandery, a clansman of Chancellor Sun.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lu Kai, styled Jingfeng, came from Wu in Wu commandery, a kinsman of Chancellor Sun Xun.

manualTranslations.zh: 黃武初為永興、諸暨長，所在有治跡，拜建武都尉，領兵。
manualTranslations.literal: Early in Huangwu he served as magistrate of Yongxing and Zhuji; wherever he went he left traces of good governance. He was appointed Commandant Who Establishes Martiality and led troops.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Early in Huangwu he governed Yongxing and Zhuji with a clean record, became Commandant Who Establishes Martiality, and took command of troops.

manualTranslations.zh: 雖統軍眾，手不釋書。
manualTranslations.literal: Though he commanded armies, he never put books aside.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Even while commanding armies he never laid books aside.

manualTranslations.zh: 好《太玄》，論演其意，以筮輒驗。
manualTranslations.literal: He loved the Taixuan, elaborated its meaning, and whenever he divined by it the results proved true.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He loved the Taixuan, worked out its doctrines, and his divinations always proved true.

manualTranslations.zh: 赤烏中，除儋耳太守，討朱崖，斬獲有功，遷為建武校尉。
manualTranslations.literal: In Chiwu he was appointed Administrator of Dan'er, campaigned against Zhuya, and for beheading and capture of the enemy was rewarded; he was transferred to Colonel Who Establishes Martiality.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the Chiwu era he became administrator of Dan'er, campaigned against Zhuya with success, and was promoted to Colonel Who Establishes Martiality.

manualTranslations.zh: 五鳳二年255年，討山賊陳毖於零陵。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year of Wufeng, 255 CE, he campaigned against the mountain bandit Chen Bi in Lingling.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Wufeng 2 (255) he attacked the mountain bandit Chen Bi in Lingling.

manualTranslations.zh: 斬毖克捷，拜巴丘督、偏將軍，封都鄉侯，轉為武昌右部督。
manualTranslations.literal: He beheaded Bi with success, was appointed Commander at Baqiu and Major General, enfeoffed as Village Marquis of Du, and transferred to colonel of the right division at Wuchang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He killed Chen Bi in victory, became commander at Baqiu and major general, was enfeoffed as village marquis of Du, and transferred to colonel of the right division at Wuchang.

manualTranslations.zh: 與諸將共赴壽春；
manualTranslations.literal: Together with other generals he went to Shouchun;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He marched with other generals to Shouchun;

manualTranslations.zh: 還，累遷蕩魏、綏遠將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: On return he was promoted repeatedly to General Who Quells Wei and General Who Pacifies the Far.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: On return he was promoted repeatedly to General Who Quells Wei and General Who Pacifies the Far.

manualTranslations.zh: 孫休即位，拜征北將軍，假節領豫州牧。
manualTranslations.literal: When Sun Xiu took the throne, Kai was appointed General Who Conquers the North with acting credentials as Governor of Yu Province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Sun Xiu succeeded, Lu Kai was made General Who Conquers the North with acting authority as governor of Yu Province.

manualTranslations.zh: 孫皓立，遷鎮西大將軍，都督巴丘，領荊州牧，進封嘉興侯。
manualTranslations.literal: When Sun Hao succeeded, he was transferred to Grand General Who Guards the West, supervising Baqiu as Governor of Jing Province, and advanced to Marquis of Jiaxing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Sun Hao took the throne, Lu Kai became Grand General Who Guards the West, supervised Baqiu as governor of Jing Province, and was advanced to marquis of Jiaxing.

manualTranslations.zh: 孫皓與晉平，使者丁忠自北還，說皓弋陽可襲，凱諫止，語在《皓傳》。
manualTranslations.literal: When Sun Hao made peace with Jin, the envoy Ding Zhong returned from the north and urged Hao to raid Yiyang; Kai remonstrated and stopped it—the account is in the biography of Hao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Sun Hao made peace with Jin, the envoy Ding Zhong returned from the north urging a raid on Yiyang; Lu Kai dissuaded him—the account is in Sun Hao's biography.

manualTranslations.zh: 寶鼎元年，遷左丞相。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Baoding he was transferred to Left Chancellor.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Baoding 1 he was transferred to left chancellor.

localRange.text: 風雨逆度，正由此起，是不遵帝先五也；

sourceRange.text: 建衡元年，疾病。皓遣中書令董朝問所欲言，凱陳：“何定不可任用，宣授外任，不宜委以國事。奚熙小吏，建起浦裡田，欲復嚴密故跡，亦不可聽。姚信、樓玄、賀劭、張悌、郭逴、薛瑩、滕脩及族弟喜，抗，或清白忠勤，或姿才卓茂，皆社稷之楨干，國家之良輔。願陛下重留神思，訪以時務，各盡其忠，拾遺萬一。”遂卒，時年七十二。

manualTranslations.zh: 建衡元年，疾病。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Jianheng he fell ill.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Jianheng 1 he fell ill.

manualTranslations.zh: 皓遣中書令董朝問所欲言，凱陳：“何定不可任用，宣授外任，不宜委以國事。
manualTranslations.literal: Hao sent Secretariat Director Dong Chao to ask what he wished to say; Kai stated: "He Ding must not be employed; he should be given an outer post and must not be entrusted with state affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sun Hao sent Secretariat Director Dong Chao to ask his final counsel. Lu Kai said: "He Ding must not be trusted; give him an outside post and keep state affairs from him.

manualTranslations.zh: 奚熙小吏，建起浦裡田，欲復嚴密故跡，亦不可聽。
manualTranslations.literal: Xi Zhao is a petty clerk who promoted the Puli field reclamation, seeking to restore Yan Mi's old project—that too must not be allowed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Xi Zhao is a petty clerk who pushed the Puli reclamation, seeking to revive Yan Mi's old scheme—that too must be refused.

manualTranslations.zh: 姚信、樓玄、賀劭、張悌、郭逴、薛瑩、滕脩及族弟喜，抗，或清白忠勤，或姿才卓茂，皆社稷之楨干，國家之良輔。
manualTranslations.literal: Yao Xin, Lou Xuan, He Shao, Zhang Ti, Guo Chuo, Xue Ying, Teng Xiu, and my clansmen Xi and Kang—some are pure, loyal, and diligent, others splendid in talent—are all pillars of the altars of soil and grain, fine assistants to the state.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yao Xin, Lou Xuan, He Shao, Zhang Ti, Guo Chuo, Xue Ying, Teng Xiu, and my clansmen Xi and Kang—some pure and loyal, others splendid in talent—are pillars of the altars and fine servants of the state.

manualTranslations.zh: 願陛下重留神思，訪以時務，各盡其忠，拾遺萬一。”
manualTranslations.literal: I pray Your Majesty will weigh my words, consult them on current affairs, and let each give his full loyalty, offering counsel even in one case out of ten thousand."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I pray Your Majesty will heed this, consult them on affairs, and let each give full loyalty, speaking truth even once in ten thousand cases."

manualTranslations.zh: 遂卒，時年七十二。
manualTranslations.literal: He then died, aged seventy-two.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He died at seventy-two.

sourceRange.text: 權歎曰："使人盡如是儀，當安用科法為?"及寢疾，遺令素棺，斂以時服，務從省約，年八十一卒。胡綜字偉則。汝南固始人也。少孤，母將避難江東。孫策領會稽太守，綜年十四，為門下循行，留吳與孫權共讀書。策薨，權為討虜將軍，以綜為金曹從事，從討黃祖，拜鄂長。權為將軍，都京，召綜還，為書部。與是儀、徐詳俱典軍國密事。劉備下白帝，權以見兵少，使綜料諸縣，得六千人，立解煩兩部，詳領左部、綜領右部督。吳將晉宗叛歸魏，魏以宗為蘄春太守，去江數百里，數為寇害。權使綜與賀齊輕行掩襲，生虜得宗。加建武中郎將。魏拜權為吳王，封綜、儀、詳皆為亭侯。

manualTranslations.zh: 胡綜字偉則。
manualTranslations.literal: Hu Zong, courtesy name Weize.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Hu Zong (courtesy Weize)

manualTranslations.zh: 汝南固始人也。
manualTranslations.literal: He was a man of Gushi in Runan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: came from Gushi in Runan commandery.

manualTranslations.zh: 少孤，母將避難江東。
manualTranslations.literal: He lost his father early; his mother took him to flee turmoil east of the Yangzi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was orphaned young; his mother brought him south across the Yangzi to escape the wars.

manualTranslations.zh: 孫策領會稽太守，綜年十四，為門下循行，留吳與孫權共讀書。
manualTranslations.literal: When Sun Ce held the post of Administrator of Kuaiji, Zong at age fourteen served as a gate attendant, remaining in Wu to study with Sun Quan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Sun Ce was administrator of Kuaiji, Zong at fourteen became a gate attendant and stayed in Wu to read with Sun Quan.

manualTranslations.zh: 策薨，權為討虜將軍，以綜為金曹從事，從討黃祖，拜鄂長。
manualTranslations.literal: When Ce died, Quan became General Who Pacifies Barbarians and appointed Zong clerk of the gold bureau; he followed in the punitive expedition against Huang Zu and was named Prefect of E.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Sun Ce's death Sun Quan became general who pacifies barbarians, made Zong a gold-bureau clerk, joined the campaign against Huang Zu, and named him prefect of E.

manualTranslations.zh: 權為將軍，都京，召綜還，為書部。
manualTranslations.literal: When Quan became general and established the capital, he recalled Zong and made him head of the documentation office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Sun Quan took the title of general and fixed the capital, he recalled Zong to head the documentation office.

manualTranslations.zh: 與是儀、徐詳俱典軍國密事。
manualTranslations.literal: Together with Shi Yi and Xu Xiang he jointly managed confidential state and military affairs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: With Shi Yi and Xu Xiang he jointly handled confidential military and state business.

manualTranslations.zh: 劉備下白帝，權以見兵少，使綜料諸縣，得六千人，立解煩兩部，詳領左部、綜領右部督。
manualTranslations.literal: When Liu Bei descended from Baidi, Quan, seeing his visible forces were few, had Zong muster the counties and raise six thousand men, establishing two hardship-relief divisions—Xiang commanded the left division and Zong supervised the right.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Liu Bei came down from Baidi, Sun Quan, finding his visible troops too thin, had Zong levy the counties for six thousand men and formed two hardship-relief divisions—Xu Xiang led the left and Hu Zong the right.

manualTranslations.zh: 吳將晉宗叛歸魏，魏以宗為蘄春太守，去江數百里，數為寇害。
manualTranslations.literal: The Wu officer Jin Zong defected to Wei; Wei appointed Zong Administrator of Qichun, several hundred li from the river, and he repeatedly raided as a bandit scourge.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Wu officer Jin Zong crossed to Wei; Wei made him Qichun prefect hundreds of li from the river, and he raided the frontier again and again.

manualTranslations.zh: 權使綜與賀齊輕行掩襲，生虜得宗。
manualTranslations.literal: Quan sent Zong with He Qi on a light, swift ambush strike and captured Zong alive.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sun Quan sent Zong with He Qi on a swift surprise raid and took Jin Zong alive.

manualTranslations.zh: 加建武中郎將。
manualTranslations.literal: He was promoted to Central Commander of Establishing Martial.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He was promoted to central commander of establishing martial.

manualTranslations.zh: 魏拜權為吳王，封綜、儀、詳皆為亭侯。
manualTranslations.literal: When Wei invested Quan as King of Wu, Zong, Yi, and Xiang were all enfeoffed as village marquises.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Wei recognized Sun Quan as King of Wu, Zong, Yi, and Xiang were all made village marquises.

items.acceptedSourceText: 胡綜字偉則。汝南固始人也。少孤，母將避難江東。孫策領會稽太守，綜年十四，為門下循行，留吳與孫權共讀書。策薨，權為討虜將軍，以綜為金曹從事，從討黃祖，拜鄂長。權為將軍，都京，召綜還，為書部。與是儀、徐詳俱典軍國密事。劉備下白帝，權以見兵少，使綜料諸縣，得六千人，立解煩兩部，詳領左部、綜領右部督。吳將晉宗叛歸魏，魏以宗為蘄春太守，去江數百里，數為寇害。權使綜與賀齊輕行掩襲，生虜得宗。加建武中郎將。魏拜權為吳王，封綜、儀、詳皆為亭侯。

sourceRange.text: ”其二曰：“昔伊尹去夏人商，陳平委楚歸漢，書功竹帛，遺名陵後世，世主不謂之背誕者，以為知天命也。臣昔為曹氏所見交接，外托群臣，內如骨肉，恩義綢繆，有合無離，遂受偏方之任，總河北之軍。當此之時，志望高大，永與曹氏同死懼生。惟恐功之不建，事之不成耳。及曹氏之亡，後嗣繼位，幼沖統政，讒言彌興。同儕者以勢相害，異趣者得間其言，而臣受性簡略，素不下人，視彼數子，意實迫之，此亦臣之過也。遂為邪議所見構會，招至猜疑，誣臣欲叛。雖識真者保明其心，世亂讒勝，余嫌猶在，常懼一旦橫受無辜，憂心孔疚，如覆冰炭。昔樂毅為燕昭王立功於齊，惠王即位，疑奪其任，遂去燕之趙，休烈不虧。彼豈欲二三其德，蓋畏功名不建，而懼禍之將及也。昔遣魏郡周光以賈販為名，托叛南詣，宣達密計。時以倉卒，未敢便有章表，使光口傳而已。以為天下大歸可見，天意所在，非吳復誰?此方之民，思為臣妾，延頸舉踵，惟恐兵來之遲耳。若使聖恩少加信納，當以河北承望王師，疑心赤實，天日是鑒。而光去經年，不聞咳唾，未審此意竟得達不?瞻望長歎，日月以幾，魯望高子，何足以喻!又臣今日見待稍薄，蒼蠅之聲，綿綿不絕，必受此禍，遲速事耳。臣私度陛下未垂明慰者，必以臣質貫穿仁義之道，不行若此之事，謂光所傳，多虛少實，或謂比中有他消息，不知臣質構讒見疑，恐受大害也。且臣質著有罪之日，自當奔赴鼎鑊，束身待罪，此蓋人臣之宜也。今日無罪，橫見譖毀，將有商鞅、白起之禍。尋惟事勢，去亦直也。死而弗義，不去何為!樂毅之出，吳起之走，君子傷其不遇，未有非之者也。願陛下推古況今，不疑怪於臣質也。又念人臣獲罪，當如伍員奉己自效，不當繞幸因事為利。然今與古，厥勢不同，南北悠遠。江湖隔絕，自不舉事，何得濟免!是以忘志士之節，而思立功之義也之也。且臣質又以曹氏之嗣，非天命所在，政弱刑亂，柄奪於臣，諸將專威於外，各自為政，莫或同心，士卒衰耗，帑藏空虛，綱紀毀廢，上下並昏，想前後數得降叛，具聞此問，兼弱攻昧，宜應天時，此實陛下進取之秋。是以區區敢獻其計。今若內兵淮、泗，據有下邳，荊、揚二州，聞聲響應，臣從河北席眷而南，形勢一連，根牙永固。關西之兵繫於所衛，青、徐二州不敢徹守，許，洛余兵眾不滿萬，誰能來東與陛下爭者?此城千載一會之期，可不深思而熟計乎!及臣所在，既自多馬，加以羌、胡常以三四月中美草時，驅馬來出，隱度今者，可得三千餘匹。陛下出軍，當投此時，多將騎士來就馬耳。此皆先定所一二知。凡兩軍不能相究虛實，今此間實羸，易可克定，陛下舉動，應者必多。上定洪業，使普天一統，下令臣質建非常之功，此乃天也。若不見納，此亦天也。願陛下思之，不復多陳。

manualTranslations.zh: ”其二曰：“昔伊尹去夏人商，陳平委楚歸漢，書功竹帛，遺名陵後世，世主不謂之背誕者，以為知天命也。
manualTranslations.literal: The second says: "In olden days Yi Yin left Xia for Shang, and Chen Ping abandoned Chu for Han; their merits were written on bamboo and silk and their names left mounds for later ages—sovereigns did not call them traitorous, deeming them men who knew Heaven's mandate."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The second reads: "Long ago Yi Yin left Xia for Shang and Chen Ping abandoned Chu for Han; their deeds were recorded on bamboo and silk and their names endure for posterity—rulers did not call them traitors, but men who read Heaven's mandate."

manualTranslations.zh: 臣昔為曹氏所見交接，外托群臣，內如骨肉，恩義綢繆，有合無離，遂受偏方之任，總河北之軍。
manualTranslations.literal: Your subject was once received and connected by the Cao clan—outwardly among ministers, inwardly like flesh and bone; grace and duty were close-woven, joined without parting—thereupon he received a regional command and oversaw the armies north of the He.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I was once taken in by the Cao house—outwardly a minister, inwardly treated like kin; our bond was close and unbroken, and I received a frontier command over the Hebei armies.

manualTranslations.zh: 當此之時，志望高大，永與曹氏同死懼生。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time his aims were lofty; he would forever share death and fear life with the Cao clan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In those days my ambition was high; I meant to live and die with the Cao house.

manualTranslations.zh: 惟恐功之不建，事之不成耳。
manualTranslations.literal: He only feared that merit would not be established and affairs would not succeed.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I feared only that our work would fail and our cause come to nothing.

manualTranslations.zh: 及曹氏之亡，後嗣繼位，幼沖統政，讒言彌興。
manualTranslations.literal: When the Cao clan's founder died, the successor ascended, a youth holding government; slanderous words spread ever more.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Cao Cao's death the heir took the throne—a child in power—and slander multiplied.

manualTranslations.zh: 同儕者以勢相害，異趣者得間其言，而臣受性簡略，素不下人，視彼數子，意實迫之，此亦臣之過也。
manualTranslations.literal: Peers harmed one another by power; those of different bent found openings in their words; yet your subject by nature is plain and brief, never deferring to others—looking on those several men, he truly pressed them—this too is your subject's fault.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Colleagues preyed on one another; rivals seized on their talk; and I, blunt by nature and never humble before others, had pressed those men hard—this too was my fault.

manualTranslations.zh: 遂為邪議所見構會，招至猜疑，誣臣欲叛。
manualTranslations.literal: Thereupon he was framed by evil talk and brought under suspicion, falsely accused of wishing to rebel.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Evil counsel framed me, suspicion followed, and I was accused of plotting rebellion.

manualTranslations.zh: 雖識真者保明其心，世亂讒勝，余嫌猶在，常懼一旦橫受無辜，憂心孔疚，如覆冰炭。
manualTranslations.literal: Although those who knew the truth vouched for his heart, in a chaotic age slander prevailed and lingering suspicion remained; he constantly feared suddenly suffering innocence by violence—his heart deeply afflicted, as if overturned between ice and fire.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Though those who knew me cleared my name, in these troubled times calumny wins and doubt lingers; I live in dread of sudden injustice, my heart torn as between ice and fire.

manualTranslations.zh: 昔樂毅為燕昭王立功於齊，惠王即位，疑奪其任，遂去燕之趙，休烈不虧。
manualTranslations.literal: Formerly Yue Yi for King Zhao of Yan achieved merit in Qi; when King Hui ascended, suspecting him he removed his charge, whereupon he left Yan for Zhao—his splendid fame undiminished.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Once Yue Yi served King Zhao of Yan against Qi; when King Hui came to the throne he was suspected and stripped of command, left Yan for Zhao, and lost none of his renown.

manualTranslations.zh: 彼豈欲二三其德，蓋畏功名不建，而懼禍之將及也。
manualTranslations.literal: Did he wish to double his virtue? He feared merit and fame would not be established and disaster was about to reach him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Was he fickle in loyalty? He feared his achievements would come to nothing and ruin was closing in.

manualTranslations.zh: 昔遣魏郡周光以賈販為名，托叛南詣，宣達密計。
manualTranslations.literal: Formerly he dispatched Zhou Guang of Wei commandery under the name of a merchant-trader, feigning defection to go south and declare the secret plan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I once sent Zhou Guang of Wei commandery south disguised as a peddler, pretending to defect, to convey a secret design.

manualTranslations.zh: 時以倉卒，未敢便有章表，使光口傳而已。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time, because of haste, he dared not at once submit a formal memorial and had Guang transmit it by word alone.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the rush I dared not send a formal memorial and had Guang speak the message orally.

manualTranslations.zh: 以為天下大歸可見，天意所在，非吳復誰?此方之民，思為臣妾，延頸舉踵，惟恐兵來之遲耳。
manualTranslations.literal: He considered that the great return of All under Heaven was visible and Heaven's intent lay elsewhere—if not Wu, then who? The people of this region wish to become subjects; they stretch necks and lift heels, fearing only that troops come too late.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I believed the realm's great allegiance was plain and Heaven's choice obvious—if not Wu, then who? The folk here long to submit, craning their necks and rising on tiptoe, dreading only that your armies arrive too late.

manualTranslations.zh: 若使聖恩少加信納，當以河北承望王師，疑心赤實，天日是鑒。
manualTranslations.literal: If Your sacred grace would slightly add trust and acceptance, he would from Hebei await the royal host—his loyal heart true red; sun and Heaven are witness.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If Your Majesty would grant a little trust, I would hold Hebei open for your host—my loyal heart is true; Heaven and sun bear witness.

manualTranslations.zh: 而光去經年，不聞咳唾，未審此意竟得達不?瞻望長歎，日月以幾，魯望高子，何足以喻!又臣今日見待稍薄，蒼蠅之聲，綿綿不絕，必受此禍，遲速事耳。
manualTranslations.literal: Yet Guang departed a year ago and no cough or spit has been heard—does this intent in the end reach you? Gazing afar he sighs long; days and months pile up—Lu Wang and Gao Zi are not enough as likeness! Moreover your subject today is treated somewhat thinly; the buzz of flies is unending—he is sure to suffer this calamity; it is only a matter of sooner or later.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet Guang left a year ago and not a word has returned—did my message ever reach you? I gaze south and sigh as the months pass; even Lu Wang and Gao Zi scarcely match my longing! And now I am treated coldly; slander never stops—I am sure to suffer for it, only sooner or later.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣私度陛下未垂明慰者，必以臣質貫穿仁義之道，不行若此之事，謂光所傳，多虛少實，或謂比中有他消息，不知臣質構讒見疑，恐受大害也。
manualTranslations.literal: Your subject privately surmises that if Your Majesty has not yet extended clear comfort, it must be because your subject Zhi is thought to pierce through the Way of benevolence and righteousness and would not do such a thing—deeming what Guang transmitted mostly empty and little real, or that among these matters there is other news—not knowing your subject Zhi is framed by slander and suspected, fearing great harm.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I suppose Your Majesty has not yet reassured me because you take me for a man steeped in righteousness who would never act thus—thinking Guang's tale mostly false, or that some other intrigue is afoot—unaware that I am slandered and in peril.

manualTranslations.zh: 且臣質著有罪之日，自當奔赴鼎鑊，束身待罪，此蓋人臣之宜也。
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover, on a day when your subject Zhi is clearly guilty, he ought of himself to rush to the cauldron and cauldron, binding his body to await punishment—this is what a minister should do.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: And if I were truly guilty I would go bound to the executioner's cauldron—that is a subject's duty.

manualTranslations.zh: 今日無罪，橫見譖毀，將有商鞅、白起之禍。
manualTranslations.literal: Today without guilt he is suddenly slandered and will meet the calamity of Shang Yang and Bai Qi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Today, innocent, I am suddenly defamed and face the fate of Shang Yang or Bai Qi.

manualTranslations.zh: 尋惟事勢，去亦直也。
manualTranslations.literal: Reflecting on the situation, to leave is also straight.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Weighing the situation, departure is the honest course.

manualTranslations.zh: 死而弗義，不去何為!樂毅之出，吳起之走，君子傷其不遇，未有非之者也。
manualTranslations.literal: To die without righteousness—if he does not leave, what is he to do! Yue Yi's departure, Wu Qi's flight—gentlemen grieve their lack of recognition; none have condemned them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: To die without justice—why not leave? When Yue Yi left and Wu Qi fled, gentlemen mourned their ill treatment; none blamed them.

manualTranslations.zh: 願陛下推古況今，不疑怪於臣質也。
manualTranslations.literal: May Your Majesty extend ancient examples to judge the present and not be suspicious or strange toward your subject Zhi.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I beg Your Majesty to weigh antiquity against today and not find me strange.

manualTranslations.zh: 又念人臣獲罪，當如伍員奉己自效，不當繞幸因事為利。
manualTranslations.literal: He also reflects that when a minister receives guilt, he ought like Wu Yuan to offer himself in service, not seek advantage by circling fortune and using events for profit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I know a guilty minister should, like Wu Zixu, offer himself in loyal service—not twist events for private gain.

manualTranslations.zh: 然今與古，厥勢不同，南北悠遠。
manualTranslations.literal: Yet now and antiquity—their situations differ; north and south are vast and far.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yet today differs from antiquity; north and south are far apart.

manualTranslations.zh: 江湖隔絕，自不舉事，何得濟免!是以忘志士之節，而思立功之義也之也。
manualTranslations.literal: Rivers and lakes cut off—if he himself does not act, how can he cross to safety! Therefore forgetting the integrity of a resolute man, he thinks instead of the righteousness of establishing merit.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Rivers and lakes stand between us—without acting myself, how could I escape? So I set aside pure integrity and think instead of earning merit by service.

manualTranslations.zh: 且臣質又以曹氏之嗣，非天命所在，政弱刑亂，柄奪於臣，諸將專威於外，各自為政，莫或同心，士卒衰耗，帑藏空虛，綱紀毀廢，上下並昏，想前後數得降叛，具聞此問，兼弱攻昧，宜應天時，此實陛下進取之秋。
manualTranslations.literal: Moreover your subject Zhi also considers that the Cao successor is not where Heaven's mandate lies—government weak, punishments chaotic, the handle seized by ministers; generals wield sole might abroad, each governing on his own, none of one heart; soldiers decline and waste; treasury stores are empty; statutes and discipline are ruined and abandoned; high and low alike are benighted. He thinks that from front and back you have repeatedly received defectors and rebels and fully heard this inquiry—attack the weak and strike the dim, fit Heaven's season—this is truly the season for Your Majesty's advance.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I also judge the Cao heir not Heaven's choice—weak rule, chaotic law, power held by ministers; generals rule their own domains abroad without unity; troops waste away and coffers stand empty; order is broken and court and country are blind. Your Majesty has heard this from many deserters: strike the weak while fortune favors you—this is your moment to advance.

manualTranslations.zh: 是以區區敢獻其計。
manualTranslations.literal: Therefore in his slight way he dares offer this plan.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In my small way I dare offer this plan.

manualTranslations.zh: 今若內兵淮、泗，據有下邳，荊、揚二州，聞聲響應，臣從河北席眷而南，形勢一連，根牙永固。
manualTranslations.literal: Now if inner troops move on the Huai and Si, hold Xiapi, and the two provinces Jing and Yang respond at the sound, your subject from Hebei rolls up his mat-rug and goes south—the situation links as one, root and branch forever firm.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If you march on the Huai and Si and seize Xiapi, Jing and Yang will answer at once; I will roll south from Hebei, our positions will link, and the foundation will hold.

manualTranslations.zh: 關西之兵繫於所衛，青、徐二州不敢徹守，許，洛余兵眾不滿萬，誰能來東與陛下爭者?此城千載一會之期，可不深思而熟計乎!及臣所在，既自多馬，加以羌、胡常以三四月中美草時，驅馬來出，隱度今者，可得三千餘匹。
manualTranslations.literal: The troops of Guanxi are tied to what they guard; the two provinces Qing and Xu dare not fully withdraw garrisons; at Xu and Luo the remaining soldiers number less than ten thousand—who can come east to contend with Your Majesty? This is a once-in-a-thousand-years meeting—can you not deeply ponder and carefully plan! As to where your subject is, he already has many horses; moreover the Qiang and Hu often in the third and fourth months, when grass is lush, drive horses out—privately estimating the present, he could obtain more than three thousand head.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Guansi's armies are pinned to their posts; Qing and Xu dare not strip their garrisons; fewer than ten thousand men remain at Xu and Luoyang—who could march east against you? This is a once-in-a-millennium chance—will you not weigh it carefully? Where I am we already have many horses; in the third and fourth months, when grass is rich, the Qiang and Hu drive herds out—I estimate three thousand mounts could be gathered now.

manualTranslations.zh: 陛下出軍，當投此時，多將騎士來就馬耳。
manualTranslations.literal: When Your Majesty sends out the army, you should strike at this time, bringing many knights to come take the horses.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Your Majesty should march at that season and send many horsemen to collect the mounts.

manualTranslations.zh: 此皆先定所一二知。
manualTranslations.literal: These are matters he knows beforehand one or two in advance.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: These points I know well in advance.

manualTranslations.zh: 凡兩軍不能相究虛實，今此間實羸，易可克定，陛下舉動，應者必多。
manualTranslations.literal: In general two armies cannot investigate each other's emptiness and fullness; now this region is truly weak and easily conquered and settled—when Your Majesty acts, responders will surely be many.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Armies cannot always probe each other's strength; this region is truly weak and easily taken—when you move, many will join you.

manualTranslations.zh: 上定洪業，使普天一統，下令臣質建非常之功，此乃天也。
manualTranslations.literal: Above, settling the great enterprise and making all under Heaven one—ordering your subject Zhi to establish extraordinary merit—this is Heaven.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: To settle the great enterprise and unify the realm, and to let me win extraordinary merit—that is Heaven's will.

manualTranslations.zh: 若不見納，此亦天也。
manualTranslations.literal: If not accepted, this too is Heaven.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: If you refuse, that too is Heaven's decree.

manualTranslations.zh: 願陛下思之，不復多陳。
manualTranslations.literal: May Your Majesty ponder it; he will not further elaborate much.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I beg Your Majesty to consider it; I will say no more.

items.acceptedSourceText: ”其二曰：“昔伊尹去夏人商，陳平委楚歸漢，書功竹帛，遺名陵後世，世主不謂之背誕者，以為知天命也。臣昔為曹氏所見交接，外托群臣，內如骨肉，恩義綢繆，有合無離，遂受偏方之任，總河北之軍。當此之時，志望高大，永與曹氏同死懼生。惟恐功之不建，事之不成耳。及曹氏之亡，後嗣繼位，幼沖統政，讒言彌興。同儕者以勢相害，異趣者得間其言，而臣受性簡略，素不下人，視彼數子，意實迫之，此亦臣之過也。遂為邪議所見構會，招至猜疑，誣臣欲叛。雖識真者保明其心，世亂讒勝，余嫌猶在，常懼一旦橫受無辜，憂心孔疚，如覆冰炭。昔樂毅為燕昭王立功於齊，惠王即位，疑奪其任，遂去燕之趙，休烈不虧。彼豈欲二三其德，蓋畏功名不建，而懼禍之將及也。昔遣魏郡周光以賈販為名，托叛南詣，宣達密計。時以倉卒，未敢便有章表，使光口傳而已。以為天下大歸可見，天意所在，非吳復誰?此方之民，思為臣妾，延頸舉踵，惟恐兵來之遲耳。若使聖恩少加信納，當以河北承望王師，疑心赤實，天日是鑒。而光去經年，不聞咳唾，未審此意竟得達不?瞻望長歎，日月以幾，魯望高子，何足以喻!又臣今日見待稍薄，蒼蠅之聲，綿綿不絕，必受此禍，遲速事耳。臣私度陛下未垂明慰者，必以臣質貫穿仁義之道，不行若此之事，謂光所傳，多虛少實，或謂比中有他消息，不知臣質構讒見疑，恐受大害也。且臣質著有罪之日，自當奔赴鼎鑊，束身待罪，此蓋人臣之宜也。今日無罪，橫見譖毀，將有商鞅、白起之禍。尋惟事勢，去亦直也。死而弗義，不去何為!樂毅之出，吳起之走，君子傷其不遇，未有非之者也。願陛下推古況今，不疑怪於臣質也。又念人臣獲罪，當如伍員奉己自效，不當繞幸因事為利。然今與古，厥勢不同，南北悠遠。江湖隔絕，自不舉事，何得濟免!是以忘志士之節，而思立功之義也之也。且臣質又以曹氏之嗣，非天命所在，政弱刑亂，柄奪於臣，諸將專威於外，各自為政，莫或同心，士卒衰耗，帑藏空虛，綱紀毀廢，上下並昏，想前後數得降叛，具聞此問，兼弱攻昧，宜應天時，此實陛下進取之秋。是以區區敢獻其計。今若內兵淮、泗，據有下邳，荊、揚二州，聞聲響應，臣從河北席眷而南，形勢一連，根牙永固。關西之兵繫於所衛，青、徐二州不敢徹守，許，洛余兵眾不滿萬，誰能來東與陛下爭者?此城千載一會之期，可不深思而熟計乎!及臣所在，既自多馬，加以羌、胡常以三四月中美草時，驅馬來出，隱度今者，可得三千餘匹。陛下出軍，當投此時，多將騎士來就馬耳。此皆先定所一二知。凡兩軍不能相究虛實，今此間實羸，易可克定，陛下舉動，應者必多。上定洪業，使普天一統，下令臣質建非常之功，此乃天也。若不見納，此亦天也。願陛下思之，不復多陳。

sourceRange.text: 綝遣將軍孫耽送亮之國，徙尚於零陵，遷公主於豫章。綝意彌溢，侮慢民神，遂燒大橋頭伍子胥廟，又壞浮屠祠，斬道人。休既即位，稱草莽臣。詣闕上書曰：「臣伏自省，才非干國，因緣肺腑，位極人臣，傷錦敗駕，罪負彰露，尋愆惟闕，夙夜憂懼。臣聞天命棐諶，必就有德，是以幽、厲失度，閡宣中興，陛下聖德，纂承大統，宜得良輔；以協雍熙，雖堯之盛，猶求稷契之佐；以協明聖之德。古人有言：『陳力就列，不能者止。』臣雖自展竭，無益庶政，謹上印綬節鉞，退還田裡，以避賢路。」休引見慰喻。又下詔曰：「朕以不德，守藩於外，值茲際會，群公卿士，暨於朕躬，以奉宗廟。朕用撫然，若涉淵冰。大將軍忠計內發，扶危定傾，安康社稷，功勳赫然。昔漢孝宣踐阼，霍光尊顯，褒德賞功，古今之通義也。其以大將軍為丞相、荊州牧，食五縣。」恩為禦史大夫、衛將軍，據右將軍。皆縣侯。幹雜號將軍、亭侯。闓亦封亭侯。綝一門五侯，皆典禁兵，權傾人主，自吳國朝臣未嘗有也。

manualTranslations.literal: After Xiu took the throne, Lin styled himself a rustic subject.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Once Emperor Xiu reigned, Sun Lin called himself a rustic subject.

manualTranslations.zh: 詣闕上書曰：「臣伏自省，才非干國，因緣肺腑，位極人臣，傷錦敗駕，罪負彰露，尋愆惟闕，夙夜憂懼。
manualTranslations.literal: He went to court and submitted a memorial saying, "Your subject reflects in humility: talent unfit to sustain the state, yet through kinship rose to the summit of ministers; I have torn brocade and wrecked the carriage—guilt stands revealed; reviewing faults I fear day and night.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He went to court and wrote, "I reflect that my talent cannot sustain the state, yet kinship raised me to the summit of power; I have torn brocade and wrecked the carriage, and guilt stands clear; day and night I fear my faults.

manualTranslations.zh: 臣聞天命棐諶，必就有德，是以幽、厲失度，閡宣中興，陛下聖德，纂承大統，宜得良輔；
manualTranslations.literal: Your subject has heard that Heaven's mandate is aided and sincere and must settle on the virtuous; thus You and Li lost measure yet Xuan restored the house; Your Majesty's sagely virtue inherits the great succession and deserves worthy assistants;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Heaven aids the sincere and settles on virtue; You and Li lost the way yet Xuan restored the house; Your Majesty inherits the great succession and deserves worthy assistants;

manualTranslations.zh: 以協雍熙，雖堯之盛，猶求稷契之佐；
manualTranslations.literal: to harmonize peace and glory; even in Yao's greatness he still sought assistants like Ji and Qi;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: to harmonize peace; even Yao sought men like Ji and Qi;

manualTranslations.zh: 以協明聖之德。
manualTranslations.literal: to harmonize with enlightened and sagely virtue.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: to match enlightened and sagely virtue.

manualTranslations.zh: 古人有言：『陳力就列，不能者止。』
manualTranslations.literal: The ancients said, "Offer strength and take your place; if unable, withdraw."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The ancients said, "Offer strength and take your place; if unable, withdraw."

manualTranslations.zh: 臣雖自展竭，無益庶政，謹上印綬節鉞，退還田裡，以避賢路。」
manualTranslations.literal: Though your subject has exhausted himself, he benefits no common governance; I respectfully return seals, ribbons, and credential staff, withdraw to fields and hamlets, and yield the path for the worthy."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Though I have exhausted myself I benefit no governance; I return seals, ribbons, and the staff of authority, withdraw to my fields, and yield the path for the worthy."

manualTranslations.zh: 休引見慰喻。
manualTranslations.literal: Xiu received him in audience and comforted him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiu received him in audience and comforted him.

manualTranslations.zh: 又下詔曰：「朕以不德，守藩於外，值茲際會，群公卿士，暨於朕躬，以奉宗廟。
manualTranslations.literal: He also issued an edict saying, "We lack virtue, guarded a fief abroad, met this juncture, and lords, ministers, and scholars together with Our person uphold the ancestral temple.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He also issued an edict: "Lacking virtue I guarded a fief abroad until this juncture, when lords and ministers with me uphold the ancestral temple.

manualTranslations.zh: 朕用撫然，若涉淵冰。
manualTranslations.literal: We are apprehensive, as if treading deep ice.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: I am apprehensive, as if treading deep ice.

manualTranslations.zh: 大將軍忠計內發，扶危定傾，安康社稷，功勳赫然。
manualTranslations.literal: The Grand General's loyal plan arose within, braced peril and steadied the tipping, brought peace to altars and state, and his merit blazed bright.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The grand general's loyal counsel braced peril, steadied the state, and his merit blazed bright.

manualTranslations.zh: 昔漢孝宣踐阼，霍光尊顯，褒德賞功，古今之通義也。
manualTranslations.literal: Formerly when Han's Emperor Xuan ascended the throne, Huo Guang was honored and exalted—praising virtue and rewarding merit is the constant principle of past and present.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xuan of Han took the throne he honored Huo Guang—praising merit is the constant way of past and present.

manualTranslations.zh: 其以大將軍為丞相、荊州牧，食五縣。」
manualTranslations.literal: Let the Grand General be Chancellor and Governor of Jing Province with income from five counties."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Let the grand general be chancellor and governor of Jing with income from five counties."

manualTranslations.zh: 恩為禦史大夫、衛將軍，據右將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: En was made Grandee Secretary and Guard General; Ju was made General of the Right.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: En was made grandee secretary and guard general; Lü Ju was made general of the right.

manualTranslations.zh: 皆縣侯。
manualTranslations.literal: All were enfeoffed as district marquises.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: All were enfeoffed as district marquises.

manualTranslations.zh: 幹雜號將軍、亭侯。
manualTranslations.literal: Gan was made a miscellaneous-number general and village marquis.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gan was made a miscellaneous-number general and village marquis.

manualTranslations.zh: 闓亦封亭侯。
manualTranslations.literal: Kan was also enfeoffed as village marquis.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Kan was also enfeoffed as village marquis.

manualTranslations.zh: 綝一門五侯，皆典禁兵，權傾人主，自吳國朝臣未嘗有也。
manualTranslations.literal: Lin's household held five marquisates at once, all commanding forbidden troops; power tilted past the sovereign—never before among Wu court ministers.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Five marquises in one Sun Lin household, all commanding palace troops—power beyond any Wu minister before.

sourceRange.text: 永安元年258年十二月丁卯，建業中謠言明會有變。綝聞之，不悅。夜大風發木揚沙，綝益恐。戊辰臘會，綝稱疾。休強起之，使者十餘輩。綝不得已，將人，眾止焉。綝曰：「國家屢有命，不可辭。可豫整兵，令府內起火，因是可得速還。」遂入，尋而火起，綝求出，休曰：「外兵自多，不足煩丞相也。」綝起離席，奉、布目左右縛之。綝叩首曰：「願徙交州。」休曰：「卿何以不徙滕胤、呂據？」綝復曰：「願沒為官奴。」休曰：「何不以胤、據為奴乎！」遂斬之。以綝首令其眾曰：「諸與綝同謀皆赦。」放仗者五千人。闓乘船欲北降，追殺之。夷三族。發孫峻棺，取其印綬，綝其木而埋之，以殺魯育等故也。

context.beforeSource: 將軍魏邈說休曰「綝居外必有變」，武衛士施朔又告「綝欲反有徵」休密問張布，布與丁奉謀於會殺綝。
context.afterSource: 綝死時年二十八。

manualTranslations.zh: 永安元年258年十二月丁卯，建業中謠言明會有變。
manualTranslations.literal: In the twelfth month, day dingmao, of the first year of Yongan, 258 CE, Jianye rumor said the bright assembly would bring upheaval.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yongan 1, month 12, day dingmao (258): Jianye rumor warned of trouble at the bright assembly.

manualTranslations.zh: 綝聞之，不悅。
manualTranslations.literal: Lin heard it and was displeased.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sun Lin heard and was displeased.

manualTranslations.zh: 夜大風發木揚沙，綝益恐。
manualTranslations.literal: That night a great wind uprooted trees and raised sand; Lin grew more fearful.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: That night gale winds uprooted trees and raised sand; Lin grew more afraid.

manualTranslations.zh: 戊辰臘會，綝稱疾。
manualTranslations.literal: On day wuchen at the year-end assembly Lin claimed illness.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At the year-end assembly on day wuchen Sun Lin claimed illness.

manualTranslations.zh: 休強起之，使者十餘輩。
manualTranslations.literal: Xiu forced him to rise; over ten messengers came.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiu forced him to attend; more than ten messengers came.

manualTranslations.zh: 綝不得已，將人，眾止焉。
manualTranslations.literal: Lin had no choice and was about to lead men when the crowd stopped him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sun Lin had no choice and was about to bring men when the crowd stopped him.

manualTranslations.zh: 綝曰：「國家屢有命，不可辭。
manualTranslations.literal: Lin said, "The state has repeatedly commanded; one cannot refuse.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sun Lin said, "The state has repeatedly commanded; I cannot refuse.

manualTranslations.zh: 可豫整兵，令府內起火，因是可得速還。」
manualTranslations.literal: You may ready troops in advance, set fire inside the mansion, and thereby return quickly."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Ready troops in advance, set fire inside the mansion, and I can return quickly."

manualTranslations.zh: 遂入，尋而火起，綝求出，休曰：「外兵自多，不足煩丞相也。」
manualTranslations.literal: He then entered; soon fire rose; Lin begged to leave; Xiu said, "Outside troops are plentiful enough—no need to trouble the Chancellor."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He entered; soon fire rose; Lin begged to leave; Emperor Xiu said, "Outside troops are plentiful—no need to trouble the chancellor."

manualTranslations.zh: 綝起離席，奉、布目左右縛之。
manualTranslations.literal: Lin rose from his seat; Feng and Bu signaled attendants to bind him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sun Lin rose; Ding Feng and Zhang Bu signaled attendants to bind him.

manualTranslations.zh: 綝叩首曰：「願徙交州。」
manualTranslations.literal: Lin kowtowed and said, "I wish to be banished to Jiaozhou."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lin kowtowed: "Banish me to Jiaozhou."

manualTranslations.zh: 休曰：「卿何以不徙滕胤、呂據？」
manualTranslations.literal: Xiu said, "Why did you not banish Teng Yin and Lü Ju?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiu said, "Why did you not banish Teng Yin and Lü Ju?"

manualTranslations.zh: 綝復曰：「願沒為官奴。」
manualTranslations.literal: Lin again said, "I wish to be reduced to government slaves."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Lin said, "Make me a government slave."

manualTranslations.zh: 休曰：「何不以胤、據為奴乎！」
manualTranslations.literal: Xiu said, "Why not make Yin and Ju the slaves!"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Emperor Xiu said, "Why not make Yin and Ju the slaves!"

manualTranslations.zh: 遂斬之。
manualTranslations.literal: Thereupon he was beheaded.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Then he was beheaded.

manualTranslations.zh: 以綝首令其眾曰：「諸與綝同謀皆赦。」
manualTranslations.literal: With Lin's head he addressed the host saying, "All who plotted with Lin are pardoned."
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Holding Lin's head he told the host, "All who plotted with Lin are pardoned."

manualTranslations.zh: 放仗者五千人。
manualTranslations.literal: Five thousand who laid down weapons were released.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Five thousand who laid down weapons were released.

manualTranslations.zh: 闓乘船欲北降，追殺之。
manualTranslations.literal: Kan took ship intending to surrender north; pursuers killed him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Kan tried to flee north by ship; pursuers killed him.

manualTranslations.zh: 夷三族。
manualTranslations.literal: Three clans were exterminated.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Three clans were exterminated.

manualTranslations.zh: 發孫峻棺，取其印綬，綝其木而埋之，以殺魯育等故也。
manualTranslations.literal: Sun Jun's coffin was opened, his seals and ribbons taken, the wood flayed and buried—because of the killing of Lu Yu and others.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sun Jun's coffin was opened, his seals taken, the wood flayed and buried—for the killing of Lu Yu and others.

sourceRange.text: 滕胤字承嗣，北海劇人也。伯父耽，父冑，與劉繇州裡通家。以世擾亂，渡江依繇。孫權為車騎將軍，拜耽右司馬，以寬厚稱，早卒，無嗣。冑善屬文，權待以賓禮，軍國書疏，常令損益潤色之，亦不幸短命。權為吳王，迫錄舊恩，封胤都亭侯。少有節操，美容儀。《吳書》曰：胤年十二，而孤單煢立，能治身厲行。為人白晳，威儀可觀。每正朔朝賀脩勤，在位大臣見者，無不歎賞。弱冠尚公主。年三十，起家為丹楊太守，徙吳郡、會稽，所在見稱。《吳書》曰：胤上表陳及時宜，及民間優劣，多所匡弼。權以胤故，增重公主之賜，屢加存問。胤每聽辭訟，斷罪法，察言觀色，務盡情理。人有窮冤悲苦之言，對之流涕。太元元年251年，權寢疾，詣都，留為太常；與諾葛恪等俱受遺詔輔政。孫亮即位，加衛將軍。

context.beforeSource: 後為將，討儋耳，還拜丹楊太守，年三十三卒。
context.afterSource: 恪將悉眾伐魏。
context.beforeLocal: 後為將，討儋耳，還拜丹楊太守，年三十三卒。
context.afterLocal: 恪將悉眾伐魏。

manualTranslations.zh: 滕胤字承嗣，北海劇人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Teng Yin, courtesy name Chengsi, was a man of Ju in Beihai.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Teng Yin, styled Chengsi, came from Ju in Beihai.

manualTranslations.zh: 伯父耽，父冑，與劉繇州裡通家。
manualTranslations.literal: His father's elder brother was Dan; his father was Zhou; they were family friends with Liu Yao in the same province.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His uncle Dan and his father Zhou were old family friends of Liu Yao in the province.

manualTranslations.zh: 以世擾亂，渡江依繇。
manualTranslations.literal: Because the age was in turmoil, they crossed the river and relied on Yao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In the turmoil of the times they crossed the Yangzi and attached themselves to Liu Yao.

manualTranslations.zh: 孫權為車騎將軍，拜耽右司馬，以寬厚稱，早卒，無嗣。
manualTranslations.literal: When Sun Quan was General of Chariots and Cavalry he appointed Dan Right Major; Dan was praised for generosity and died young without heirs.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Sun Quan was general of chariots and cavalry he made Dan right major; Dan was known for generosity, died young, and left no heirs.

manualTranslations.zh: 冑善屬文，權待以賓禮，軍國書疏，常令損益潤色之，亦不幸短命。
manualTranslations.literal: Zhou excelled at composition; Quan treated him with guest ceremony and often had him revise and polish state and military documents; he too died young by misfortune.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhou was a skilled writer whom Sun Quan honored as a guest and often asked to polish state papers; he too died young.

manualTranslations.zh: 權為吳王，迫錄舊恩，封胤都亭侯。
manualTranslations.literal: When Quan became King of Wu he, mindful of old kindness, enfeoffed Yin as Marquis of the Capital Precinct.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Sun Quan became king of Wu he remembered old debts and enfeoffed Yin as marquis of the capital precinct.

manualTranslations.zh: 少有節操，美容儀。
manualTranslations.literal: From youth he had integrity and handsome bearing.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From youth he was principled and handsome.

manualTranslations.zh: 《吳書》曰：胤年十二，而孤單煢立，能治身厲行。
manualTranslations.literal: The Wu shu states: Yin at twelve stood alone and orphaned, yet could discipline himself and enforce conduct.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Wu shu states that at twelve Yin was orphaned yet disciplined himself sternly.

manualTranslations.zh: 為人白晳，威儀可觀。
manualTranslations.literal: He was fair-skinned and his bearing was admirable.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Fair-skinned, his bearing was imposing.

manualTranslations.zh: 每正朔朝賀脩勤，在位大臣見者，無不歎賞。
manualTranslations.literal: At each New Year court congratulation he was diligent in ritual; ministers who saw him all sighed in admiration.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At New Year audiences his ritual diligence moved every minister who saw him.

manualTranslations.zh: 弱冠尚公主。
manualTranslations.literal: At coming of age he married an imperial princess.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At his capping he married an imperial princess.

manualTranslations.zh: 年三十，起家為丹楊太守，徙吳郡、會稽，所在見稱。
manualTranslations.literal: At thirty he first left home to serve as Administrator of Danyang, was transferred to Wu and Kuaiji commanderies, and was praised wherever he served.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At thirty he became administrator of Danyang, then served Wu and Kuaiji, winning praise in each post.

manualTranslations.zh: 《吳書》曰：胤上表陳及時宜，及民間優劣，多所匡弼。
manualTranslations.literal: The Wu shu states: Yin memorialized on timely policy and on the merits and faults among the people, correcting much.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Wu shu states that Yin memorialized on policy and popular conditions and corrected much.

manualTranslations.zh: 權以胤故，增重公主之賜，屢加存問。
manualTranslations.literal: Because of Yin, Quan increased the princess's gifts and repeatedly sent inquiries.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: For Teng Yin's sake Sun Quan enriched the princess's gifts and often sent inquiries.

manualTranslations.zh: 胤每聽辭訟，斷罪法，察言觀色，務盡情理。
manualTranslations.literal: Whenever Yin heard lawsuits he judged by law, watched words and expressions, and strove to exhaust reason and feeling.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In court Teng Yin judged by law, read faces, and strove for justice tempered by mercy.

manualTranslations.zh: 人有窮冤悲苦之言，對之流涕。
manualTranslations.literal: When people spoke of desperate wrongs and bitter grief he wept before them.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He wept openly when petitioners told tales of desperate wrong.

manualTranslations.zh: 太元元年251年，權寢疾，詣都，留為太常；
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Taixuan, 251 CE, when Quan lay ill Yin went to the capital and was retained as Chamberlain for Ceremonies;
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Taixuan 1 (251), when Sun Quan fell ill, Teng Yin came to court and was kept as chamberlain for ceremonies;

manualTranslations.zh: 與諾葛恪等俱受遺詔輔政。
manualTranslations.literal: together with Zhuge Ke and others he received the deathbed edict to assist government.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: and with Zhuge Ke and others received the deathbed regency.

manualTranslations.zh: 孫亮即位，加衛將軍。
manualTranslations.literal: When Sun Liang took the throne Yin was made Guard General.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Sun Liang succeeded, Yin was made guard general.

sourceRange.text: 孫峻字子遠，孫堅弟靜之曾孫也。靜生暠，暠生恭，為散騎侍郎。恭生峻。少便弓馬，精果膽決。孫權末，徙武衛都尉，為侍中。權臨薨，受遺輔政，領武衛將軍，故典宿衛，封都鄉侯。既誅諸葛恪，遷丞相大將軍，督中外諸軍事、假節，進封富春侯。滕胤以恪子竦妻父辭位。峻曰：「鯀、禹罪不相及，滕侯何為？」峻、胤雖內不沾洽，而外相包容，進胤爵高密侯，共事如前。《吳錄》曰：群臣上奏，共推峻為太尉，議胤為司徒。時有媚峻者，以為大統宜在公族，若滕胤為亞公，聲名素重，眾心所附，不可貳也。乃表以峻為丞相，又不置御史大夫，士人皆失望矣。峻素無重名，驕矜險害，多所刑殺，百姓囂然。又姦亂宮人，與公主魯班私通。五鳳元年254年，吳侯英謀殺峻，英事洩死。

context.beforeSource: 《吳書》曰：胤寵任彌高，接士愈勤，表奏書疏，皆自經意，不以委下。
context.afterSource: 二年，魏毋丘儉、文欽以眾叛，與魏人戰於樂嘉，峻帥驃騎將軍呂據、左將軍留贊襲壽春，會欽敗降，軍還。

manualTranslations.zh: 孫峻字子遠，孫堅弟靜之曾孫也。
manualTranslations.literal: Sun Jun, courtesy name Ziyuan, was a great-grandson of Jing, younger brother of Sun Jian.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sun Jun, styled Ziyuan, was a great-grandson of Sun Jian's brother Jing.

manualTranslations.zh: 靜生暠，暠生恭，為散騎侍郎。
manualTranslations.literal: Jing begot Gao; Gao begot Gong, who was Regular Attendant of Scattered Cavalry.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Jing's line ran Gao to Gong, a regular attendant of scattered cavalry.

manualTranslations.zh: 恭生峻。
manualTranslations.literal: Gong begot Jun.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Gong was Jun's father.

manualTranslations.zh: 少便弓馬，精果膽決。
manualTranslations.literal: From youth he was skilled with bow and horse, decisive and daring.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: From youth he excelled at arms and acted with bold decisiveness.

manualTranslations.zh: 孫權末，徙武衛都尉，為侍中。
manualTranslations.literal: Late in Sun Quan's reign he was moved to Commandant of Martial Guards and made Palace Attendant.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Late in Sun Quan's reign he became commandant of martial guards and palace attendant.

manualTranslations.zh: 權臨薨，受遺輔政，領武衛將軍，故典宿衛，封都鄉侯。
manualTranslations.literal: As Quan lay dying Jun received the testament to assist government, took command as General of Martial Guards, continued to oversee palace guards, and was enfeoffed as Marquis of the Capital District.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At Sun Quan's deathbed Sun Jun received the regency, commanded the martial guards, kept palace security, and was enfeoffed as marquis of the capital district.

manualTranslations.zh: 既誅諸葛恪，遷丞相大將軍，督中外諸軍事、假節，進封富春侯。
manualTranslations.literal: After Zhuge Ke was executed he was moved to Chancellor and Grand General, put in charge of all military affairs inside and outside with credential staff, and advanced to Marquis of Fuchun.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: After Zhuge Ke's execution he became chancellor and grand general with full military command and was advanced to marquis of Fuchun.

manualTranslations.zh: 滕胤以恪子竦妻父辭位。
manualTranslations.literal: Teng Yin, as father-in-law to Ke's son Song, declined office.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Teng Yin, Zhuge Ke's son-in-law, declined office.

manualTranslations.zh: 峻曰：「鯀、禹罪不相及，滕侯何為？」
manualTranslations.literal: Jun said, "Gun and Yu's crimes did not reach one another—why should Marquis Teng do so?"
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sun Jun said, "Gun and Yu were not punished for each other's crimes—why should Marquis Teng?"

manualTranslations.zh: 峻、胤雖內不沾洽，而外相包容，進胤爵高密侯，共事如前。
manualTranslations.literal: Though Jun and Yin were not close within, outwardly they accommodated each other; Jun advanced Yin to Marquis of Gaomi and they worked together as before.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Though Sun Jun and Teng Yin were cold in private, outwardly they cooperated; Jun made Yin marquis of Gaomi and business continued.

manualTranslations.zh: 《吳錄》曰：群臣上奏，共推峻為太尉，議胤為司徒。
manualTranslations.literal: The Wu lu states: The ministers jointly memorialized, recommending Jun as Grand Commandant and Yin as Minister over the Masses.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The Wu lu states that ministers recommended Sun Jun as grand commandant and Teng Yin as minister over the masses.

manualTranslations.zh: 時有媚峻者，以為大統宜在公族，若滕胤為亞公，聲名素重，眾心所附，不可貳也。
manualTranslations.literal: At the time flatterers of Jun held that the great succession should rest with the ducal clan; if Teng Yin became deputy minister, his fame was already weighty and hearts attached to him—he could not be made second.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Flatterers argued the succession belonged to the imperial clan; if famed Teng Yin became deputy minister hearts would divide.

manualTranslations.zh: 乃表以峻為丞相，又不置御史大夫，士人皆失望矣。
manualTranslations.literal: Thereupon they memorialized to make Jun Chancellor and again did not appoint a Grandee Secretary; scholars all despaired.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They made Sun Jun chancellor instead and left the censorate empty; scholars despaired.

manualTranslations.zh: 峻素無重名，驕矜險害，多所刑殺，百姓囂然。
manualTranslations.literal: Jun had never had great reputation; he was arrogant, dangerous, and harmful, executed many, and the common people were in uproar.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Sun Jun had never been esteemed; arrogant and cruel, he killed freely and the people seethed.

manualTranslations.zh: 又姦亂宮人，與公主魯班私通。
manualTranslations.literal: He also debauched palace women and privately consorted with Princess Lu Ban.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: He debauched palace women and kept Princess Lu Ban as a lover.

manualTranslations.zh: 五鳳元年254年，吳侯英謀殺峻，英事洩死。
manualTranslations.literal: In the first year of Wufeng, 254 CE, Marquis of Wu Ying plotted to kill Jun; Ying's affair leaked and he died.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wufeng 1 (254): Marquis Ying of Wu plotted to kill Sun Jun; the plot leaked and Ying died.

sourceRange.text: 」濮陽興字子元，陳留人也。父逸，漢末避亂江東，官至長沙太守。逸事見《陸瑁傳》。興少有士名，孫權時除上虞令，稍遷至尚書左曹，以五官中郎將使蜀，還為會稽太守。時琅邪王休居會稽，興深與相結。及休即位，徵興為太常衛將軍、平軍國事，封外黃侯。永安三年260年，都尉嚴密建丹楊湖田，作浦裡塘。

context.beforeSource: 其罹恪等事見遠徙者，一切召還。
context.afterSource: 詔百官會議，咸以為用功多而田不保成，唯興以為可成。

manualTranslations.zh: 濮陽興字子元，陳留人也。
manualTranslations.literal: Puyang Xing, courtesy name Ziyuan, was a man of Chenliu.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Puyang Xing, styled Ziyuan, came from Chenliu.

manualTranslations.zh: 父逸，漢末避亂江東，官至長沙太守。
manualTranslations.literal: His father Yi, fleeing chaos at the end of Han, crossed to Jiangdong and rose to Administrator of Changsha.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: His father Yi fled the late-Han turmoil to Jiangdong and became administrator of Changsha.

manualTranslations.zh: 逸事見《陸瑁傳》。
manualTranslations.literal: Yi's career appears in the biography of Lu Mao.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yi's career is recorded in the biography of Lu Mao.

manualTranslations.zh: 興少有士名，孫權時除上虞令，稍遷至尚書左曹，以五官中郎將使蜀，還為會稽太守。
manualTranslations.literal: Xing early gained a scholar's reputation; under Sun Quan he was appointed magistrate of Shangyu, gradually rose to the left bureau of the Masters of Writing, served as General of the Five Offices as envoy to Shu, and on return became Administrator of Kuaiji.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Puyang Xing won early fame as a gentleman; under Sun Quan he served as magistrate of Shangyu, rose through the secretariat, went to Shu as envoy, and returned as administrator of Kuaiji.

manualTranslations.zh: 時琅邪王休居會稽，興深與相結。
manualTranslations.literal: At that time Prince of Langye Xiu resided in Kuaiji, and Xing formed a deep bond with him.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: While Prince Xiu of Langye lived in Kuaiji, Puyang Xing became his close ally.

manualTranslations.zh: 及休即位，徵興為太常衛將軍、平軍國事，封外黃侯。
manualTranslations.literal: When Xiu took the throne, Xing was summoned as Chamberlain for Ceremonies and Guard General and charged with settling military affairs, enfeoffed as Marquis of Waihuang.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: When Emperor Xiu ascended the throne, Xing was made chamberlain for ceremonies and guard general, charged with military affairs, and enfeoffed as marquis of Waihuang.

manualTranslations.zh: 永安三年260年，都尉嚴密建丹楊湖田，作浦裡塘。
manualTranslations.literal: In the third year of Yongan, 260 CE, Commandant Yan Mi proposed Danyang lake-field works, building Puli Pool.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Yongan 3 (260): Commandant Yan Mi proposed the Danyang lake-field project and the Puli reclamation.

items.acceptedSourceText: 濮陽興字子元，陳留人也。父逸，漢末避亂江東，官至長沙太守。逸事見《陸瑁傳》。興少有士名，孫權時除上虞令，稍遷至尚書左曹，以五官中郎將使蜀，還為會稽太守。時琅邪王休居會稽，興深與相結。及休即位，徵興為太常衛將軍、平軍國事，封外黃侯。永安三年260年，都尉嚴密建丹楊湖田，作浦裡塘。

sourceRange.text: 初，權黃龍元年229年遷都建業。二年築東興堤遏湖水。後徵淮南，敗，以內船，由是廢不復修。恪以建興元年252年十月會眾於東興，更作大堤，左右結山俠築兩城，各留千人，使全端、留略守之，引軍而還。魏以吳軍入其疆土，恥於受侮，命大將胡遵、諸葛誕等率眾七萬，欲攻圍兩塢，圖壞堤遏。恪興軍四萬，晨夜赴救。遵等敕其諸軍作浮橋度，陳於堤上，分兵攻兩城。城在高峻，不可卒拔。恪遣將軍留贊、呂據、唐諮、丁奉為前部。時天寒雪，魏諸將會飲，見贊等兵少，而解置鎧甲，不持矛戟。但兜鍪刀楯，夥身緣遏，大笑之，不即嚴兵。兵得上，便鼓譟亂斫。魏軍驚擾散走，爭渡浮橋，橋壞絕，自投於水，更相蹈藉。樂安太守桓嘉等同時並沒，死者數萬。故叛將韓綜為魏前軍督，亦斬之。獲車乘牛馬驢騾各數千，資器山積，振旅而歸。進封恪陽都侯，加荊揚州牧，督中外諸軍事，賜金一百斤，馬二百匹，繒佈各萬匹。

context.beforeSource: 恪每出入，百姓延頸思見其狀。
context.afterSource: 恪遂有輕敵之心，以十二月戰克，明年春，復欲出軍。
context.beforeLocal: 恪每出入，百姓延頸思見其狀。
context.afterLocal: 恪遂有輕敵之心，以十二月戰克，明年春，復欲出軍。

manualTranslations.zh: 初，權黃龍元年229年遷都建業。
manualTranslations.literal: At first, in the first year of Huanglong, 229 CE, Quan moved the capital to Jianye.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: At first, in Huanglong 1 (229), Sun Quan moved the capital to Jianye.

manualTranslations.zh: 二年築東興堤遏湖水。
manualTranslations.literal: In the second year he built the Dongxing embankment to dam the lake waters.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The next year he built the Dongxing dyke to hold back the lake.

manualTranslations.zh: 後徵淮南，敗，以內船，由是廢不復修。
manualTranslations.literal: Later a Huainan campaign failed; because the boats were internal, the works were abandoned and never repaired.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: A later Huainan campaign failed; the boats were unsuited, and the works were abandoned.

manualTranslations.zh: 恪以建興元年252年十月會眾於東興，更作大堤，左右結山俠築兩城，各留千人，使全端、留略守之，引軍而還。
manualTranslations.literal: Ke, in the tenth month of the first year of Jianxing, 252 CE, assembled forces at Dongxing, rebuilt the great embankment, linked mountain flanks to erect two forts, left a thousand men in each, appointed Quan Duan and Liu Lue to hold them, and withdrew the main army.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In Jianxing 1, month 10 (252), Zhuge Ke rebuilt the great Dongxing dyke, threw up twin forts on the flanks with a thousand men each under Quan Duan and Liu Lue, and marched home.

manualTranslations.zh: 魏以吳軍入其疆土，恥於受侮，命大將胡遵、諸葛誕等率眾七萬，欲攻圍兩塢，圖壞堤遏。
manualTranslations.literal: Wei, shamed that Wu troops had entered its territory, ordered Grand Generals Hu Zun, Zhuge Dan, and others to lead seventy thousand men to attack and besiege the two forts and break the dam.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Humiliated by Wu incursion, Wei sent Hu Zun, Zhuge Dan, and seventy thousand men to storm the twin forts and break the dyke.

manualTranslations.zh: 恪興軍四萬，晨夜赴救。
manualTranslations.literal: Ke raised an army of forty thousand and rushed to the rescue day and night.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhuge Ke marched forty thousand men to the rescue without rest.

manualTranslations.zh: 遵等敕其諸軍作浮橋度，陳於堤上，分兵攻兩城。
manualTranslations.literal: Zun and the others ordered their hosts to build pontoon bridges to cross, arrayed on the embankment, and divided forces to attack the two forts.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zun ordered pontoon bridges thrown across, lined the dyke, and split forces to assault both forts.

manualTranslations.zh: 城在高峻，不可卒拔。
manualTranslations.literal: The forts stood high and steep and could not be taken at once.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: The forts were too high and steep to storm quickly.

manualTranslations.zh: 恪遣將軍留贊、呂據、唐諮、丁奉為前部。
manualTranslations.literal: Ke sent Generals Liu Zan, Lü Ju, Tang Zi, and Ding Feng as the van.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhuge Ke sent Liu Zan, Lü Ju, Tang Zi, and Ding Feng ahead as the van.

manualTranslations.zh: 時天寒雪，魏諸將會飲，見贊等兵少，而解置鎧甲，不持矛戟。
manualTranslations.literal: It was bitterly cold and snowing; the Wei generals were drinking together, saw that Zan and the others had few troops, and doffed their armor, laying aside spears and halberds.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: In driving snow the Wei generals drank, saw how few Wu troops faced them, and stripped off armor and spears.

manualTranslations.zh: 但兜鍪刀楯，夥身緣遏，大笑之，不即嚴兵。
manualTranslations.literal: They wore only helmets, swords, and shields, climbed the embankment in a crowd, laughed at them, and did not immediately ready their troops.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Helmets, swords, and shields only, they swarmed the dyke laughing and did not immediately ready their troops.

manualTranslations.zh: 兵得上，便鼓譟亂斫。
manualTranslations.literal: Once Wu troops gained the height, they beat drums, shouted, and hacked in disorder.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wu soldiers surged up, drums roaring, blades flailing.

manualTranslations.zh: 魏軍驚擾散走，爭渡浮橋，橋壞絕，自投於水，更相蹈藉。
manualTranslations.literal: The Wei army panicked and scattered, scrambling for the pontoon bridges; the bridges broke, men threw themselves into the water, and trampled one another.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Wei troops broke, crushed the bridges, drowned and trampled one another in flight.

manualTranslations.zh: 樂安太守桓嘉等同時並沒，死者數萬。
manualTranslations.literal: Administrator of Le'an Huan Jia and others perished together; the dead numbered in the tens of thousands.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Le'an administrator Huan Jia and others drowned with them; tens of thousands died.

manualTranslations.zh: 故叛將韓綜為魏前軍督，亦斬之。
manualTranslations.literal: The former rebel general Han Zong, serving as Wei van commander, was also beheaded.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Han Zong, the turncoat now commanding Wei van, was beheaded too.

manualTranslations.zh: 獲車乘牛馬驢騾各數千，資器山積，振旅而歸。
manualTranslations.literal: They captured thousands of carts, cattle, horses, donkeys, and mules, with stores piled like hills, and returned in good order.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: They seized thousands of wagons and beasts, booty heaped like hills, and marched home in triumph.

manualTranslations.zh: 進封恪陽都侯，加荊揚州牧，督中外諸軍事，賜金一百斤，馬二百匹，繒佈各萬匹。
manualTranslations.literal: Ke was advanced to Marquis of Yangdu, made Governor of Jing and Yang provinces, put in charge of all military affairs inside and outside, and granted one hundred jin of gold, two hundred horses, and ten thousand bolts each of silk and cloth.
manualTranslations.idiomatic: Zhuge Ke was made marquis of Yangdu, governor of Jing and Yang, commander of all forces, and given a hundred jin of gold, two hundred horses, and ten thousand bolts each of silk and cloth.
